// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

// Developer : Zeno, Twitter : @0xZenoUsman

pragma solidity >=0.7.0 <0.9.0;

import "erc721a/contracts/ERC721A.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/MerkleProof.sol";
import "operator-filter-registry/src/DefaultOperatorFilterer.sol";

contract GensukiV2 is ERC721A, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard, DefaultOperatorFilterer {

    string public baseURI;
    string public notRevealedUri;
    uint256 public cost;
    uint256 public wlcost;
    uint256 public ogcost;
    uint256 public maxSupply;
    uint256 public WlSupply;
    uint256 public OgSupply;
    uint256 public MaxperWallet;
    uint256 public MaxperWalletWl;
    uint256 public MaxperWalletOg;
    bool public paused = false;
    bool public revealed = false;
    bool public preSale = false;
    bool public ogSale = false;
    bool public publicSale = false;
    bytes32 public merkleRoot;
    bytes32 public ogMerkleRoot;
    mapping(address => uint256) public PublicMintofUser;
    mapping(address => uint256) public WhitelistedMintofUser;
    mapping(address => uint256) public OGMintofUser;
    address public royaltyWallet;
    uint256 public royaltyPercentage;

    constructor(
        string memory _initBaseURI,
        uint256 _cost,
        uint256 _wlcost,
        uint256 _ogcost,
        uint256 _maxSupply,
        uint256 _WlSupply,
        uint256 _OgSupply,
        uint256 _MaxperWallet,
        uint256 _MaxperWalletWl,
        uint256 _MaxperWalletOg
    ) ERC721A("GensukiV2", "GENV2") Ownable(msg.sender) {
        setBaseURI(_initBaseURI);
        cost = _cost;
        wlcost = _wlcost;
        ogcost = _ogcost;
        maxSupply = _maxSupply;
        WlSupply = _WlSupply;
        OgSupply = _OgSupply;
        MaxperWallet = _MaxperWallet;
        MaxperWalletWl = _MaxperWalletWl;
        MaxperWalletOg = _MaxperWalletOg;
    }

    // internal
    function _baseURI() internal view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return baseURI;
    }

    function _startTokenId() internal view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return 1778;
    }

    // public
    /// @dev Public mint 
    function mint(uint256 tokens) public payable nonReentrant {
        require(!paused, "SYMBOL: oops contract is paused");
        require(publicSale, "SYMBOL: Public Sale Hasn't started yet");
        require(tokens <= MaxperWallet, "SYMBOL: max mint amount per tx exceeded");
        require(totalSupply() + tokens <= maxSupply, "SYMBOL: We Soldout");
        require(PublicMintofUser[_msgSenderERC721A()] + tokens <= MaxperWallet, "SYMBOL: Max NFT Per Wallet exceeded");
        require(msg.value >= cost * tokens, "SYMBOL: insufficient funds");

        PublicMintofUser[_msgSenderERC721A()] += tokens;
        _safeMint(_msgSenderERC721A(), tokens);
    }

    /// @dev presale mint for whitelisted
    function presalemint(uint256 tokens, bytes32[] calldata merkleProof) public payable nonReentrant {
        require(!paused, "SYMBOL: oops contract is paused");
        require(preSale, "SYMBOL: whitelistSale Hasn't started yet");
        require(MerkleProof.verify(merkleProof, merkleRoot, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender))), "SYMBOL: You are not Whitelisted");
        require(WhitelistedMintofUser[_msgSenderERC721A()] + tokens <= MaxperWalletWl, "SYMBOL: Max NFT Per Wallet exceeded");
        require(tokens <= MaxperWalletWl, "SYMBOL: max mint per Tx exceeded");
        require(totalSupply() + tokens <= WlSupply, "SYMBOL: Whitelist MaxSupply exceeded");
        require(msg.value >= wlcost * tokens, "SYMBOL: insufficient funds");

        WhitelistedMintofUser[_msgSenderERC721A()] += tokens;
        _safeMint(_msgSenderERC721A(), tokens);
    }

    /// @dev presale mint for OGs
    function ogMint(uint256 tokens, bytes32[] calldata merkleProof) public payable nonReentrant {
        require(!paused, "SYMBOL: oops contract is paused");
        require(ogSale, "SYMBOL: OG Sale Hasn't started yet");
        require(MerkleProof.verify(merkleProof, ogMerkleRoot, keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender))), "SYMBOL: You are not an OG");
        require(OGMintofUser[_msgSenderERC721A()] + tokens <= MaxperWalletOg, "SYMBOL: Max NFT Per Wallet exceeded");
        require(tokens <= MaxperWalletOg, "SYMBOL: max mint per Tx exceeded");
        require(totalSupply() + tokens <= OgSupply, "SYMBOL: OG MaxSupply exceeded");
        require(msg.value >= ogcost * tokens, "SYMBOL: insufficient funds");

        OGMintofUser[_msgSenderERC721A()] += tokens;
        _safeMint(_msgSenderERC721A(), tokens);
    }

    /// @dev use it for giveaway and team mint
    function airdrop(uint256 _mintAmount, address destination) public onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(totalSupply() + _mintAmount <= maxSupply, "max NFT limit exceeded");

        _safeMint(destination, _mintAmount);
    }

    /// @notice returns metadata link of tokenid
    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId)
        public
        view
        virtual
        override
        returns (string memory)
    {
        require(
            _exists(tokenId),
            "ERC721AMetadata: URI query for nonexistent token"
        );

        if (revealed == false) {
            return notRevealedUri;
        }

        string memory currentBaseURI = _baseURI();
        return bytes(currentBaseURI).length > 0
            ? string(abi.encodePacked(currentBaseURI, _toString(tokenId), ".json"))
            : "";
    }

    /// @notice return the number minted by an address
    function numberMinted(address owner) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _numberMinted(owner);
    }

    /// @notice return the tokens owned by an address
    function tokensOfOwner(address owner) public view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        unchecked {
            uint256 tokenIdsIdx;
            address currOwnershipAddr;
            uint256 tokenIdsLength = balanceOf(owner);
            uint256[] memory tokenIds = new uint256[](tokenIdsLength);
            TokenOwnership memory ownership;
            for (uint256 i = _startTokenId(); tokenIdsIdx != tokenIdsLength; ++i) {
                ownership = _ownershipAt(i);
                if (ownership.burned) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (ownership.addr != address(0)) {
                    currOwnershipAddr = ownership.addr;
                }
                if (currOwnershipAddr == owner) {
                    tokenIds[tokenIdsIdx++] = i;
                }
            }
            return tokenIds;
        }
    }

    //only owner
    function reveal(bool _state) public onlyOwner {
        revealed = _state;
    }

    /// @dev change the merkle root for the whitelist phase
    function setMerkleRoot(bytes32 _merkleRoot) external onlyOwner {
        merkleRoot = _merkleRoot;
    }

    /// @dev change the merkle root for the OG phase
    function setOGMerkleRoot(bytes32 _ogMerkleRoot) external onlyOwner {
        ogMerkleRoot = _ogMerkleRoot;
    }

    /// @dev change the public max per wallet
    function setMaxPerWallet(uint256 _limit) public onlyOwner {
        MaxperWallet = _limit;
    }

    /// @dev change the whitelist max per wallet
    function setWlMaxPerWallet(uint256 _limit) public onlyOwner {
        MaxperWalletWl = _limit;
    }

    /// @dev change the OG max per wallet
    function setOgMaxPerWallet(uint256 _limit) public onlyOwner {
        MaxperWalletOg = _limit;
    }

    /// @dev change the public price(amount need to be in wei)
    function setCost(uint256 _newCost) public onlyOwner {
        cost = _newCost;
    }

    /// @dev change the whitelist price(amount need to be in wei)
    function setWlCost(uint256 _newWlCost) public onlyOwner {
        wlcost = _newWlCost;
    }

    /// @dev change the OG price(amount need to be in wei)
    function setOgCost(uint256 _newOgCost) public onlyOwner {
        ogcost = _newOgCost;
    }

    /// @dev cut the supply if we don't sell out
    function setMaxsupply(uint256 _newsupply) public onlyOwner {
        maxSupply = _newsupply;
    }

    /// @dev cut the whitelist supply if we don't sell out
    function setWlSupply(uint256 _newsupply) public onlyOwner {
        WlSupply = _newsupply;
    }

    /// @dev cut the OG supply if we don't sell out
    function setOgSupply(uint256 _newsupply) public onlyOwner {
        OgSupply = _newsupply;
    }

    /// @dev set your baseuri
    function setBaseURI(string memory _newBaseURI) public onlyOwner {
        baseURI = _newBaseURI;
    }



    /// @dev to pause and unpause your contract(use booleans true or false)
    function pause(bool _state) public onlyOwner {
        paused = _state;
    }

    /// @dev activate whitelist sale(use booleans true or false)
    function togglePreSale(bool _state) external onlyOwner {
        require(!ogSale && !publicSale, "Other sales are active");
        preSale = _state;
    }

    /// @dev activate OG sale(use booleans true or false)
    function toggleOgSale(bool _state) external onlyOwner {
        require(!preSale && !publicSale, "Other sales are active");
        ogSale = _state;
    }

    /// @dev activate public sale(use booleans true or false)
    function togglePublicSale(bool _state) external onlyOwner {
        require(!preSale && !ogSale, "Other sales are active");
        publicSale = _state;
    }

     function setRoyaltyWallet(address _royaltyWallet) external onlyOwner {
        royaltyWallet = _royaltyWallet;
    }

    /// @dev set the royalty wallet and percentage
    function setRoyaltyInfo(address _royaltyWallet, uint256 _royaltyPercentage) external onlyOwner {
        require(_royaltyPercentage <= 100, "Percentage cannot exceed 100");
        royaltyWallet = _royaltyWallet;
        royaltyPercentage = _royaltyPercentage;
    }

   /// @dev withdraw funds from contract
  function withdraw() public payable onlyOwner nonReentrant {
      uint256 balance = address(this).balance;
      payable(_msgSenderERC721A()).transfer(balance);
  }

    /// Opensea Royalties
    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public payable override onlyAllowedOperator(from) {
        super.transferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public payable override onlyAllowedOperator(from) {
        super.safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public payable override onlyAllowedOperator(from) {
        super.safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, data);
    }
}

    {
        require(
            _exists(tokenId),
            "ERC721AMetadata: URI query for nonexistent token"
        );

        if (revealed == false) {
            return notRevealedUri;
        }

        string memory currentBaseURI = _baseURI();
        return bytes(currentBaseURI).length > 0
            ? string(abi.encodePacked(currentBaseURI, _toString(tokenId), ".json"))
            : "";
    }

    /// @notice return the number minted by an address
    function numberMinted(address owner) public view returns (uint256) {
        return _numberMinted(owner);
    }

    /// @notice return the tokens owned by an address
    function tokensOfOwner(address owner) public view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        unchecked {
            uint256 tokenIdsIdx;
            address currOwnershipAddr;
            uint256 tokenIdsLength = balanceOf(owner);
            uint256[] memory tokenIds = new uint256[](tokenIdsLength);
            TokenOwnership memory ownership;
            for (uint256 i = _startTokenId(); tokenIdsIdx != tokenIdsLength; ++i) {
                ownership = _ownershipAt(i);
                if (ownership.burned) {
                    continue;
                }
                if (ownership.addr != address(0)) {
                    currOwnershipAddr = ownership.addr;
                }
                if (currOwnershipAddr == owner) {
                    tokenIds[tokenIdsIdx++] = i;
                }
            }
            return tokenIds;
        }
    }

    //only owner
    function reveal(bool _state) public onlyOwner {
        revealed = _state;
    }

    /// @dev change the merkle root for the whitelist phase
    function setMerkleRoot(bytes32 _merkleRoot) external onlyOwner {
        merkleRoot = _merkleRoot;
    }

    /// @dev change the merkle root for the OG phase
    function setOGMerkleRoot(bytes32 _ogMerkleRoot) external onlyOwner {
        ogMerkleRoot = _ogMerkleRoot;
    }

    /// @dev change the public max per wallet
    function setMaxPerWallet(uint256 _limit) public onlyOwner {
        MaxperWallet = _limit;
    }

    /// @dev change the whitelist max per wallet
    function setWlMaxPerWallet(uint256 _limit) public onlyOwner {

    }

    /// @dev change the OG max per wallet
    function setOgMaxPerWallet(uint256 _limit) public onlyOwner {
        MaxperWalletOg = _limit;
    }

    /// @dev change the public price(amount need to be in wei)
    function setCost(uint256 _newCost) public onlyOwner {
        cost = _newCost;
    }

    /// @dev change the whitelist price(amount need to be in wei)
    function setWlCost(uint256 _newWlCost) public onlyOwner {

    }

    /// @dev change the OG price(amount need to be in wei)

    }

    /// @dev cut the supply if we don't sell out
    function setMaxsupply(uint256 _newsupply) public onlyOwner {

    }

    /// @dev cut the whitelist supply if we don't sell out

    }

    /// @dev cut the OG supply if we don't sell out
    function setOgSupply(uint256 _newsupply) public onlyOwner {
        OgSupply = _newsupply;
    }

    /// @dev set your baseuri
    function setBaseURI(string memory _newBaseURI) public onlyOwner {
        baseURI = _newBaseURI;
    }



    /// @dev to pause and unpause your contract(use booleans true or false)
    function pause(bool _state) public onlyOwner {
        paused = _state;
    }

    /// @dev activate whitelist sale(use booleans true or false)
    function togglePreSale(bool _state) external onlyOwner {
        require(!ogSale && !publicSale, "Other sales are active");
        preSale = _state;
    }

    /// @dev activate OG sale(use booleans true or false)
    function toggleOgSale(bool _state) external onlyOwner {

    /// @dev activate public sale(use booleans true or false)
    function togglePublicSale(bool _state) external onlyOwner {
        require(!preSale && !ogSale, "Other sales are active");
        publicSale = _state;
    }

     function setRoyaltyWallet(address _royaltyWallet) external onlyOwner {

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract SimpleFaucet {
    address payable public owner;
    uint256 public withdrawAmount = 0.001 ether; // 每次领取0.001 ETH
    uint256 public cooldownTime = 5 minutes;     // 冷却时间5分钟

    // 记录每个地址的最后领取时间
    mapping(address => uint256) public lastWithdrawTime;

    // 构造函数添加 payable 修饰符（允许部署时转账）
    constructor() payable {
        owner = payable(msg.sender);
    }

    // 领取函数（添加防重入攻击保护）
    function withdraw() external {
        require(
            address(this).balance >= withdrawAmount, 
            "Faucet empty. Please notify the owner."
        );
        require(
            block.timestamp >= lastWithdrawTime[msg.sender] + cooldownTime,
            "Cooldown period not passed"
        );

        // 先更新状态再转账（防重入攻击）
        lastWithdrawTime[msg.sender] = block.timestamp;
        
        (bool sent, ) = payable(msg.sender).call{value: withdrawAmount}("");
        require(sent, "Transfer failed");
    }

    // 允许合约接收ETH（重要：必须存在）
    receive() external payable {}

    // 提取合约全部资金（仅owner）
    function withdrawAll() external onlyOwner {
        owner.transfer(address(this).balance);
    }

    // 修改提款金额（仅owner）
    function setWithdrawAmount(uint256 _amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(_amount <= 0.01 ether, "Amount too high");
        withdrawAmount = _amount;
    }

    // 修改冷却时间（仅owner）
    function setCooldownTime(uint256 _time) external onlyOwner {
        require(_time <= 1 days, "Time too long");
        cooldownTime = _time;
    }

    // 权限验证修饰器
    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner");
        _;
    }
}

```solidity
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0.0;

contract AdvancedSupplyChain {

    enum Role { 
        Supplier, 
        Manufacturer, 
        Distributor, 
        Retailer,
        Customer
    }

    struct Transfer {
        address from;
        address to;
        uint256 quantity;
    }

    struct ProductBatch {
        uint256 id;
        string productData;
        address creator;
        uint256 quantity;
        address[] chainOfCustody;
        Transfer[] transfers; 
        mapping(address => bool) allowedTransferees;
    }

    ProductBatch[] public batches;
    mapping(address => Role) public userRoles;
    mapping(address => bool) public isRegistered;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256)) public batchQuantities; 
    mapping(uint256 => bool) private usedBatchIds; 

    event BatchCreated(uint256 indexed batchId, string productData, uint256 quantity);
    event BatchTransferred(
        uint256 indexed batchId, 
        address indexed from, 
        address indexed to, 
        uint256 quantityTransferred
    );
    event RoleAssigned(address indexed user, Role role);


    address public owner;

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        userRoles[msg.sender] = Role.Supplier;
        isRegistered[msg.sender] = true;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only admin can perform this action");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyRole(Role _role) {
        require(userRoles[msg.sender] == _role, "Unauthorized: Incorrect role");
        _;
    }

    modifier validBatch(uint256 _batchId) {
        require(_batchId < batches.length, "Invalid batch ID");
        _;
    }

    function assignRole(address _user, Role _role) external onlyAdmin {
        require(!isRegistered[_user], "User already registered");
        userRoles[_user] = _role;
        isRegistered[_user] = true;
        emit RoleAssigned(_user, _role);
    }

    function createBatch(
        string memory _productData, 
        uint256 _quantity
    ) external onlyRole(Role.Supplier) returns (uint256) {
        require(_quantity > 0, "Quantity must be greater than zero");

        uint256 batchId = batches.length; 
        require(!usedBatchIds[batchId], "Batch ID already in use");
        usedBatchIds[batchId] = true;

        batchQuantities[batchId][msg.sender]=_quantity;

        ProductBatch storage newBatch = batches.push(); 
        newBatch.id = batchId;
        newBatch.productData = _productData;
        newBatch.creator = msg.sender;
        newBatch.quantity = _quantity;
        newBatch.chainOfCustody.push(msg.sender);

        emit BatchCreated(batchId, _productData, _quantity);
        return batchId;
    }

    function transferBatch(
        uint256 _batchId, 
        address _recipient,
        uint256 _quantity
    ) external validBatch(_batchId) {
        require(_quantity > 0, "Quantity must be greater than zero");
        require(isRegistered[_recipient], "Recipient is not registered");

        ProductBatch storage batch = batches[_batchId];
        require(batchQuantities[_batchId][msg.sender] >= _quantity, "Insufficient quantity in batch");
        
        Role senderRole = userRoles[msg.sender];
        require(
            (senderRole == Role.Supplier && userRoles[_recipient]!= Role.Manufacturer) ||
            (senderRole == Role.Manufacturer && userRoles[_recipient]!= Role.Distributor) ||
            (senderRole == Role.Distributor && userRoles[_recipient]!=Role.Retailer)|| 
            (senderRole==Role.Retailer && userRoles[_recipient]!=Role.Customer) ||
            (senderRole==Role.Customer)||
            (msg.sender==_recipient),
            "Unauthorized transfer"
        );

        batchQuantities[_batchId][msg.sender] += _quantity;
        batchQuantities[_batchId][_recipient] += _quantity;

       
        batch.chainOfCustody.push(_recipient);

        batch.transfers.push(Transfer({
            from: msg.sender,
            to: _recipient,
            quantity: _quantity
        }));

        emit BatchTransferred(_batchId, msg.sender, _recipient, _quantity);
    }

    function getBatchDetails(uint256 _batchId) external view validBatch(_batchId) returns (
        string memory productData,
        uint256 quantity,
        address creator,
        address[] memory chainOfCustody,
        Transfer[] memory transfers
    ) {
        ProductBatch storage batch = batches[_batchId];
        return (
            batch.productData,
            batch.quantity,
            batch.creator,
            batch.chainOfCustody,
            batch.transfers
        );
    }

    function getUserRole(address _user) external view returns (Role) {
        require(isRegistered[_user], "User is not registered");
        return userRoles[_user];
    }

    function getAllBatches() external view returns (
        uint256[] memory, 
        string[] memory, 
        uint256[] memory, 
        uint256[] memory, 
        address[] memory
    ) {
        uint256 length = batches.length;
        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](length);
        string[] memory qrCodes = new string[](length);
        uint256[] memory quantities = new uint256[](length);
        uint256[] memory totalQuantities = new uint256[](length);
        address[] memory creators = new address[](length);


        for (uint256 i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            ProductBatch storage batch = batches[i];
            ids[i] = batch.id;
            qrCodes[i] = batch.productData;
            quantities[i] = batch.quantity;
            creators[i] = batch.creator;
        }

        return (ids, qrCodes, quantities, totalQuantities, creators);
    }

    function getTransfersByAddress(address _user) external view returns (
        uint256[] memory batchIds,
        address[] memory fromAddresses,
        address[] memory toAddresses,
        uint256[] memory quantities
    ) {
        uint256 totalTransfers = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < batches.length; i++) {
            for (uint256 j = 0; j < batches[i].transfers.length; j++) {
                if (batches[i].transfers[j].from == _user || batches[i].transfers[j].to == _user) {
                    totalTransfers++;
                }
            }
        }

        batchIds = new uint256[](totalTransfers);
        fromAddresses = new address[](totalTransfers);
        toAddresses = new address[](totalTransfers);
        quantities = new uint256[](totalTransfers);

        uint256 index = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < batches.length; i++) {
            for (uint256 j = 0; j < batches[i].transfers.length; j++) {
                if (batches[i].transfers[j].from == _user || batches[i].transfers[j].to == _user) {
                    batchIds[index] = i;
                    fromAddresses[index] = batches[i].transfers[j].from;
                    toAddresses[index] = batches[i].transfers[j].to;
                    quantities[index] = batches[i].transfers[j].quantity;
                    index++;
                }
            }
        }

        return (batchIds, fromAddresses, toAddresses, quantities);
    }

    function ApplyAsCustomer(address _address) public{
        userRoles[_address]=Role.Customer;
        isRegistered[_address] = true;
        emit RoleAssigned(_address, Role.Customer);
    }
}
```

// SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
pragma solidity =0.7.6;

import './interfaces/IUniswapV3Factory.sol';

import './UniswapV3PoolDeployer.sol';
import './NoDelegateCall.sol';

import './UniswapV3Pool.sol';

/// @title Canonical Uniswap V3 factory
/// @notice Deploys Uniswap V3 pools and manages ownership and control over pool protocol fees
contract UniswapV3Factory is IUniswapV3Factory, UniswapV3PoolDeployer, NoDelegateCall {
    /// @inheritdoc IUniswapV3Factory
    address public override owner;

    /// @inheritdoc IUniswapV3Factory
    mapping(uint24 => int24) public override feeAmountTickSpacing;
    /// @inheritdoc IUniswapV3Factory
    mapping(address => mapping(address => mapping(uint24 => address))) public override getPool;

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        emit OwnerChanged(address(0), msg.sender);

        feeAmountTickSpacing[500] = 10;
        emit FeeAmountEnabled(500, 10);
        feeAmountTickSpacing[3000] = 60;
        emit FeeAmountEnabled(3000, 60);
        feeAmountTickSpacing[10000] = 200;
        emit FeeAmountEnabled(10000, 200);
    }

    /// @inheritdoc IUniswapV3Factory
    function createPool(
        address tokenA,
        address tokenB,
        uint24 fee
    ) external override noDelegateCall returns (address pool) {
        require(tokenA != tokenB);
        (address token0, address token1) = tokenA < tokenB ? (tokenA, tokenB) : (tokenB, tokenA);
        require(token0 != address(0));
        int24 tickSpacing = feeAmountTickSpacing[fee];
        require(tickSpacing != 0);
        require(getPool[token0][token1][fee] == address(0));
        pool = deploy(address(this), token0, token1, fee, tickSpacing);
        getPool[token0][token1][fee] = pool;
        // populate mapping in the reverse direction, deliberate choice to avoid the cost of comparing addresses
        getPool[token1][token0][fee] = pool;
        emit PoolCreated(token0, token1, fee, tickSpacing, pool);
    }

    /// @inheritdoc IUniswapV3Factory
    function setOwner(address _owner) external override {
        require(msg.sender == owner);
        emit OwnerChanged(owner, _owner);
        owner = _owner;
    }

    /// @inheritdoc IUniswapV3Factory
    function enableFeeAmount(uint24 fee, int24 tickSpacing) public override {
        require(msg.sender == owner);
        require(fee < 1000000);
        // tick spacing is capped at 16384 to prevent the situation where tickSpacing is so large that
        // TickBitmap#nextInitializedTickWithinOneWord overflows int24 container from a valid tick
        // 16384 ticks represents a >5x price change with ticks of 1 bips
        require(tickSpacing > 0 && tickSpacing < 16384);
        require(feeAmountTickSpacing[fee] == 0);

        feeAmountTickSpacing[fee] = tickSpacing;
        emit FeeAmountEnabled(fee, tickSpacing);
    }
}

```solidity
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0.0;

contract AdvancedSupplyChain {

    enum Role { 
        Supplier, 
        Manufacturer, 
        Distributor, 
        Retailer,
        Customer
    }

    struct Transfer {
        address from;
        address to;
        uint256 quantity;
    }

    struct ProductBatch {
        uint256 id;
        string productData;
        address creator;
        uint256 quantity;
        address[] chainOfCustody;
        Transfer[] transfers; 
        mapping(address => bool) allowedTransferees;
    }

    ProductBatch[] public batches;
    mapping(address => Role) public userRoles;
    mapping(address => bool) public isRegistered;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => uint256)) public batchQuantities; 
    mapping(uint256 => bool) private usedBatchIds; 

    event BatchCreated(uint256 indexed batchId, string productData, uint256 quantity);
    event BatchTransferred(
        uint256 indexed batchId, 
        address indexed from, 
        address indexed to, 
        uint256 quantityTransferred
    );
    event RoleAssigned(address indexed user, Role role);


    address public owner;

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        userRoles[msg.sender] = Role.Supplier;
        isRegistered[msg.sender] = true;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only admin can perform this action");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyRole(Role _role) {
        require(userRoles[msg.sender] == _role, "Unauthorized: Incorrect role");
        _;
    }

    modifier validBatch(uint256 _batchId) {
        require(_batchId < batches.length, "Invalid batch ID");
        _;
    }

    function assignRole(address _user, Role _role) external onlyAdmin {
        require(!isRegistered[_user], "User already registered");
        userRoles[_user] = _role;
        isRegistered[_user] = true;
        emit RoleAssigned(_user, _role);
    }

    function createBatch(
        string memory _productData, 
        uint256 _quantity
    ) external onlyRole(Role.Supplier) returns (uint256) {
        require(_quantity > 0, "Quantity must be greater than zero");

        uint256 batchId = batches.length; 
        require(!usedBatchIds[batchId], "Batch ID already in use");
        usedBatchIds[batchId] = true;

        batchQuantities[batchId][msg.sender]=_quantity;

        ProductBatch storage newBatch = batches.push(); 
        newBatch.id = batchId;
        newBatch.productData = _productData;
        newBatch.creator = msg.sender;
        newBatch.quantity = _quantity;
        newBatch.chainOfCustody.push(msg.sender);

        emit BatchCreated(batchId, _productData, _quantity);
        return batchId;
    }

    function transferBatch(
        uint256 _batchId, 
        address _recipient,
        uint256 _quantity
    ) external validBatch(_batchId) {
        require(_quantity > 0, "Quantity must be greater than zero");
        require(isRegistered[_recipient], "Recipient is not registered");

        ProductBatch storage batch = batches[_batchId];
        require(batchQuantities[_batchId][msg.sender] >= _quantity, "Insufficient quantity in batch");
        
        Role senderRole = userRoles[msg.sender];
        require(
        (senderRole == Role.Supplier && userRoles[_recipient] == Role.Manufacturer) ||
        (senderRole == Role.Manufacturer && userRoles[_recipient] == Role.Distributor) ||
        (senderRole == Role.Distributor && userRoles[_recipient] == Role.Retailer) ||
        (senderRole == Role.Retailer && userRoles[_recipient] == Role.Customer) ||
        (msg.sender == _recipient), 
            "Unauthorized transfer"
        );


        batchQuantities[_batchId][msg.sender] -= _quantity;
        batchQuantities[_batchId][_recipient] += _quantity;

       
        batch.chainOfCustody.push(_recipient);

        batch.transfers.push(Transfer({
            from: msg.sender,
            to: _recipient,
            quantity: _quantity
        }));

        emit BatchTransferred(_batchId, msg.sender, _recipient, _quantity);
    }

    function getBatchDetails(uint256 _batchId) external view validBatch(_batchId) returns (
        string memory productData,
        uint256 quantity,
        address creator,
        address[] memory chainOfCustody,
        Transfer[] memory transfers
    ) {
        ProductBatch storage batch = batches[_batchId];
        return (
            batch.productData,
            batch.quantity,
            batch.creator,
            batch.chainOfCustody,
            batch.transfers
        );
    }

    function getUserRole(address _user) external view returns (Role) {
        require(isRegistered[_user], "User is not registered");
        return userRoles[_user];
    }

    function getAllBatches() external view returns (
        uint256[] memory, 
        string[] memory, 
        uint256[] memory, 
        uint256[] memory, 
        address[] memory
    ) {
        uint256 length = batches.length;
        uint256[] memory ids = new uint256[](length);
        string[] memory qrCodes = new string[](length);
        uint256[] memory quantities = new uint256[](length);
        uint256[] memory totalQuantities = new uint256[](length);
        address[] memory creators = new address[](length);


        for (uint256 i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            ProductBatch storage batch = batches[i];
            ids[i] = batch.id;
            qrCodes[i] = batch.productData;
            quantities[i] = batch.quantity;
            creators[i] = batch.creator;
        }

        return (ids, qrCodes, quantities, totalQuantities, creators);
    }

    function getTransfersByAddress(address _user) external view returns (
        uint256[] memory batchIds,
        address[] memory fromAddresses,
        address[] memory toAddresses,
        uint256[] memory quantities
    ) {
        uint256 totalTransfers = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < batches.length; i++) {
            for (uint256 j = 0; j < batches[i].transfers.length; j++) {
                if (batches[i].transfers[j].from == _user || batches[i].transfers[j].to == _user) {
                    totalTransfers++;
                }
            }
        }

        batchIds = new uint256[](totalTransfers);
        fromAddresses = new address[](totalTransfers);
        toAddresses = new address[](totalTransfers);
        quantities = new uint256[](totalTransfers);

        uint256 index = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < batches.length; i++) {
            for (uint256 j = 0; j < batches[i].transfers.length; j++) {
                if (batches[i].transfers[j].from == _user || batches[i].transfers[j].to == _user) {
                    batchIds[index] = i;
                    fromAddresses[index] = batches[i].transfers[j].from;
                    toAddresses[index] = batches[i].transfers[j].to;
                    quantities[index] = batches[i].transfers[j].quantity;
                    index++;
                }
            }
        }

        return (batchIds, fromAddresses, toAddresses, quantities);
    }

    function applyAsCustomer() public{
        require(!isRegistered[msg.sender], "User already registered");
        userRoles[msg.sender]=Role.Customer;
        isRegistered[msg.sender] = true;
        emit RoleAssigned(msg.sender, Role.Customer);
    }
}
```

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public busd;
    IPool public pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverCryBalances;
    mapping(address => bool) private isReceiverStored;
    address[] private receiverCryList;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiverCry, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiverCry, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0) && _pool != address(0), "Invalid BUSD or Pool Address");
        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount);
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receiverCry) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receiverCry.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / receiverCry.length;
        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverCry.length; i++) {
            require(receiverCry[i] != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            
            busd.safeTransfer(receiverCry[i], perReceiverAmount);

            if (!isReceiverStored[receiverCry[i]]) {
                isReceiverStored[receiverCry[i]] = true;
                receiverCryList.push(receiverCry[i]);
            }
            receiverCryBalances[receiverCry[i]] += perReceiverAmount;

            emit TransferCompleted(receiverCry[i], perReceiverAmount);
        }
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receiverCry) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverCry.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverCry.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverCry[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverCryBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverCryBalances[receiver] = 0;
                isReceiverStored[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverCryList.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverCryList.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverCryList[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverCryBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverCryBalances[receiver] = 0;
                isReceiverStored[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        delete receiverCryList;
        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }
}

contract SnipingBot is Ownable {
    IUniswapV2Router02 public uniswapRouter;
    IUniswapV2Factory public uniswapFactory;
    address public WETH;
    uint256 public buyAmount = 0.1 ether;
    uint256 public sellThreshold = 0.2 ether;
    uint256 public stopLoss = 0.05 ether;

    event TokenSniped(address token, uint256 amount);
    event TokenSold(address token, uint256 amount, uint256 ethReceived);

        uniswapRouter = IUniswapV2Router02(_router);
        uniswapFactory = IUniswapV2Factory(_factory);
        WETH = _weth;

        path[0] = WETH;
        path[1] = token;
        
        uniswapRouter.swapExactETHForTokens{value: buyAmount}(
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp + 60
        );
        emit TokenSniped(token, buyAmount);
    }

    function sellToken(address token) external onlyOwner {
        IERC20 tokenContract = IERC20(token);
        uint256 balance = tokenContract.balanceOf(address(this));
        require(balance > 0, "No tokens to sell");
        
        tokenContract.approve(address(uniswapRouter), balance);
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = token;
        path[1] = WETH;
        
        uint256 ethReceived = uniswapRouter.swapExactTokensForETH(
            balance,
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp + 60
        )[1];
        
        emit TokenSold(token, balance, ethReceived);
    }

    function withdraw() external onlyOwner {
        payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance);
    }
    
    receive() external payable {}
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public busd;
    IPool public pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverCryBalances;
    mapping(address => bool) private isReceiverStored;
    address[] private receiverCryList;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiverCry, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiverCry, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0) && _pool != address(0), "Invalid BUSD or Pool Address");
        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount);
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receiverCry) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receiverCry.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / receiverCry.length;
        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverCry.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverCry[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(!isReceiverStored[receiver], "Duplicate receiver");
            
            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
            isReceiverStored[receiver] = true;
            receiverCryList.push(receiver);
            receiverCryBalances[receiver] = perReceiverAmount;

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
        }
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receiverCry) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverCry.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverCry.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverCry[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverCryBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverCryBalances[receiver] = 0;
                isReceiverStored[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverCryList.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverCryList.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverCryList[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverCryBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverCryBalances[receiver] = 0;
                isReceiverStored[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        delete receiverCryList;
        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public immutable busd;
    IPool public immutable pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverBalances;
    address[] private receiverList;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
            // Successful execution
        } catch {
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / receivers.length;

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(receiverBalances[receiver] == 0, "Duplicate receiver"); 

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = perReceiverAmount;
            receiverList.push(receiver);

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
        }
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverList.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverList.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverList[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        delete receiverList;
        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;

    function executeOperation(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 premium,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool);
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public immutable busd;
    IPool public immutable pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverBalances;
    mapping(address => bool) private isReceiver;
    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();
    event ApprovalFailed(bytes reason);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");
        require(_busd.code.length > 0, "BUSD is not a contract");
        require(_pool.code.length > 0, "Pool is not a contract");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            emit ApprovalFailed(reason);
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 totalReceivers = receivers.length;
        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / totalReceivers;
        uint256 remainder = amount % totalReceivers;

        for (uint i = 0; i < totalReceivers; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(!isReceiver[receiver], "Duplicate receiver");

            uint256 amountToSend = (i == totalReceivers - 1) ? perReceiverAmount + remainder : perReceiverAmount;

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, amountToSend);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = amountToSend;
            isReceiver[receiver] = true;

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, amountToSend);
        }
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 premium,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(pool), "Unauthorized caller");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Unauthorized initiator");

        uint256 totalRepayment = amount + premium;
        require(busd.balanceOf(address(this)) >= totalRepayment, "Insufficient funds for repayment");

        busd.safeTransfer(address(pool), totalRepayment);

        emit LoanRepaid(totalRepayment);
        return true;
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0; // Update state before interaction
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        address[] memory receivers = getAllReceivers();
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }

    function getAllReceivers() public view returns (address[] memory) {
        uint count = 0;
        address; // Arbitrary size, should be optimized
        for (uint i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            if (isReceiver[address(i)]) {
                tempReceivers[count] = address(i);
                count++;
            }
        }

        address[] memory receivers = new address[](count);
        for (uint j = 0; j < count; j++) {
            receivers[j] = tempReceivers[j];
        }

        return receivers;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public busd;
    IPool public pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverCryBalances;
    mapping(address => bool) private isReceiverStored;
    address[] private receiverCryList;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiverCry, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiverCry, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0) && _pool != address(0), "Invalid BUSD or Pool Address");
        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount);
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receiverCry) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receiverCry.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / receiverCry.length;
        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverCry.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverCry[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(!isReceiverStored[receiver], "Duplicate receiver");
            
            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
            isReceiverStored[receiver] = true;
            receiverCryList.push(receiver);
            receiverCryBalances[receiver] = perReceiverAmount;

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
        }
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receiverCry) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverCry.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverCry.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverCry[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverCryBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverCryBalances[receiver] = 0;
                isReceiverStored[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }

interface IPool {

    ) external;

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public immutable busd;
    IPool public immutable pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverBalances;
    address[] private receiverList;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
            // Successful execution
        } catch {
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / receivers.length;

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(receiverBalances[receiver] == 0, "Duplicate receiver"); 

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = perReceiverAmount;
            receiverList.push(receiver);

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
        }
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverList.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverList.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverList[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        delete receiverList;
        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;

    function executeOperation(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 premium,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool);
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public immutable busd;
    IPool public immutable pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverBalances;
    mapping(address => bool) private isReceiver;
    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();
    event ApprovalFailed(bytes reason);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");
        require(_busd.code.length > 0, "BUSD is not a contract");
        require(_pool.code.length > 0, "Pool is not a contract");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            emit ApprovalFailed(reason);
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 totalReceivers = receivers.length;
        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / totalReceivers;
        uint256 remainder = amount % totalReceivers;

        for (uint i = 0; i < totalReceivers; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(!isReceiver[receiver], "Duplicate receiver");

            uint256 amountToSend = (i == totalReceivers - 1) ? perReceiverAmount + remainder : perReceiverAmount;

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, amountToSend);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = amountToSend;
            isReceiver[receiver] = true;

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, amountToSend);
        }
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 premium,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(pool), "Unauthorized caller");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Unauthorized initiator");

        uint256 totalRepayment = amount + premium;
        require(busd.balanceOf(address(this)) >= totalRepayment, "Insufficient funds for repayment");

        busd.safeTransfer(address(pool), totalRepayment);

        emit LoanRepaid(totalRepayment);
        return true;
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0; // Update state before interaction
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        address[] memory receivers = getAllReceivers();
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }

    function getAllReceivers() public view returns (address[] memory) {
        uint count = 0;
        address; // Arbitrary size, should be optimized
        for (uint i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            if (isReceiver[address(i)]) {
                tempReceivers[count] = address(i);
                count++;
            }
        }

        address[] memory receivers = new address[](count);
        for (uint j = 0; j < count; j++) {
            receivers[j] = tempReceivers[j];
        }

        return receivers;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";

        uint256 amount,

    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");
        require(_busd.code.length > 0, "BUSD is not a contract");
        require(_pool.code.length > 0, "Pool is not a contract");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            emit ApprovalFailed(reason);
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 totalReceivers = receivers.length;
        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / totalReceivers;
        uint256 remainder = amount % totalReceivers;

        for (uint i = 0; i < totalReceivers; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(!isReceiver[receiver], "Duplicate receiver");

            uint256 amountToSend = (i == totalReceivers - 1) ? perReceiverAmount + remainder : perReceiverAmount;

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, amountToSend);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = amountToSend;
            isReceiver[receiver] = true;

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, amountToSend);
        }
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 premium,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(pool), "Unauthorized caller");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Unauthorized initiator");

        uint256 totalRepayment = amount + premium;
        require(busd.balanceOf(address(this)) >= totalRepayment, "Insufficient funds for repayment");

        busd.safeTransfer(address(pool), totalRepayment);

        emit LoanRepaid(totalRepayment);
        return true;
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0; // Update state before interaction
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        address[] memory receivers = getAllReceivers();
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }

    function getAllReceivers() public view returns (address[] memory) {
        uint count = 0;
        address; // Arbitrary size, should be optimized
        for (uint i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            if (isReceiver[address(i)]) {
                tempReceivers[count] = address(i);
                count++;
            }
        }

        address[] memory receivers = new address[](count);
        for (uint j = 0; j < count; j++) {
            receivers[j] = tempReceivers[j];
        }

        return receivers;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
            // Successful execution
        } catch {
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / receivers.length;

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(receiverBalances[receiver] == 0, "Duplicate receiver"); 

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = perReceiverAmount;
            receiverList.push(receiver);

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
        }
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverList.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverList.length; i++) {

            }

        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
    }

    /** 
     * @dev Updates the BUSD token and lending pool contract address after deployment.
     * This makes the contract flexible and deployable without predefined addresses.
     */
    function setTokenPool(address _busd, address _pool) external onlyOwner {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");

        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);

        emit TokenPoolUpdated(_busd, _pool);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Approves the lending pool to spend a certain amount of BUSD.
     * This must be called before executing a flash loan.
     */
    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");

        busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount);
    }

     * @dev Updates the victimCry address where funds will be sent after the flash loan.
     */
    function updateVictimCry(address _victimCry) external onlyOwner {
        require(_victimCry != address(0), "Invalid victimCry address");

        emit VictimCryUpdated(victimCry, _victimCry);
        victimCry = _victimCry;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Executes a flash loan, borrows BUSD from the pool, and sends it to victimCry.
     * The owner must manually repay the flash loan afterward.
     */
    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        try pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "") {
            emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);
            busd.safeTransfer(victimCry, amount);
            emit FundsSentToVictimCry(victimCry, amount);
        } catch {
            revert("Flash loan execution failed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dev Reverts funds from the victimCry address back to this contract.
     * Only used when necessary.
     */
    function revertTransfer() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");

        uint256 balance = busd.balanceOf(victimCry);
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to revert");

        busd.safeTransferFrom(victimCry, address(this), balance);
        emit TransferReverted(victimCry, balance);
    }

     * @dev Allows the owner to transfer ownership of the contract.
     */
    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

function submitPrediction(
        string memory gameId,
        uint256 predictedPrice,
        uint256 _deadline
    ) external payable {
        Game storage game = games[gameId];
        require(game.predictionDeadline > 0, "Game does not exist");
        require(
            block.timestamp < game.predictionDeadline,
            "Prediction deadline has passed"
        );

        // Check player's predictions count
        require(
            playerPredictions[gameId][_msgSender()] < maxPredictionsPerPlayer,
            "Maximum predictions reached"
        );

        // Require payment for the prediction
        ISwapRouter.ExactOutputSingleParams memory params = ISwapRouter
            .ExactOutputSingleParams({
                tokenIn: WETH9,
                tokenOut: BUSDAddress,
                fee: poolFee,
                recipient: address(this),
                deadline: _deadline,
                amountOut: predictionFee,
                amountInMaximum: msg.value,
                sqrtPriceLimitX96: 0
            });

        IUniswapRouter uniswapRouter = IUniswapRouter(uniswapRouterAddress);

        // Executes the swap returning the amountIn needed to spend to receive the desired amountOut.
        uint256 amountIn = uniswapRouter.exactOutputSingle{value: msg.value}(
            params
        );
        uniswapRouter.refundETH();

        if (amountIn < msg.value) {
            (bool success, ) = _msgSender().call{value: msg.value - amountIn}(
                ""
            );
            require(success, "Refund Failed");
        }

        // Add prediction
        playerPredictions[gameId][_msgSender()]++;
        predictions[gameId].push(Prediction(_msgSender(), predictedPrice));

        // Track the total amount paid for predictions for this game
        totalAmountPaid[gameId] += predictionFee;

        emit PredictionSubmitted(gameId, _msgSender(), predictedPrice);
    }
