// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract ExamSystem {
    struct Student {
        address studentAddress;
        string name;
        bool registered;
    }

    struct Exam {
        uint256 id;
        string subject;
        string date;
        string question1;
        string question2;
        string question3;
        bool isActive;
    }

    address public admin;
    mapping(address => Student) public students;
    mapping(uint256 => Exam) public exams;

    uint256 public examCount;
    bool public systemActive = true;

    address[] private registeredStudentsList;

    event StudentRegistered(address indexed student, string name);
    event ExamScheduled(uint256 indexed id, string subject, string date);
    event AnswerSubmitted(address indexed student, uint256 examId, string answerHash);
    event ExamEnded(uint256 indexed id);
    event ExamActivated(uint256 indexed id);
    event SystemDeactivated();
    event SystemReactivated();

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "Only admin can perform this action");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyActiveSystem() {
        require(systemActive, "System is not active");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyRegisteredStudent() {
        require(students[msg.sender].registered, "You are not registered");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        admin = msg.sender;
        require(admin != address(0), "Admin address cannot be zero");
    }

    // Register a student
    function registerStudent(string memory _name) public onlyActiveSystem {
        require(!students[msg.sender].registered, "Already registered");
        students[msg.sender] = Student(msg.sender, _name, true);
        registeredStudentsList.push(msg.sender);
        emit StudentRegistered(msg.sender, _name);
    }

    // Admin schedules an exam
    function scheduleExam(
        string memory _subject,
        string memory _date,
        string memory _question1,
        string memory _question2,
        string memory _question3
    ) public onlyAdmin onlyActiveSystem {
        examCount++;
        exams[examCount] = Exam(
            examCount,
            _subject,
            _date,
            _question1,
            _question2,
            _question3,
            true
        );
        emit ExamScheduled(examCount, _subject, _date);
        emit ExamActivated(examCount);
    }

    // View an exam by ID
    function viewExam(uint256 _id) public view returns (Exam memory) {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active");
        return exams[_id];
    }

    // Get a single exam safely
    function getExamById(uint256 _id) public view returns (Exam memory) {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Exam does not exist");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active or has ended");
        return exams[_id];
    }

    // Get all active exams
    function getAllExams() public view returns (Exam[] memory) {
        require(systemActive, "System is not active");

        uint256 activeExamCount = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= examCount; i++) {
            if (exams[i].isActive) {
                activeExamCount++;
            }
        }

        Exam[] memory activeExams = new Exam[](activeExamCount);
        uint256 counter = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= examCount; i++) {
            if (exams[i].isActive) {
                activeExams[counter] = exams[i];
                counter++;
            }
        }

        return activeExams;
    }

    // Student submits an answer
    function submitAnswer(uint256 _id, string memory _answerHash)
        public
        onlyRegisteredStudent
        onlyActiveSystem
    {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active");
        emit AnswerSubmitted(msg.sender, _id, _answerHash);
    }

    // End an exam by ID
    function endExam(uint256 _id) public onlyAdmin {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam already ended");
        exams[_id].isActive = false;
        emit ExamEnded(_id);
    }

    // Deactivate the system
    function deactivateSystem() public onlyAdmin {
        systemActive = false;
        emit SystemDeactivated();
    }

    // Reactivate the system
    function reactivateSystem() public onlyAdmin {
        systemActive = true;
        emit SystemReactivated();
    }

    // Get role of the current user
    function login() public view returns (string memory role) {
        if (msg.sender == admin) {
            return "admin";
        } else if (students[msg.sender].registered) {
            return "student";
        } else {
            return "unregistered";
        }
    }

    //Get all registered students (Admin only)
    function getAllStudents() public view onlyAdmin returns (Student[] memory) {
        uint256 studentCount = registeredStudentsList.length;
        Student[] memory registeredStudents = new Student[](studentCount);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < studentCount; i++) {
            address studentAddr = registeredStudentsList[i];
            if (students[studentAddr].registered) {
                registeredStudents[i] = students[studentAddr];
            }
        }
        return registeredStudents;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract ExamSystem {
    struct Student {
        address studentAddress;
        string name;
        bool registered;
    }

    struct Exam {
        uint256 id;
        string subject;
        string date;
        string question1;
        string question2;
        string question3;
        bool isActive;
    }

    address public admin;
    mapping(address => Student) public students;
    mapping(uint256 => Exam) public exams;

    uint256 public examCount;
    bool public systemActive = true;

    address[] private registeredStudentsList;

    event StudentRegistered(address indexed student, string name);
    event ExamScheduled(uint256 indexed id, string subject, string date);
    event AnswerSubmitted(address indexed student, uint256 examId, string answerHash);
    event ExamEnded(uint256 indexed id);
    event ExamActivated(uint256 indexed id);
    event SystemDeactivated();
    event SystemReactivated();

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "Only admin can perform this action");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyActiveSystem() {
        require(systemActive, "System is not active");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyRegisteredStudent() {
        require(students[msg.sender].registered, "You are not registered");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        admin = msg.sender;
        require(admin != address(0), "Admin address cannot be zero");
    }

    // Register a student
    function registerStudent(string memory _name) public onlyActiveSystem {
        require(!students[msg.sender].registered, "Already registered");
        students[msg.sender] = Student(msg.sender, _name, true);
        registeredStudentsList.push(msg.sender);
        emit StudentRegistered(msg.sender, _name);
    }

    // Admin schedules an exam
    function scheduleExam(
        string memory _subject,
        string memory _date,
        string memory _question1,
        string memory _question2,
        string memory _question3
    ) public onlyAdmin onlyActiveSystem {
        examCount++;
        exams[examCount] = Exam(
            examCount,
            _subject,
            _date,
            _question1,
            _question2,
            _question3,
            true
        );
        emit ExamScheduled(examCount, _subject, _date);
        emit ExamActivated(examCount);
    }

    // View an exam by ID
    function viewExam(uint256 _id) public view returns (Exam memory) {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active");
        return exams[_id];
    }

    // Get a single exam safely
    function getExamById(uint256 _id) public view returns (Exam memory) {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Exam does not exist");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active or has ended");
        return exams[_id];
    }

    // Get all active exams
    function getAllExams() public view returns (Exam[] memory) {
        require(systemActive, "System is not active");

        uint256 activeExamCount = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= examCount; i++) {
            if (exams[i].isActive) {
                activeExamCount++;
            }
        }

        Exam[] memory activeExams = new Exam[](activeExamCount);
        uint256 counter = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= examCount; i++) {
            if (exams[i].isActive) {
                activeExams[counter] = exams[i];
                counter++;
            }
        }

        return activeExams;
    }

    // Student submits an answer
    function submitAnswer(uint256 _id, string memory _answerHash)
        public
        onlyRegisteredStudent
        onlyActiveSystem
    {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam is not active");
        emit AnswerSubmitted(msg.sender, _id, _answerHash);
    }

    // End an exam by ID
    function endExam(uint256 _id) public onlyAdmin {
        require(_id > 0 && _id <= examCount, "Invalid exam ID");
        require(exams[_id].isActive, "Exam already ended");
        exams[_id].isActive = false;
        emit ExamEnded(_id);
    }

    // Deactivate the system
    function deactivateSystem() public onlyAdmin {
        systemActive = false;
        emit SystemDeactivated();
    }

    // Reactivate the system
    function reactivateSystem() public onlyAdmin {
        systemActive = true;
        emit SystemReactivated();
    }

    // Get role of the current user
    function login() public view returns (string memory role) {
        if (msg.sender == admin) {
            return "admin";
        } else if (students[msg.sender].registered) {
            return "student";
        } else {
            return "unregistered";
        }
    }

    //Get all registered students (Admin only)
    function getAllStudents() public view onlyAdmin returns (Student[] memory) {
        uint256 studentCount = registeredStudentsList.length;
        Student[] memory registeredStudents = new Student[](studentCount);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < studentCount; i++) {
            address studentAddr = registeredStudentsList[i];
            if (students[studentAddr].registered) {
                registeredStudents[i] = students[studentAddr];
            }
        }
        return registeredStudents;
    }
}

contract GBALL {
    // Mapping of player scores.
mapping(address => uint256[]) public gballScores;
    
// Event emitted when a new score is added or updated
event NewScoreAdded(uint256[] _scores, address indexed _player);
    
// Event for leaderboard updates
event LeaderboardUpdatedEvent(address[] winners);

constructor() public {
        uniquePlayers = new bool[](0); 
}
mapping (uint =>bool ) private  uniqueplayers;
function addNewScore() external payable returns (uint) {
require(msg.value >= 1e9, "Minimum contribution required"); // Minimum contribution of 1 GWei required
        
    gballScores[msg.sender].push(msg.value);
        
        emit NewScoreAdded(gballScores[msg.sender], msg.sender);
        
       return uint(getTotalPoints());
}

function getTotalPoint(address _player) internal view returns (uint){
     require(_player != address(0), "Player must not be zero-address.");
    
    if(uniquePlayers[_player] == false)
        uniqueplayers[_player]= true;
        
       uint total = 0;
       
   for(uint i=0; i < gballScores[msg.sender].length(); ++i){

              }

mapping(address => uint256[]) private stakedBalances;

event StakeUpdatedEvent(address indexed _owner, uint256 stake);
    
    function stakeTokens(uint256 amount) public nonReentrant returns(bool){
            require(amount > 0 && msg.sender != address(0), "Invalid input");
            
           if(stakedBalances[msg.sender].length() == 0)
                stakedBalances[msg.sender] = new uint256[](1); // Initialize array for owner's balance
        
        _safeTransfer(address(this),msg.sender, amount *10**18);
        
            emit StakeUpdatedEvent(msg.sender,(amount*2)/100);

return true;

}
function unstakeTokens(uint256 amount) public nonReentrant returns(bool){
           require(amount > 0 && stakedBalances[msg.sender].length() != 0,"Invalid input");
            
        uint balance = getStakedBalance();
        
            if(balance == 0)
                return false; // No tokens to unstack
        
      _safeTransfer(address(this), msg.sender, amount *10**18); 
    
return true;
}

function rewardUsers(uint256 amount) public nonReentrant returns(bool){
           require(amount > 0 && totalSupply <=100000,"Invalid input");
        
            uint fee = ((amount)*2)/10 **18; // Calculate a 2% fee for rewards
        _safeTransfer(address(this), address(0x52B747686b97aFCFF67d1681e8fc5F9eCc9A26b8) ,fee); 
    
return true;
}

}

pragma solidity ^0.8;

contract GBALL {
    // Mapping of player scores.
mapping(address => uint256[]) public gballScores;
    
// Event emitted when a new score is added or updated
event NewScoreAdded(uint256[] _scores, address indexed _player);
    
// Event for leaderboard updates
event LeaderboardUpdatedEvent(address[] winners);

constructor() public {
        uniquePlayers = new bool[](0); 
}
mapping (uint =>bool ) private  uniqueplayers;
function addNewScore() external payable returns (uint) {
require(msg.value >= 1e9, "Minimum contribution required"); // Minimum contribution of 1 GWei required
        
    gballScores[msg.sender].push(msg.value);
        
        emit NewScoreAdded(gballScores[msg.sender], msg.sender);
        
       return uint(getTotalPoints());
}

function getTotalPoint(address _player) internal view returns (uint){
     require(_player != address(0), "Player must not be zero-address.");
    
    if(uniquePlayers[_player] == false)
        uniqueplayers[_player]= true;
        
       uint total = 0;
       
   for(uint i=0; i < gballScores[msg.sender].length(); ++i){
           //total += getTotelPoints(address(i));
              }
   
    return total;

}

function mintGBALL() external onlyOwner returns (bool success) {
        require(totalSupply <= 100000, "Maximum supply.");
    
         _safeMint(msg.sender ,1);

   return true;
}
// Staking logic

mapping(address => uint256[]) private stakedBalances;

event StakeUpdatedEvent(address indexed _owner, uint256 stake);
    
    function stakeTokens(uint256 amount) public nonReentrant returns(bool){
            require(amount > 0 && msg.sender != address(0), "Invalid input");
            
           if(stakedBalances[msg.sender].length() == 0)
                stakedBalances[msg.sender] = new uint256[](1); // Initialize array for owner's balance
        
        _safeTransfer(address(this),msg.sender, amount *10**18);
        
            emit StakeUpdatedEvent(msg.sender,(amount*2)/100);

return true;

}
function unstakeTokens(uint256 amount) public nonReentrant returns(bool){
           require(amount > 0 && stakedBalances[msg.sender].length() != 0,"Invalid input");
            
        uint balance = getStakedBalance();
        
            if(balance == 0)
                return false; // No tokens to unstack
        
      _safeTransfer(address(this), msg.sender, amount *10**18); 
    
return true;
}

function rewardUsers(uint256 amount) public nonReentrant returns(bool){
           require(amount > 0 && totalSupply <=100000,"Invalid input");
        
            uint fee = ((amount)*2)/10 **18; // Calculate a 2% fee for rewards
        _safeTransfer(address(this), address(0x52B747686b97aFCFF67d1681e8fc5F9eCc9A26b8) ,fee); 
    
return true;
}

function getStakedBalance() public view returns (uint256){
    return stakedBalances[msg.sender][stakedBalances[msg.sender].length()- 1];
} 

}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

/// @title Интерфейс для функции swap (на основе предоставленного ABI)
interface ISwap {
    function swap(
        address recipient,
        bool zeroForOne,
        int256 amountSpecified,
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96,
        bytes calldata data
    ) external returns (int256 amount0, int256 amount1);
}

contract MultiSwap {
    // Адреса внешних контрактов
    address public constant SWAP_CONTRACT_1 = 0xFe4fe5B4575c036aC6D5cCcFe13660020270e27A;
    address public constant SWAP_CONTRACT_2 = 0x7f51c8AaA6B0599aBd16674e2b17FEc7a9f674A1;

    // Структура для параметров свапа
    struct SwapParams {
        address recipient;
        bool zeroForOne;
        int256 amountSpecified;
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96;
        bytes data;
    }

    /// @notice Выполняет два свапа подряд в одной транзакции.
    /// Если хотя бы один свап завершается неудачно, вся транзакция отменяется.
    /// @param swap1 Параметры для первого свапа.
    /// @param swap2 Параметры для второго свапа.
    function executeMultiSwap(SwapParams calldata swap1, SwapParams calldata swap2) external {
        // Первый свап через контракт SWAP_CONTRACT_1
        try ISwap(SWAP_CONTRACT_1).swap(
            swap1.recipient,
            swap1.zeroForOne,
            swap1.amountSpecified,
            swap1.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            swap1.data
        ) returns (int256, int256) {
            // Можно добавить дополнительные проверки возвращаемых значений, если нужно.
        } catch {
            revert("Swap 1 failed");
        }

        // Второй свап через контракт SWAP_CONTRACT_2
        try ISwap(SWAP_CONTRACT_2).swap(
            swap2.recipient,
            swap2.zeroForOne,
            swap2.amountSpecified,
            swap2.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            swap2.data
        ) returns (int256, int256) {
            // Можно добавить дополнительные проверки возвращаемых значений, если нужно.
        } catch {
            revert("Swap 2 failed");
```solidity
        }
    }
}
```

```solidity
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
pragma solidity 0.8.20;

interface IPancakeRouter02 {
    function swapExactTokensForTokens(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        address[] calldata path,
        address to,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external returns (uint256[] memory amounts);
}

interface IPancakePair {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
}

interface IERC20 {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
}

contract NuwaToken {
    string public name = "nuwa";
    string public symbol = "nuwa";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;
    uint256 public totalSupply = 88000 * 1e18;

    address public owner;
    address public blackHoleAddress = 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD;
    address public marketingWallet;
    address public routerAddress;
    address public usdtAddress;
    address public lpTokenAddress;

    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowances;
    mapping(address => bool) public isWhiteListed;
    mapping(address => bool) public isExcluded;
    address[] public excludedAddresses;

    uint256 public totalLPRewards;
    bool private inSwap;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not owner");
        _;
    }

    modifier lockTheSwap {
        inSwap = true;
        _;
        inSwap = false;
    }

    constructor(address _router, address _usdt, address _lpToken, address _marketingWallet) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        balances[msg.sender] = totalSupply;
        routerAddress = _router;
        usdtAddress = _usdt;
        lpTokenAddress = _lpToken;
        marketingWallet = _marketingWallet;
        
        // 将合约和黑洞地址加入白名单
        isWhiteListed[address(this)] = true;
        isWhiteListed[blackHoleAddress] = true;
        isWhiteListed[owner] = true;
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return balances[account];
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        uint256 currentAllowance = allowances[sender][msg.sender];
        require(currentAllowance >= amount, "Amount exceeds allowance");
        _transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        allowances[sender][msg.sender] -= amount;
        return true;
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        allowances[msg.sender][spender] = amount;
        return true;
    }

    function _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(balances[sender] >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        balances[sender] -= amount;

        uint256 fee = 0;
        if (!isWhiteListed[sender] && !isWhiteListed[recipient]) {
            fee = amount * 3 / 100;
            uint256 receiveAmount = amount - fee;
            balances[recipient] += receiveAmount;
            emit Transfer(sender, recipient, receiveAmount);
            
            // 分配手续费
            _distributeFee(sender, fee);
        } else {
            balances[recipient] += amount;
            emit Transfer(sender, recipient, amount);
        }

        // 自动兑换逻辑
        if (recipient == address(this) && !inSwap) {
            inSwap = true;
            uint256 tokenAmount = amount - (isWhiteListed[sender] || isWhiteListed[recipient] ? 0 : fee);
            _swapForUSDT(tokenAmount);
            inSwap = false;
        }
    }

    function _distributeFee(address sender, uint256 fee) private lockTheSwap {
        uint256 part1 = fee * 8 / 30;
        uint256 part2 = fee * 7 / 30;
        uint256 part3 = fee * 8 / 30;
        uint256 part4 = fee * 7 / 30;

        // 发送到黑洞地址
        _transfer(sender, blackHoleAddress, part2);

        // 其他部分转入合约地址
        _transfer(sender, address(this), part1 + part3 + part4);

        // 兑换并处理各部分
        _swapAndStore(part1);
        
        uint256 lpUSDT = _swapAndGetUSDT(part3);
        totalLPRewards += lpUSDT;
        
        uint256 marketingUSDT = _swapAndGetUSDT(part4);
        IERC20(usdtAddress).transfer(marketingWallet, marketingUSDT);
    }

    function _swapAndStore(uint256 tokenAmount) private {
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = address(this);
        path[1] = usdtAddress;
        IERC20(address(this)).approve(routerAddress, tokenAmount);
        IPancakeRouter02(routerAddress).swapExactTokensForTokens(
            tokenAmount,
            0,
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function _swapAndGetUSDT(uint256 tokenAmount) private returns (uint256) {
        uint256 initialBalance = IERC20(usdtAddress).balanceOf(address(this));
        _swapAndStore(tokenAmount);
        return IERC20(usdtAddress).balanceOf(address(this)) - initialBalance;
    }

    function _swapForUSDT(uint256 tokenAmount) private {
        uint256 usdtBalance = IERC20(usdtAddress).balanceOf(address(this));
        uint256 blackHoleBalance = balances[blackHoleAddress];
        uint256 denominator = (88000e18 - blackHoleBalance) / 10;
        if (denominator == 0) denominator = 1;
        
        uint256 usdtAmount = (tokenAmount * usdtBalance) / denominator;
        if (usdtAmount > 0) {
            IERC20(usdtAddress).transfer(msg.sender, usdtAmount);
        }
    }

    function claimLPRewards() external {
        require(!isExcluded[msg.sender], "Excluded address");
        uint256 lpBalance = IPancakePair(lpTokenAddress).balanceOf(msg.sender);
        uint256 lpTotalSupply = IPancakePair(lpTokenAddress).totalSupply();
        
        // 计算有效总供应量
        for (uint i = 0; i < excludedAddresses.length; i++) {
            lpTotalSupply -= IPancakePair(lpTokenAddress).balanceOf(excludedAddresses[i]);
        }
        
        require(lpTotalSupply > 0, "No liquidity");
        uint256 share = (lpBalance * totalLPRewards) / lpTotalSupply;
        IERC20(usdtAddress).transfer(msg.sender, share);
        totalLPRewards -= share;
    }

    // 管理功能
    function addWhiteList(address addr) external onlyOwner {
        isWhiteListed[addr] = true;
    }

    function removeWhiteList(address addr) external onlyOwner {
        isWhiteListed[addr] = false;
    }

    function addExcludedAddress(address addr) external onlyOwner {
        require(!isExcluded[addr], "Already excluded");
        isExcluded[addr] = true;
        excludedAddresses.push(addr);
    }

    function removeExcludedAddress(address addr) external onlyOwner {
        require(isExcluded[addr], "Not excluded");
        isExcluded[addr] = false;
        for (uint i = 0; i < excludedAddresses.length; i++) {
            if (excludedAddresses[i] == addr) {
                excludedAddresses[i] = excludedAddresses[excludedAddresses.length-1];
                excludedAddresses.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
}
```

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.26;

contract Array {
    // Several ways to initialize an array
    uint256[] public arr;
    uint256[] public arr2 = [1, 2, 3];
    // Fixed sized array, all elements initialize to 0
    uint256[10] public myFixedSizeArr;

    function get(uint256 i) public view returns (uint256) {
        return arr[i];
    }

    // Solidity can return the entire array.
    // But this function should be avoided for
    // arrays that can grow indefinitely in length.
    function getArr() public view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        return arr;
    }

    function push(uint256 i) public {
        // Append to array
        // This will increase the array length by 1.
        arr.push(i);
    }

    function pop() public {
        // Remove last element from array
        // This will decrease the array length by 1
        arr.pop();
    }

    function getLength() public view returns (uint256) {
        return arr.length;
    }

    function remove(uint256 index) public {
        // Delete does not change the array length.
        // It resets the value at index to it's default value,
        // in this case 0
        delete arr[index];
    }

    function examples() external pure {
        // create array in memory, only fixed size can be created
        uint256[] memory a = new uint256[](5);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

/// @title Интерфейс для функции swap (на основе предоставленного ABI)
interface ISwap {
    function swap(
        address recipient,
        bool zeroForOne,
        int256 amountSpecified,
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96,
        bytes calldata data
    ) external returns (int256 amount0, int256 amount1);
}

/// @dev Базовый контракт. Пока пустой, но может служить для наследования.
contract BaseContract { }

/// @title Контракт для выполнения двух свапов в одной транзакции
contract MultiSwap is BaseContract {
    // Адреса внешних контрактов
    address public constant SWAP_CONTRACT_1 = 0xFe4fe5B4575c036aC6D5cCcFe13660020270e27A;
    address public constant SWAP_CONTRACT_2 = 0x7f51c8AaA6B0599aBd16674e2b17FEc7a9f674A1;

    // Структура для параметров свапа
    struct SwapParams {
        address recipient;
        bool zeroForOne;
        int256 amountSpecified;
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96;
        bytes data;
    }

    /// @dev Конструктор. Необходим для предотвращения абстрактности контракта.
    constructor() {}

    /// @notice Выполняет два свапа подряд в одной транзакции.
    /// Если хотя бы один свап завершается неудачно, вся транзакция отменяется.
    /// @param swap1 Параметры для первого свапа.
    /// @param swap2 Параметры для второго свапа.
    function executeMultiSwap(SwapParams calldata swap1, SwapParams calldata swap2) external {
        // Первый свап через контракт SWAP_CONTRACT_1
        try ISwap(SWAP_CONTRACT_1).swap(
            swap1.recipient,
            swap1.zeroForOne,
            swap1.amountSpecified,
            swap1.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            swap1.data
        ) returns (int256, int256) {
            // Дополнительные проверки можно добавить при необходимости.
        } catch {
            revert("Swap 1 failed");
        }

        // Второй свап через контракт SWAP_CONTRACT_2
        try ISwap(SWAP_CONTRACT_2).swap(
            swap2.recipient,
            swap2.zeroForOne,
            swap2.amountSpecified,
            swap2.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            swap2.data
        ) returns (int256, int256) {
            // Дополнительные проверки можно добавить при необходимости.
        } catch {
            revert("Swap 2 failed");
        }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.21;

/// @notice Minimal Chainlink Aggregator interface.
interface AggregatorV3Interface {
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
    function description() external view returns (string memory);
    function version() external view returns (uint256);
    function getRoundData(uint80 _roundId)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint80 roundId,
            int256 answer,
            uint256 startedAt,
            uint256 updatedAt,
            uint80 answeredInRound
        );
    function latestRoundData()
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint80 roundId,
            int256 answer,
            uint256 startedAt,
            uint256 updatedAt,
            uint80 answeredInRound
        );
}

/// @title ContractV4
/// @notice A gas-optimized smart contract to facilitate scalping in crypto trading.
/// @dev This contract allows users to deposit/withdraw ETH, execute rapid buy/sell orders with
///      configurable stop-loss/take-profit thresholds, enforce exposure and risk limits, and
///      integrate with Chainlink price feeds for real-time market data.
contract ContractV4 {
    address public owner;

    // User balances with minimal storage writes.
    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;

    // Per-user trading settings stored in a struct.
    struct TradeSettings {
        uint256 stopLoss;
        uint256 takeProfit;
        uint256 maxExposure; // Maximum allowed exposure per trade.
        uint256 lastTradeTime;
        uint256 dailyLoss;
        uint256 dailyLossLimit;
        uint256 lastTradeDay; // Used to reset daily loss.
    }
    mapping(address => TradeSettings) public tradeSettings;

    // Global trade timeout in seconds to manage high-frequency trading.
    uint256 public tradeTimeout;

    // Flags to halt trading.
    bool public gracefulStopActive;
    bool public hardStopActive;

    // Mapping for Chainlink price feeds. The key (e.g., keccak256("ETH/USD")) identifies the pair.
    mapping(bytes32 => AggregatorV3Interface) public chainlinkFeeds;

    // Enum for trade types.
    enum TradeType {
        Buy,
        Sell
    }

    // Events for logging.
    event Deposit(address indexed user, uint256 amount);
    event Withdrawal(address indexed user, uint256 amount);
    event TradeExecuted(
        address indexed user,
        string tradeType,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 stopLoss,
        uint256 takeProfit
    );
    event TradingHalted(bool hardStop);
    event TradeSettingsUpdated(
        address indexed user,
        uint256 stopLoss,
        uint256 takeProfit,
        uint256 maxExposure,
        uint256 dailyLossLimit
    );

    // Only the owner may call functions marked with this modifier.
    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not owner");
        _;
    }

    // Ensure that trading functions are callable only when a hard stop is not active.
    modifier tradingAllowed() {
        require(!hardStopActive, "Trading is hard stopped");
        _;
    }

    /// @notice Constructor sets the owner, trade timeout, and configures Chainlink price feeds.
    /// @param feedKeys An array of identifiers (e.g., keccak256("ETH/USD")).
    /// @param feedAddresses The corresponding Chainlink aggregator addresses.
    /// @param _tradeTimeout The minimum number of seconds required between trades per user.
    constructor(
        bytes32[] memory feedKeys,
        address[] memory feedAddresses,
        uint256 _tradeTimeout
    ) {
        require(feedKeys.length == feedAddresses.length, "Array length mismatch");
        owner = msg.sender;
        tradeTimeout = _tradeTimeout;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < feedKeys.length; i++) {
            chainlinkFeeds[feedKeys[i]] = AggregatorV3Interface(feedAddresses[i]);
        }
    }

    /// @notice Deposit ETH into your trading account.
    function deposit() public payable {
        require(msg.value > 0, "Must send ETH");
        balances[msg.sender] += msg.value;
        emit Deposit(msg.sender, msg.value);
    }

    /// @notice Withdraw ETH from your trading account.
    /// @param amount The amount to withdraw.
    function withdraw(uint256 amount) external {
        require(balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        balances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount);
        emit Withdrawal(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    /// @notice Batch deposit credits to multiple users (only callable by the owner).
    function batchDeposit(address[] calldata users, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyOwner {
        require(users.length == amounts.length, "Array length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < users.length; ) {
            balances[users[i]] += amounts[i];
            emit Deposit(users[i], amounts[i]);
            unchecked { i++; }
        }
    }

    /// @notice Batch withdrawal processing for multiple users (only callable by the owner).
    function batchWithdraw(address[] calldata users, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyOwner {
        require(users.length == amounts.length, "Array length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < users.length; ) {
            require(balances[users[i]] >= amounts[i], "Insufficient balance");
            balances[users[i]] -= amounts[i];
            payable(users[i]).transfer(amounts[i]);
            emit Withdrawal(users[i], amounts[i]);
            unchecked { i++; }
        }
    }

    /// @notice Set or update your trade settings.
    /// @param stopLoss Pre-calculated stop-loss threshold.
    /// @param takeProfit Pre-calculated take-profit threshold.
    /// @param maxExposure Maximum exposure per trade.
    /// @param dailyLossLimit Maximum allowable loss per day.
    function setTradeSettings(
        uint256 stopLoss,
        uint256 takeProfit,
        uint256 maxExposure,
        uint256 dailyLossLimit
    ) external {
        tradeSettings[msg.sender] = TradeSettings({
            stopLoss: stopLoss,
            takeProfit: takeProfit,
            maxExposure: maxExposure,
            lastTradeTime: 0,
            dailyLoss: 0,
            dailyLossLimit: dailyLossLimit,
            lastTradeDay: block.timestamp / 1 days
        });
        emit TradeSettingsUpdated(msg.sender, stopLoss, takeProfit, maxExposure, dailyLossLimit);
    }

    /// @notice Execute a trade for the sender.
    /// @param tradeType 0 for Buy, 1 for Sell.
    /// @param amount The amount for the trade.
    /// @param stopLoss The stop-loss threshold.
    /// @param takeProfit The take-profit threshold.
    /// @param priceFeedKey The identifier for the Chainlink price feed.
    function executeTrade(
        TradeType tradeType,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 stopLoss,
        uint256 takeProfit,
        bytes32 priceFeedKey
    ) external tradingAllowed {
        _executeTrade(msg.sender, tradeType, amount, stopLoss, takeProfit, priceFeedKey);
    }

    /// @dev Helper function to fetch the current price from a Chainlink price feed.
    function _getCurrentPrice(bytes32 priceFeedKey) internal view returns (uint256) {
        AggregatorV3Interface feed = chainlinkFeeds[priceFeedKey];
        require(address(feed) != address(0), "Invalid price feed");
        (, int256 priceInt, , , ) = feed.latestRoundData();
        require(priceInt > 0, "Invalid price data");
        return uint256(priceInt);
    }

    /// @dev Internal pure function that encapsulates the market condition logic.
    function _checkMarketConditions(
        TradeType tradeType,
        uint256 currentPrice,
        uint256 stopLoss,
        uint256 takeProfit
    ) internal pure returns (bool) {
        if (currentPrice >= stopLoss) {
            if (tradeType == TradeType.Buy && currentPrice <= stopLoss + (stopLoss / 100)) {
                return true;
            } else if (tradeType == TradeType.Sell && currentPrice >= takeProfit - (takeProfit / 100)) {
                return true;
            }
        } else {
            if (tradeType == TradeType.Sell && currentPrice >= stopLoss - (stopLoss / 100)) {
                return true;
            } else if (tradeType == TradeType.Buy && currentPrice <= takeProfit + (takeProfit / 100)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    /// @dev Internal function that contains the core trade execution logic.
    function _executeTrade(
        address user,
        TradeType tradeType,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 stopLoss,
        uint256 takeProfit,
        bytes32 priceFeedKey
    ) internal {
        // Reference the user's trade settings.
        TradeSettings storage settings = tradeSettings[user];

        // Enforce time-based constraints.
        require(
            block.timestamp >= settings.lastTradeTime + tradeTimeout,
            "Trade timeout not met"
        );

        // Enforce maximum exposure limits.
        require(amount <= settings.maxExposure, "Exceeds max exposure");

        // Reset daily loss if a new day has started.
        uint256 currentDay = block.timestamp / 1 days;
        if (currentDay > settings.lastTradeDay) {
            settings.dailyLoss = 0;
            settings.lastTradeDay = currentDay;
        }
        require(settings.dailyLoss < settings.dailyLossLimit, "Daily loss limit reached");

        // Fetch the current market price.
        uint256 currentPrice = _getCurrentPrice(priceFeedKey);

        // Check market conditions using the separated logic.
        bool executeOrder = _checkMarketConditions(tradeType, currentPrice, stopLoss, takeProfit);
        require(executeOrder, "Market conditions not met");

        // Update the last trade time.
        settings.lastTradeTime = block.timestamp;

        // Simulate trade settlement.
        if (tradeType == TradeType.Buy) {
            require(balances[user] >= amount, "Insufficient balance for buy");
            balances[user] -= amount;
        } else {
            balances[user] += amount;
        }

        // Emit an event to log the trade.
        string memory tradeTypeStr = tradeType == TradeType.Buy ? "Buy" : "Sell";
        emit TradeExecuted(user, tradeTypeStr, amount, currentPrice, stopLoss, takeProfit);
    }

    /// @notice Batch processing of multiple trades (only callable by the owner).
    /// @dev This reduces transaction count by executing many trades in one call.
    function batchExecuteTrades(
        address[] calldata users,
        TradeType[] calldata tradeTypes,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata stopLosses,
        uint256[] calldata takeProfits,
        bytes32[] calldata priceFeedKeys
    ) external onlyOwner tradingAllowed {
        uint256 len = users.length;
        require(
            len == tradeTypes.length &&
            len == amounts.length &&
            len == stopLosses.length &&
            len == takeProfits.length &&
            len == priceFeedKeys.length,
            "Array length mismatch"
        );
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; ) {
            _executeTrade(
                users[i],
                tradeTypes[i],
                amounts[i],
                stopLosses[i],
                takeProfits[i],
                priceFeedKeys[i]
            );
            unchecked { i++; }
        }
    }

    /// @notice Set the graceful stop flag (halts new trades but allows ongoing ones to finish).
    function setGracefulStop(bool _gracefulStop) external onlyOwner {
        gracefulStopActive = _gracefulStop;
    }

    /// @notice Set the hard stop flag (immediately disables all trade-related calls).
    function setHardStop(bool _hardStop) external onlyOwner {
        hardStopActive = _hardStop;
        emit TradingHalted(_hardStop);
    }

    /// @notice Update a Chainlink price feed address.
    /// @param feedKey The identifier for the price feed.
    /// @param feedAddress The new Chainlink aggregator address.
    function updatePriceFeed(bytes32 feedKey, address feedAddress) external onlyOwner {
        chainlinkFeeds[feedKey] = AggregatorV3Interface(feedAddress);
    }

    // Allow the contract to receive ETH directly.
    receive() external payable {
        deposit();
    }
    fallback() external payable {
        deposit();
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract DonationPlatform {
    struct Campaign {
        uint256 id;
        string title;
        string description;
        uint256 goal;
        uint256 raised;
        address payable owner;
        bool isActive;
        address[] recipients; // Recipients for fund distribution
        uint256[] shares; // Share percentages for each recipient
    }

    struct Donor {
        address donorAddress;
        uint256 amount;
    }

    uint256 public campaignCount;
    mapping(uint256 => Campaign) public campaigns;
    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userCampaigns; // Campaigns created by a user
    mapping(uint256 => Donor[]) public campaignDonors; // Donors for a specific campaign
    mapping(address => uint256[]) public userDonations; // Campaigns a user has donated to

    event CampaignCreated(uint256 id, string title, string description, uint256 goal, address owner);
    event DonationMade(uint256 campaignId, address donor, uint256 amount);
    event FundsDistributed(uint256 campaignId, address[] recipients, uint256[] amounts);

    function createCampaign(
        string memory _title,
        string memory _description,
        uint256 _goal,
        address[] memory _recipients,
        uint256[] memory _shares
    ) public {
        require(_recipients.length == _shares.length, "Recipients and shares length mismatch");
        require(_recipients.length > 0, "At least one recipient required");

        campaignCount++;
        campaigns[campaignCount] = Campaign({
            id: campaignCount,
            title: _title,
            description: _description,
            goal: _goal,
            raised: 0,
            owner: payable(msg.sender),
            isActive: true,
            recipients: _recipients,
            shares: _shares
        });
        userCampaigns[msg.sender].push(campaignCount); // Track campaigns by user
        emit CampaignCreated(campaignCount, _title, _description, _goal, msg.sender);
    }

    function donate(uint256 _campaignId) public payable {
        require(_campaignId > 0 && _campaignId <= campaignCount, "Invalid campaign ID");
        Campaign storage campaign = campaigns[_campaignId];
        require(campaign.isActive, "Campaign is not active");

        campaign.raised += msg.value;
        (bool sent, ) = campaign.owner.call{value: msg.value}("");
        require(sent, "Failed to send Ether");

        // Track the donor and their contribution
        campaignDonors[_campaignId].push(Donor({
            donorAddress: msg.sender,
            amount: msg.value
        }));

        // Track the campaign the user donated to
        userDonations[msg.sender].push(_campaignId);

        emit DonationMade(_campaignId, msg.sender, msg.value);

        // Distribute funds if the goal is reached
        if (campaign.raised >= campaign.goal) {
            distributeFunds(_campaignId);
        }
    }

    function distributeFunds(uint256 _campaignId) internal {
        Campaign storage campaign = campaigns[_campaignId];
        require(campaign.raised >= campaign.goal, "Goal not reached");
        require(campaign.isActive, "Campaign is not active");

        uint256 totalRaised = campaign.raised;
        uint256 totalShares = 0;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < campaign.shares.length; i++) {
            totalShares += campaign.shares[i];
        }

        uint256[] memory amounts = new uint256[](campaign.recipients.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < campaign.recipients.length; i++) {
            amounts[i] = (totalRaised * campaign.shares[i]) / totalShares;
            (bool sent, ) = payable(campaign.recipients[i]).call{value: amounts[i]}("");
            require(sent, "Failed to send Ether");
        }

        campaign.isActive = false; // Mark the campaign as inactive
        emit FundsDistributed(_campaignId, campaign.recipients, amounts);
    }

    function getCampaign(uint256 _campaignId) public view returns (
        uint256 id,
        string memory title,
        string memory description,
        uint256 goal,
        uint256 raised,
        address owner,
        bool isActive,
        address[] memory recipients,
        uint256[] memory shares
    ) {
        Campaign memory campaign = campaigns[_campaignId];
        return (
            campaign.id,
            campaign.title,
            campaign.description,
            campaign.goal,
            campaign.raised,
            campaign.owner,
            campaign.isActive,
            campaign.recipients,
            campaign.shares
        );
    }

    function getAllCampaigns() public view returns (Campaign[] memory) {
        Campaign[] memory allCampaigns = new Campaign[](campaignCount);
        for (uint256 i = 1; i <= campaignCount; i++) {
            allCampaigns[i - 1] = campaigns[i];
        }
        return allCampaigns;
    }

    function getUserCampaigns(address _user) public view returns (Campaign[] memory) {
        uint256[] memory userCampaignIds = userCampaigns[_user];
        Campaign[] memory userCampaignsData = new Campaign[](userCampaignIds.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < userCampaignIds.length; i++) {
            userCampaignsData[i] = campaigns[userCampaignIds[i]];
        }
        return userCampaignsData;
    }

    // Get donors for a specific campaign
    function getCampaignDonors(uint256 _campaignId) public view returns (Donor[] memory) {
        return campaignDonors[_campaignId];
    }

    // Get campaigns a user has donated to
    function getUserDonations(address _user) public view returns (Campaign[] memory) {
        uint256[] memory donatedCampaignIds = userDonations[_user];
        Campaign[] memory donatedCampaigns = new Campaign[](donatedCampaignIds.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < donatedCampaignIds.length; i++) {
            donatedCampaigns[i] = campaigns[donatedCampaignIds[i]];
        }
        return donatedCampaigns;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

/// @title Интерфейс для функции swap (на основе предоставленного ABI)
interface ISwap {
    function swap(
        address recipient,
        bool zeroForOne,
        int256 amountSpecified,
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96,
        bytes calldata data
    ) external returns (int256 amount0, int256 amount1);
}

/// @dev Базовый контракт. Пока пустой, но может служить для наследования.
contract BaseContract { }

/// @title Контракт для выполнения двух свапов в одной транзакции
contract MultiSwap is BaseContract {
    // Адреса внешних контрактов
    address public constant SWAP_CONTRACT_1 = 0xFe4fe5B4575c036aC6D5cCcFe13660020270e27A;
    address public constant SWAP_CONTRACT_2 = 0x7f51c8AaA6B0599aBd16674e2b17FEc7a9f674A1;

    // Структура для параметров свапа
    struct SwapParams {
        address recipient;
        bool zeroForOne;
        int256 amountSpecified;
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96;
        bytes data;
    }

    /// @dev Конструктор. Необходим для предотвращения абстрактности контракта.
    constructor() {}

    /// @notice Выполняет два свапа подряд в одной транзакции.
    /// Если хотя бы один свап завершается неудачно, вся транзакция отменяется.
    /// @param swap1 Параметры для первого свапа.
    /// @param swap2 Параметры для второго свапа.
    function executeMultiSwap(SwapParams calldata swap1, SwapParams calldata swap2) external {
        // Первый свап через контракт SWAP_CONTRACT_1
        try ISwap(SWAP_CONTRACT_1).swap(
            swap1.recipient,
            swap1.zeroForOne,
            swap1.amountSpecified,
            swap1.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            swap1.data
        ) returns (int256, int256) {
            // Дополнительные проверки можно добавить при необходимости.
        } catch {
            revert("Swap 1 failed");
        }

        // Второй свап через контракт SWAP_CONTRACT_2
        try ISwap(SWAP_CONTRACT_2).swap(
            swap2.recipient,
            swap2.zeroForOne,
            swap2.amountSpecified,
            swap2.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            swap2.data
        ) returns (int256, int256) {
            // Дополнительные проверки можно добавить при необходимости.
        } catch {
            revert("Swap 2 failed");
        }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

/// @title Интерфейс для функции swap (на основе предоставленного ABI)
interface ISwap {
    function swap(
        address recipient,
        bool zeroForOne,
        int256 amountSpecified,
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96,
        bytes calldata data
    ) external returns (int256 amount0, int256 amount1);
}

/// @dev Базовый контракт. Пока пустой, но может служить для наследования.
contract BaseContract { }

/// @title Контракт для выполнения двух свапов в одной транзакции
contract MultiSwap is BaseContract {
    // Адреса внешних контрактов
    address public constant SWAP_CONTRACT_1 = 0xFe4fe5B4575c036aC6D5cCcFe13660020270e27A;
    address public constant SWAP_CONTRACT_2 = 0x7f51c8AaA6B0599aBd16674e2b17FEc7a9f674A1;

    // Структура для параметров свапа
    struct SwapParams {
        address recipient;
        bool zeroForOne;
        int256 amountSpecified;
        uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96;
        bytes data;
    }

    /// @dev Конструктор. Необходим для предотвращения абстрактности контракта.
    constructor() {}

    /// @notice Выполняет два свапа подряд в одной транзакции.
    /// Если хотя бы один свап завершается неудачно, вся транзакция отменяется.
    /// @param swap1 Параметры для первого свапа.
    /// @param swap2 Параметры для второго свапа.
    function executeMultiSwap(SwapParams calldata swap1, SwapParams calldata swap2) external {
        // Первый свап через контракт SWAP_CONTRACT_1
        try ISwap(SWAP_CONTRACT_1).swap(
            swap1.recipient,
            swap1.zeroForOne,
            swap1.amountSpecified,
            swap1.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            swap1.data
        ) returns (int256, int256) {
            // Дополнительные проверки можно добавить при необходимости.
        } catch {
            revert("Swap 1 failed");
        }

        // Второй свап через контракт SWAP_CONTRACT_2
        try ISwap(SWAP_CONTRACT_2).swap(
            swap2.recipient,
            swap2.zeroForOne,
            swap2.amountSpecified,
            swap2.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
            swap2.data
        ) returns (int256, int256) {
            // Дополнительные проверки можно добавить при необходимости.
        } catch {
            revert("Swap 2 failed");
        }
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma experimental ABIEncoderV2;
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract Verifier {
    uint256 constant chainId = 0;
    address constant verifyingContract = 0x1C56346CD2A2Bf3202F771f50d3D14a367B48070;
    bytes32 constant salt = 0xf2d857f4a3edcb9b78b4d503bfe733db1e3f6cdc2b7971ee739626c97e86a558;
    
    string private constant EIP712_DOMAIN  = "EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract,bytes32 salt)";
    string private constant IDENTITY_TYPE = "Identity(uint256 userId,address wallet)";
    string private constant BID_TYPE = "Bid(uint256 amount,Identity bidder)Identity(uint256 userId,address wallet)";
    
    bytes32 private constant EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(EIP712_DOMAIN));
    bytes32 private constant IDENTITY_TYPEHASH = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(IDENTITY_TYPE));
    bytes32 private constant BID_TYPEHASH = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(BID_TYPE));
    bytes32 private constant DOMAIN_SEPARATOR = keccak256(abi.encode(
        EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,
        keccak256("My amazing dApp"),
        keccak256("2"),
        chainId,
        verifyingContract,
        salt
    ));
    
    struct Identity {
        uint256 userId;
        address wallet;
    }
    
    struct Bid {
        uint256 amount;
        Identity bidder;
    }
    
    function hashIdentity(Identity memory identity) private pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encode(
            IDENTITY_TYPEHASH,
            identity.userId,
            identity.wallet
        ));
    }
    
    function hashBid(Bid memory bid) private pure returns (bytes32){
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(
            "\x19\x01",
            DOMAIN_SEPARATOR,
            keccak256(abi.encode(
                BID_TYPEHASH,
                bid.amount,
                hashIdentity(bid.bidder)
            ))
        ));
    }
    
    function verify() public pure returns (bool) {
        Identity memory bidder = Identity({
            userId: 323,
            wallet: 0x3333333333333333333333333333333333333333
        });
        
        Bid memory bid = Bid({
            amount: 100,
            bidder: bidder
        });
            
        bytes32 sigR = 0xcc2daffe7c0fb8eee06f7086382146043f41fb463556d521b175ed45d223b379;
        bytes32 sigS = 0x691b44572142a9ecbfec8f635cda8b98389d2c8d73e0d817a7f6307952a4b23b;
        uint8 sigV = 27;

        // NOTE: please convert the signer's address to its checksummed version 
        // in order to compile the code.
        //
        // You can use visit Etherscan and copy-paste the checksummed address
        // to do so.
        //
        // A checksummed address contains a mix of uppercase and lowercase
        // characters.
        //
        // https://etherscan.io/address/0x2f748712f4dc1047c391818048ddcd4bea32b6da
        address signer = 0x2f748712f4dc1047c391818048ddcd4bea32b6da;
    
        return signer == ecrecover(hashBid(bid), sigV, sigR, sigS);
    }
}

 // SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
pragma solidity ^0.8.13;

contract Creature {
    uint256 public lifePoints;
    address public aggro;

    constructor() payable {
        lifePoints = 1000;
    }

    function attack(uint256 _damage) external {
        if (aggro == address(0)) {
            aggro = msg.sender;
        }

        if (_isOffBalance() && aggro != msg.sender) {
            lifePoints -= _damage;
        } else {
            lifePoints -= 0;
        }
    }

    function loot() external {
        require(lifePoints == 0, "Creature is still alive!");
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance);
    }

    function _isOffBalance() private view returns (bool) {
        return tx.origin != msg.sender;
    }
}

```solidity
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

import "./interfaces/IProduct.sol";
import "./interfaces/IVendor.sol";
import "./RawProduct.sol";
import "./RawProductFactory.sol";

contract Product is IProduct {
    mapping(uint256 => address) public rawProductContracts;
    RawProductFactory public immutable factory;

    // Địa chỉ transfer khi vendor tiêu sản phẩm
    address public grave;
    // Contract vendor tương ứng
    IVendor private vendorContract;

    // Lưu thông tin raw product data theo ID raw product
    mapping(uint256 => RawProductData[]) public _rawProductDatas;
    // Lưu thông tin raw transaction data theo ID raw transaction
    mapping(uint256 => RawTransactionData[]) public _rawTransactionDatas;
    // Lưu thông tin product theo ID
    mapping(uint256 => Item) public _items;
    // Lưu thông tin transaction theo ID
    mapping(uint256 => Transaction) public _transactions;

    // Lưu: address của vendor => mảng raw product ID của vendor đó
    mapping(address => uint256[]) public _rawProductOwnership;
    // Lưu: product ID => raw product ID tạo nên product đó
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public _productRawProductIds;
    // Lưu: raw tx ID => product ID của tx đó
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) public _rawTransactionProductIds;

    // Lưu quyền sở hữu product
    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => bool)) public _productOwnership;
    // Lưu quyền transfer product của các operator
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) public _operatorApprovals;

    // Lưu danh sách transaction theo ID product
    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public _itemTransactions;
    // Lưu trữ document IDs cho mỗi raw product
    mapping(uint256 => uint256[]) public _rawProductDocuments;

    uint256 public _nextRawProductId = 1; // ID raw product kế tiếp
    uint256 public _nextProductId = 1; // ID product kế tiếp
    uint256 public _nextRawTransactionId = 1; // ID raw transaction kế tiếp
    uint256 public _nextTransactionId = 1; // ID transaction kế tiếp

    constructor(address _vendorContractAddress, address _grave, address _factoryContractAddress) {
        vendorContract = IVendor(_vendorContractAddress);
        factory = RawProductFactory(_factoryContractAddress);
        grave = _grave;
    }

    // Đăng ký raw product
    function registerRawProduct(
        RawProductData[] calldata rawProductDatas,
        uint256[] calldata documentIds
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(
            vendorContract.isVendorVerified(msg.sender),
            "Product: Only verified vendors can perform this action"
        );

        uint256 rawProductId = _nextRawProductId;
        _nextRawProductId++;

        require(
            _validateAndAddDocuments(msg.sender, rawProductId, documentIds),
            "Product: Document validation failed"
        );

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawProductDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(rawProductDatas[i]);
        }

        /////
        address rawProductAddress = factory.createRawProduct(
            address(this),
            rawProductId,
            msg.sender,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );
        
        rawProductContracts[rawProductId] = rawProductAddress;
        /////
        _rawProductOwnership[msg.sender].push(rawProductId);

        emit RawProductRegistered(
            msg.sender,
            rawProductId,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );

        return rawProductId;
    }

    // Cập nhật raw product
    function updateRawProduct(
        uint256 rawProductId,
        RawProductData[] calldata rawProductDatas,
        uint256[] calldata documentIds
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(
            _isOwnerOfRawProduct(msg.sender, rawProductId),
            "Product: Not the owner of this raw product"
        );

        require(
            _validateAndAddDocuments(msg.sender, rawProductId, documentIds),
            "Product: Document validation failed"
        );

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawProductDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(rawProductDatas[i]);
        }

        IRawProduct(rawProductContracts[rawProductId]).approveAction(
            msg.sender,
            "UPDATE_RAW",
            rawProductId
        );

        emit RawProductUpdated(
            msg.sender,
            rawProductId,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );

        return true;
    }

    // Phát hành raw product
    function releaseProduct(
        uint256 rawProductId,
        string calldata _title,
        string calldata _s3Url,
        string calldata _hash
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(
            _isOwnerOfRawProduct(msg.sender, rawProductId),
            "Product: Not the owner of this raw product"
        );

        uint256 productId = _nextProductId;
        _nextProductId++;

        _items[productId] = Item({
            id: productId,
            title: _title,
            producer: msg.sender,
            currentOwner: msg.sender,
            lastOwner: address(0),
            s3Url: _s3Url,
            hash: _hash
        });

        _productOwnership[msg.sender][productId] = true;
        _productRawProductIds[productId] = rawProductId;

        string memory productIdStr = _uintToString(productId);
        RawProductData memory releaseData = RawProductData({
            dataType: RawMetadataType.Release,
            data: productIdStr,
            s3Url: "",
            hash: ""
        });
        _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(releaseData);

        emit ProductReleased(msg.sender, productId, rawProductId);

        return productId;
    }

    // Đăng ký raw transaction
    function registerRawTransaction(
        uint256 productId,
        RawTransactionData[] calldata rawTransactionDatas
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(
            _productOwnership[msg.sender][productId],
            "Product: Only the owner can register raw transaction"
        );
        uint256 rawTxId = _nextRawTransactionId;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawTransactionDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawTransactionDatas[rawTxId].push(rawTransactionDatas[i]);
        }

        _rawTransactionProductIds[rawTxId] = productId;
        _nextRawTransactionId++;

        emit RawTransactionRegistered(
            rawTxId,
            productId,
            msg.sender,
            rawTransactionDatas
        );

        return rawTxId;
    }

    // Cập nhật raw transaction
    function updateRawTransaction(
        uint256 rawTxId,
        RawTransactionData[] calldata rawTransactionDatas
    ) external returns (bool) {
        uint256 productId = _rawTransactionProductIds[rawTxId];
        require(
            _productOwnership[msg.sender][productId],
            "Product: Only the owner can update raw transaction"
        );

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawTransactionDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawTransactionDatas[rawTxId].push(rawTransactionDatas[i]);
        }

        emit RawTransactionUpdated(rawTxId, msg.sender, rawTransactionDatas);

        return true;
    }

    // Chuyển nhượng sản phẩm
    function transferFromProduct(
        address _from,
        address _to,
        uint256 rawTxOrProductId,
        string calldata _s3Url,
        string calldata _hash,
        bool isDirect
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(_from != _to, "Product: Cannot transfer to self");
        require(_to != address(0), "Product: Cannot transfer to null address");

        uint256 _rawTxId;
        uint256 _productId;
        if (isDirect) {
            _rawTxId = 0;
            _productId = rawTxOrProductId;
        } else {
            _rawTxId = rawTxOrProductId;
            _productId = _rawTransactionProductIds[rawTxOrProductId];
        }
        require(
            _checkOwnerOrApproved(_from, _productId),
            "Product: Only owner or approved can access this function"
        );

        _productOwnership[_from][_productId] = false;
        _productOwnership[_to][_productId] = true;
        _items[_productId].lastOwner = _items[_productId].currentOwner;
        _items[_productId].currentOwner = _to;

        _transactions[_nextTransactionId] = Transaction({
            txId: _nextTransactionId,
            from: _from,
            to: _to,
            rawTxId: _rawTxId,
            productId: _productId,
            s3Url: _s3Url,
            hash: _hash
        });

        _itemTransactions[_productId].push(_nextTransactionId);
        _nextTransactionId++;

        emit ProductTransferred(_from, _to, _productId);

        return true;
    }

    // Tiêu sản phẩm
    function burnProduct(uint256 _productId) external returns (bool) {
        require(
            _productOwnership[msg.sender][_productId],
            "Product: Only the owner can burn the product"
        );

        _productOwnership[msg.sender][_productId] = false;
        _productOwnership[grave][_productId] = true;
        _items[_productId].lastOwner = _items[_productId].currentOwner;
        _items[_productId].currentOwner = grave;

        _transactions[_nextTransactionId] = Transaction({
            txId: _nextTransactionId,
            from: _items[_productId].lastOwner,
            to: _items[_productId].currentOwner,
            rawTxId: 0,
            productId: _productId,
            s3Url: "",
            hash: ""
        });

        _itemTransactions[_productId].push(_nextTransactionId);
        _nextTransactionId++;
        emit ProductTransferred(msg.sender, grave, _productId);

        return true;
    }

    // Lấy thông tin chi tiết raw product theo id
    function getRawProduct(
        uint256 rawProductId
    ) external view returns (RawProduct memory) {
        require(
            _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].length > 0,
            "Product: Raw product does not exist"
        );

        address[] memory vendorAddresses = vendorContract
            .getAllVendorAddresses();
        address owner;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < vendorAddresses.length; i++) {
            if (_isOwnerOfRawProduct(vendorAddresses[i], rawProductId)) {
                owner = vendorAddresses[i];
                break;
            }
        }

        return
            RawProduct({
                datas: _rawProductDatas[rawProductId],
                documentIds: _rawProductDocuments[rawProductId],
                owner: owner
            });
    }

    // Lấy thông tin chi tiết product theo id
    function getProduct(
        uint256 productId
    ) external view returns (ProductInfo memory) {
        require(_items[productId].id != 0, "Product: Product does not exist");

        uint256 rawProductId = _productRawProductIds[productId];

        return
            ProductInfo({
                item: _items[productId],
                rawProductId: rawProductId,
                rawProduct: this.getRawProduct(rawProductId),
                transactionIds: _itemTransactions[productId]
            });
    }

    // Kiểm tra và thêm mới tư liệu sản xuất
    function _validateAndAddDocuments(
        address vendor,
        uint256 rawProductId,
        uint256[] calldata newDocumentIds
    ) internal returns (bool) {
        uint256[] memory existingDocs = _rawProductDocuments[rawProductId];

        for (uint i = 0; i < newDocumentIds.length; i++) {
            require(
                _isVendorDocument(vendor, newDocumentIds[i]),
                "Product: Document ID does not belong to vendor"
            );

            for (uint j = 0; j < existingDocs.length; j++) {
                require(
                    existingDocs[j] != newDocumentIds[i],
                    "Product: Document ID already linked to this raw product"
                );
            }
            _rawProductDocuments[rawProductId].push(newDocumentIds[i]);
        }

        return true;
    }

    // Kiểm tra tư liệu sản xuất thuộc về vendor
    function _isVendorDocument(
        address vendor,
        uint256 documentId
    ) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256[] memory vendorDocs = vendorContract.getVendorDocumentIds(
            vendor
        );
        for (uint i = 0; i < vendorDocs.length; i++) {
            if (vendorDocs[i] == documentId) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // Cập nhật quyền transfer product
    function setApprovalForAll(
        address _operator,
        bool _approved
    ) external virtual returns (bool) {
        require(
            msg.sender != _operator,
            "Product: Cannot set approval for self"
        );
        require(
            _operator != address(0),
            "Product: Cannot set approval for null address"
        );
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][_operator] = _approved;
        return true;
    }

    // Kiểm tra quyền transfer product
    function isApprovedForAll(
        address _owner,
        address _operator
    ) external view virtual returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[_owner][_operator];
    }

    // Kiểm tra quyền sở hữu raw product
    function _isOwnerOfRawProduct(
        address owner,
        uint256 rawProductId
    ) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256[] memory ownedRawProducts = _rawProductOwnership[owner];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ownedRawProducts.length; i++) {
            if (ownedRawProducts[i] == rawProductId) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    // Kiểm tra quyền transfer product
    function _checkOwnerOrApproved(
        address _from,
        uint256 _productId
    ) internal view returns (bool) {
        bool _from_the_product_owner = _productOwnership[_from][_productId];
        bool _approved_or_product_owner = this.isApprovedForAll(
            _from,
            msg.sender
        ) || msg.sender == _from;
        return _from_the_product_owner && _approved_or_product_owner;
    }

    // Chuyển từ uint sang string
    function _uintToString(
        uint256 value
    ) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}
```

```solidity
contract Product is IProduct {
    mapping(uint256 => address) public rawProductContracts;

    // Địa chỉ transfer khi vendor tiêu sản phẩm
    address public grave;
    // Contract vendor tương ứng
    IVendor private vendorContract;

    // Lưu thông tin raw product data theo ID raw product

    // Lưu thông tin raw transaction data theo ID raw transaction

    // Lưu thông tin product theo ID

    uint256 public _nextProductId = 1; // ID product kế tiếp
    uint256 public _nextRawTransactionId = 1; // ID raw transaction kế tiếp
    uint256 public _nextTransactionId = 1; // ID transaction kế tiếp

    constructor(address _vendorContractAddress, address _grave, address _factoryContractAddress) {
        vendorContract = IVendor(_vendorContractAddress);
        factory = RawProductFactory(_factoryContractAddress);
        grave = _grave;
    }

    // Đăng ký raw product
    function registerRawProduct(
        RawProductData[] calldata rawProductDatas,
        uint256[] calldata documentIds
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(
            vendorContract.isVendorVerified(msg.sender),
            "Product: Only verified vendors can perform this action"
        );

        uint256 rawProductId = _nextRawProductId;
        _nextRawProductId++;

        require(
            _validateAndAddDocuments(msg.sender, rawProductId, documentIds),
            "Product: Document validation failed"
        );

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawProductDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(rawProductDatas[i]);
        }

        /////
        address rawProductAddress = factory.createRawProduct(
            address(this),
            rawProductId,
            msg.sender,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );
        
        rawProductContracts[rawProductId] = rawProductAddress;
        /////
        _rawProductOwnership[msg.sender].push(rawProductId);

        emit RawProductRegistered(
            msg.sender,
            rawProductId,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );

        return rawProductId;
    }

    // Cập nhật raw product
    function updateRawProduct(
        uint256 rawProductId,
        RawProductData[] calldata rawProductDatas,
        uint256[] calldata documentIds
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(
            _isOwnerOfRawProduct(msg.sender, rawProductId),
            "Product: Not the owner of this raw product"
        );

        require(
            _validateAndAddDocuments(msg.sender, rawProductId, documentIds),
            "Product: Document validation failed"
        );

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawProductDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(rawProductDatas[i]);
        }

        IRawProduct(rawProductContracts[rawProductId]).approveAction(
            msg.sender,
            "UPDATE_RAW",
            rawProductId
        );

        emit RawProductUpdated(
            msg.sender,
            rawProductId,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );

        return true;
    }

        uint256 rawProductId,
        string calldata _title,
        string calldata _s3Url,
        string calldata _hash
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(
            _isOwnerOfRawProduct(msg.sender, rawProductId),
            "Product: Not the owner of this raw product"
        );

        uint256 productId = _nextProductId;
        _nextProductId++;

        _items[productId] = Item({
            id: productId,
            title: _title,
            producer: msg.sender,
            currentOwner: msg.sender,
            lastOwner: address(0),
            s3Url: _s3Url,
            hash: _hash
        });

        _productOwnership[msg.sender][productId] = true;
        _productRawProductIds[productId] = rawProductId;

        string memory productIdStr = _uintToString(productId);
        RawProductData memory releaseData = RawProductData({
            dataType: RawMetadataType.Release,
            data: productIdStr,
            s3Url: "",
            hash: ""
        });
        _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(releaseData);

        emit ProductReleased(msg.sender, productId, rawProductId);

        return productId;
    }
```
