            "Product: Not the owner of this raw product"
        );

        uint256 productId = _nextProductId;
        _nextProductId++;

        _items[productId] = Item({
            id: productId,
            title: _title,
            producer: msg.sender,
            currentOwner: msg.sender,
            lastOwner: address(0),
            s3Url: _s3Url,
            hash: _hash
        });

        _productOwnership[msg.sender][productId] = true;
        _productRawProductIds[productId] = rawProductId;

        string memory productIdStr = _uintToString(productId);
        RawProductData memory releaseData = RawProductData({
            dataType: RawMetadataType.Release,
            data: productIdStr,
            s3Url: "",
            hash: ""
        });
        _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(releaseData);

        emit ProductReleased(msg.sender, productId, rawProductId);

        return productId;
    }

    // Đăng ký raw transaction
    function registerRawTransaction(
        uint256 productId,
        RawTransactionData[] calldata rawTransactionDatas
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(
            _productOwnership[msg.sender][productId],
            "Product: Only the owner can register raw transaction"
        );
        uint256 rawTxId = _nextRawTransactionId;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawTransactionDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawTransactionDatas[rawTxId].push(rawTransactionDatas[i]);
        }

        _rawTransactionProductIds[rawTxId] = productId;
        _nextRawTransactionId++;

        emit RawTransactionRegistered(
            rawTxId,
            productId,
            msg.sender,
            rawTransactionDatas
        );

        return rawTxId;
    }

    // Cập nhật raw transaction
    function updateRawTransaction(
        uint256 rawTxId,
        RawTransactionData[] calldata rawTransactionDatas
    ) external returns (bool) {
        uint256 productId = _rawTransactionProductIds[rawTxId];
        require(
            _productOwnership[msg.sender][productId],
            "Product: Only the owner can update raw transaction"
        );

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawTransactionDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawTransactionDatas[rawTxId].push(rawTransactionDatas[i]);
        }

        emit RawTransactionUpdated(rawTxId, msg.sender, rawTransactionDatas);

        return true;
    }

    // Chuyển nhượng sản phẩm
    function transferFromProduct(
        address _from,
        address _to,
        uint256 rawTxOrProductId,
        string calldata _s3Url,
        string calldata _hash,
        bool isDirect
    ) external returns (bool) {
        require(_from != _to, "Product: Cannot transfer to self");
        require(_to != address(0), "Product: Cannot transfer to null address");

        uint256 _rawTxId;
        uint256 _productId;
        if (isDirect) {
            _rawTxId = 0;
            _productId = rawTxOrProductId;
        } else {
            _rawTxId = rawTxOrProductId;
            _productId = _rawTransactionProductIds[rawTxOrProductId];
        }
        require(
            _checkOwnerOrApproved(_from, _productId),
            "Product: Only owner or approved can access this function"
        );

        _productOwnership[_from][_productId] = false;
        _productOwnership[_to][_productId] = true;
        _items[_productId].lastOwner = _items[_productId].currentOwner;
        _items[_productId].currentOwner = _to;

        _transactions[_nextTransactionId] = Transaction({
            txId: _nextTransactionId,
            from: _from,
            to: _to,
            rawTxId: _rawTxId,
            productId: _productId,
            s3Url: _s3Url,
            hash: _hash
        });

        _itemTransactions[_productId].push(_nextTransactionId);
        _nextTransactionId++;

        emit ProductTransferred(_from, _to, _productId);

        return true;
    }

    // Tiêu sản phẩm
    function burnProduct(uint256 _productId) external returns (bool) {
        require(
            _productOwnership[msg.sender][_productId],
            "Product: Only the owner can burn the product"
        );

        _productOwnership[msg.sender][_productId] = false;
        _productOwnership[grave][_productId] = true;
        _items[_productId].lastOwner = _items[_productId].currentOwner;
        _items[_productId].currentOwner = grave;

        _transactions[_nextTransactionId] = Transaction({
            txId: _nextTransactionId,
            from: _items[_productId].lastOwner,
            to: _items[_productId].currentOwner,
            rawTxId: 0,
            productId: _productId,
            s3Url: "",
            hash: ""
        });

        _itemTransactions[_productId].push(_nextTransactionId);
        _nextTransactionId++;
        emit ProductTransferred(msg.sender, grave, _productId);

        return true;
    }

    // Lấy thông tin chi tiết raw product theo id
    function getRawProduct(
        uint256 rawProductId
    ) external view returns (RawProduct memory) {
        require(
            _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].length > 0,
            "Product: Raw product does not exist"
        );

        address[] memory vendorAddresses = vendorContract
            .getAllVendorAddresses();
        address owner;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < vendorAddresses.length; i++) {
            if (_isOwnerOfRawProduct(vendorAddresses[i], rawProductId)) {
                owner = vendorAddresses[i];
                break;
            }
        }

        return
            RawProduct({
                datas: _rawProductDatas[rawProductId],
                documentIds: _rawProductDocuments[rawProductId],
                owner: owner
            });
    }

    // Lấy thông tin chi tiết product theo id
    function getProduct(
        uint256 productId
    ) external view returns (ProductInfo memory) {
        require(_items[productId].id != 0, "Product: Product does not exist");

        uint256 rawProductId = _productRawProductIds[productId];

        return
            ProductInfo({
                item: _items[productId],
                rawProductId: rawProductId,
                rawProduct: this.getRawProduct(rawProductId),
                transactionIds: _itemTransactions[productId]
            });
    }

    // Kiểm tra và thêm mới tư liệu sản xuất
    function _validateAndAddDocuments(
        address vendor,
        uint256 rawProductId,
        uint256[] calldata newDocumentIds
    ) internal returns (bool) {
        uint256[] memory existingDocs = _rawProductDocuments[rawProductId];

        for (uint i = 0; i < newDocumentIds.length; i++) {
            require(
                _isVendorDocument(vendor, newDocumentIds[i]),
                "Product: Document ID does not belong to vendor"
            );

            for (uint j = 0; j < existingDocs.length; j++) {
                require(
                    existingDocs[j] != newDocumentIds[i],
                    "Product: Document ID already linked to this raw product"
                );
            }
            _rawProductDocuments[rawProductId].push(newDocumentIds[i]);
        }

        return true;
    }

    // Kiểm tra tư liệu sản xuất thuộc về vendor
    function _isVendorDocument(
        address vendor,
        uint256 documentId
    ) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256[] memory vendorDocs = vendorContract.getVendorDocumentIds(
            vendor
        );
        for (uint i = 0; i < vendorDocs.length; i++) {
            if (vendorDocs[i] == documentId) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // Cập nhật quyền transfer product
    function setApprovalForAll(
        address _operator,
        bool _approved
    ) external virtual returns (bool) {
        require(
            msg.sender != _operator,
            "Product: Cannot set approval for self"
        );
        require(
            _operator != address(0),
            "Product: Cannot set approval for null address"
        );
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][_operator] = _approved;
        return true;
    }

    // Kiểm tra quyền transfer product
    function isApprovedForAll(
        address _owner,
        address _operator
    ) external view virtual returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[_owner][_operator];
    }

    // Kiểm tra quyền sở hữu raw product
    function _isOwnerOfRawProduct(
        address owner,
        uint256 rawProductId
    ) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256[] memory ownedRawProducts = _rawProductOwnership[owner];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < ownedRawProducts.length; i++) {
            if (ownedRawProducts[i] == rawProductId) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    // Kiểm tra quyền transfer product
    function _checkOwnerOrApproved(
        address _from,
        uint256 _productId
    ) internal view returns (bool) {
        bool _from_the_product_owner = _productOwnership[_from][_productId];
        bool _approved_or_product_owner = this.isApprovedForAll(
            _from,
            msg.sender
        ) || msg.sender == _from;
        return _from_the_product_owner && _approved_or_product_owner;
    }

    // Chuyển từ uint sang string
    function _uintToString(
        uint256 value
    ) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        while (value != 0) {
            digits -= 1;
            buffer[digits] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(value % 10)));
            value /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
}

    uint256 public _nextTransactionId = 1; // ID transaction kế tiếp

        RawProductData[] calldata rawProductDatas,
        uint256[] calldata documentIds
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        require(
            vendorContract.isVendorVerified(msg.sender),
            "Product: Only verified vendors can perform this action"
        );

        uint256 rawProductId = _nextRawProductId;
        _nextRawProductId++;

        require(
            _validateAndAddDocuments(msg.sender, rawProductId, documentIds),
            "Product: Document validation failed"
        );

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawProductDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(rawProductDatas[i]);
        }

        /////
        address rawProductAddress = factory.createRawProduct(
            address(this),
            rawProductId,
            msg.sender,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );
        
        rawProductContracts[rawProductId] = rawProductAddress;
        /////
        _rawProductOwnership[msg.sender].push(rawProductId);

        emit RawProductRegistered(
            msg.sender,
            rawProductId,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );

        return rawProductId;
    }

        uint256 rawProductId,

        uint256[] calldata documentIds

        );

            _validateAndAddDocuments(msg.sender, rawProductId, documentIds),
            "Product: Document validation failed"
        );

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < rawProductDatas.length; i++) {
            _rawProductDatas[rawProductId].push(rawProductDatas[i]);
        }

        IRawProduct(rawProductContracts[rawProductId]).approveAction(
            msg.sender,
            "UPDATE_RAW",
            rawProductId
        );

        emit RawProductUpdated(
            msg.sender,
            rawProductId,
            rawProductDatas,
            documentIds
        );

        return true;
    }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract EthereumCoin {

    string public name = "ETH";
    string public symbol = "ETH";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;

    // Total supply is not applicable for ETH, as it's the native currency.
    // We'll just return a hardcoded value for the sake of consistency.
    uint256 public totalSupply = 0;

    // Check balance of ETH in the contract
    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return account.balance;
    }

    // Transfer ETH from contract to recipient address
    function transfer(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Insufficient contract balance");
        recipient.transfer(amount);
        return true;
    }

    // Transfer ETH from a sender to a recipient
    function transferFrom(address payable sender, address payable recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(sender.balance >= amount, "Insufficient sender balance");
        recipient.transfer(amount);
        return true;
    }

    // Get the price of ETH (hardcoded for now, you can change this logic)
    function getETHPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        return 2720 * (10 ** decimals);  // This is just a placeholder for now.
    }

    // Return the logo URI of the token (ETH in this case)
    function logoURI() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return "https://cryptologos.cc/logos/ethereum-eth-logo.png"; 
    }

    // Fallback function to receive Ether (ETH) into the contract
    receive() external payable {
        // This function allows the contract to accept ETH
    }
    
    // Function to withdraw Ether from the contract to the owner (if needed)
    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount);
    }
}

lo siento, este es el codigo completo:    // SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract MyToken is ERC20, Ownable {
    address public immutable creatorAddress;
    uint256 public constant COMMISSION_PERCENTAGE = 3;

    event TokensDonated(address indexed donor, uint256 amount, string reason);
    event CommissionPaid(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount);

    constructor() ERC20("EC DIGITAL SUCRE", "ECDS") Ownable() {
        creatorAddress = msg.sender;
        _mint(msg.sender, 5930000000 * 18 ** decimals());
    }

    function donateToCreator(uint256 amount, string memory reason) public {
        require(amount > 0, "The amount to donate must be greater than 0");
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient balance to donate");
        _transfer(msg.sender, creatorAddress, amount);
        emit TokensDonated(msg.sender, amount, reason);
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        require(amount > 0, "The amount to transfer must be greater than 0");
        require(recipient != address(0), "Cannot transfer to the zero address");
        uint256 commission = (amount * COMMISSION_PERCENTAGE) / 100;
        uint256 netAmount = amount - commission;
        _transfer(msg.sender, creatorAddress, commission);
        emit CommissionPaid(msg.sender, creatorAddress, commission);
        _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, netAmount);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        require(amount > 0, "The amount to transfer must be greater than 0");
        require(recipient != address(0), "Cannot transfer to the zero address");
        uint256 commission = (amount * COMMISSION_PERCENTAGE) / 100;
        uint256 netAmount = amount - commission;
        _transfer(sender, creatorAddress, commission);
        emit CommissionPaid(sender, creatorAddress, commission);
        _transfer(sender, recipient, netAmount);
        uint256 currentAllowance = allowance(sender, msg.sender);
        require(currentAllowance >= amount, "Transfer exceeds allowance");
        _approve(sender, msg.sender, currentAllowance - amount);
        return true;
    }
}

 // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/SafeMath.sol";

contract NovaPro is ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeMath for uint256; // Using SafeMath for uint256 operations

    address public owner;
    uint256 public leadersPool; // Total pool for leaders

    enum Rank { Unranked, Silver, Gold, Diamond } // Define leader ranks

    // Sub-struct to manage income details
    struct Income {
        uint256 x3Income;
        uint256 x4Income;
        uint256 renewalIncome;
        uint256 totalEarnings;
        uint256 leaderBonus;
    }

    // Sub-struct to manage subscription and referral details
    struct Subscription {
        uint256 subscriptionEnd; // Timestamp when the subscription ends
        uint8 currentPlan; // ID of the current subscription plan
        bool hasSubscribed; // Tracks if the user has subscribed at least once
        uint256 directReferrals; // Number of direct referrals
        uint256 directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth; // Track subscriptions by direct referrals this month
        uint256 lastSubscriptionReset; // Timestamp of the last monthly reset
    }

    // Main User struct using sub-structs to manage complexity
    struct User {
        bool isRegistered;
        address referrer;
        address[] x3Slots; // x3 plan slots (3 slots for direct referrals)
        address[] x4FirstLevel; // Level 1 (2 slots for x4 plan)
        address[] x4SecondLevel; // Level 2 (4 slots for x4 plan)
        bool isLeader; // Indicates if the user is promoted to leader status
        mapping(uint8 => bool) subscribedPlans; // Track unique plans the user has subscribed to
        Rank rank; // Current rank of the leader (Silver, Gold, Diamond)
        uint256 directLeaders; // Count of direct leaders under this user
        Income income; // Sub-struct to track income details
        Subscription subscription; // Sub-struct to track subscription details
    }

    struct Plan {
        uint8 id;
        string name;
        uint256 price;
        uint256 duration; // Duration in seconds
    }

    struct UserInfo {
        bool isRegistered;
        uint256 x3Income;
        uint256 x4Income;
        uint256 renewalIncome;
        uint256 totalEarnings;
        address referrer;
        uint256 subscriptionEnd;
        uint8 currentPlan;
        bool hasSubscribed;
        bool isLeader;
        uint256 directReferrals;
        uint256 directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth;
        uint256 lastSubscriptionReset;
        uint256 leaderBonus;
        Rank rank;
        uint256 directLeaders;
    }

    mapping(address => User) public users;
    mapping(uint256 => address) public userIds;
    mapping(uint8 => Plan) public plans; // Mapping of plan IDs to plan details
    mapping(address => address[]) private directReferrals; // Mapping to track direct referrals
    uint256 public userCount;
    uint8 public planCount;

    // Mappings to track leaders for each rank
    mapping(address => bool) public isSilverLeader;
    mapping(address => bool) public isGoldLeader;
    mapping(address => bool) public isDiamondLeader;

    event Registration(address indexed user, address indexed referrer);
    event Subscription(address indexed user, uint256 amount, uint8 planId);
    event Renewal(address indexed user, uint256 amount, uint8 planId);
    event CommissionEarned(address indexed user, uint256 amount, string plan);
    event PlanAdded(uint8 planId, string name, uint256 price, uint256 duration);
    event LeaderPromoted(address indexed user, Rank newRank);
    event LeaderBonusPaid(address indexed user, uint256 amount);
    event AdminChargeDeducted(uint256 adminAmount, uint256 poolAmount);
    event RankUpdated(address indexed user, Rank newRank);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Only owner can perform this action");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        userCount = 0;
        planCount = 0;
        leadersPool = 0; // Initialize the leaders' pool

        // Register the contract deployer as the first user
        User storage user = users[owner];
        user.isRegistered = true;
        user.subscription.hasSubscribed = true; // Owner is set as subscribed by default
        user.rank = Rank.Unranked;

        userIds[userCount] = owner;
    }

    // Function to add a new subscription plan
    function addPlan(string memory name, uint256 price, uint256 duration) external onlyOwner {
        require(price > 0, "Plan price must be greater than zero");
        require(duration > 0, "Plan duration must be greater than zero");

        planCount++; // Incrementing the uint8 directly
        plans[planCount] = Plan({
            id: planCount,
            name: name,
            price: price,
            duration: duration
        });

        emit PlanAdded(planCount, name, price, duration);
    }

    function register(address referrer) external {
        require(msg.sender != address(0), "Invalid user address");
        require(referrer != address(0), "Invalid referrer address");
        require(!users[msg.sender].isRegistered, "User already registered");
        require(users[referrer].isRegistered, "Referrer not registered");

        User storage newUser = users[msg.sender];
        newUser.isRegistered = true;
        newUser.referrer = referrer;

        // Add the new user to the referrer's direct referrals list
        directReferrals[referrer].push(msg.sender);

        // Increase direct referrals count for the referrer
        users[referrer].subscription.directReferrals = users[referrer].subscription.directReferrals.add(1);

        userCount = userCount.add(1);
        userIds[userCount] = msg.sender;

        // Check for leadership promotion on registration
        _checkAndPromoteToLeader(referrer);

        emit Registration(msg.sender, referrer);
    }

    // Actual implementation of the getDirectReferrals function
    function getDirectReferrals(address user) internal view returns (address[] memory) {
        return directReferrals[user];
    }

    // Function to subscribe to a plan for the first time
    function subscribe(uint8 planId) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(users[msg.sender].isRegistered, "User not registered");
        require(planId > 0 && planId <= planCount, "Invalid plan ID");
        require(msg.value == plans[planId].price, "Incorrect subscription amount");
        require(!users[msg.sender].subscription.hasSubscribed, "User has already subscribed; use renewal");
        require(block.timestamp <= users[msg.sender].subscription.subscriptionEnd, "Cannot subscribe to an expired plan");

        User storage user = users[msg.sender];
        _initializeSubscription(user, planId);

        // Split the subscription value into x3 and x4 plans
        uint256 halfValue = _distributeAdminCharges(msg.value);
        _distributeX3(msg.sender, halfValue);
        _distributeX4(msg.sender, halfValue);

        // Track direct referral subscriptions for the referrer
        users[user.referrer].subscription.directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth = users[user.referrer].subscription.directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth.add(1);

        // Check for leadership promotion on subscription
        _checkAndPromoteToLeader(msg.sender);

        // Update the leader's rank
        _updateLeaderRank(msg.sender);

        emit Subscription(msg.sender, msg.value, planId);
    }

    // Initialize subscription for a user
    function _initializeSubscription(User storage user, uint8 planId) internal {
        user.subscription.subscriptionEnd = block.timestamp.add(plans[planId].duration);
        user.subscription.currentPlan = planId;
        user.subscription.hasSubscribed = true; // Mark the user as having subscribed at least once
        user.subscribedPlans[planId] = true; // Track this plan subscription
        user.income.totalEarnings = user.income.totalEarnings.add(plans[planId].price);
    }

    // Handle admin charges and return distributable amount
    function _distributeAdminCharges(uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {
        uint256 adminCharge = amount.mul(20).div(100);
        uint256 adminAmount = adminCharge.div(2);
        uint256 poolAmount = adminCharge.sub(adminAmount);

        // Send 10% to admin and 10% to the leaders' pool
        payable(owner).transfer(adminAmount);
        leadersPool = leadersPool.add(poolAmount);
        emit AdminChargeDeducted(adminAmount, poolAmount);

        return amount.sub(adminCharge);
    }

    // Function to renew an existing subscription
    function renewSubscription(uint8 planId) external payable nonReentrant {
        require(users[msg.sender].isRegistered, "User not registered");
        require(users[msg.sender].subscription.hasSubscribed, "User has not subscribed yet");
        require(planId > 0 && planId <= planCount, "Invalid plan ID");
        require(msg.value == plans[planId].price, "Incorrect renewal amount");

        User storage user = users[msg.sender];
        _extendSubscription(user, planId);

        // Distribute charges and renewal commissions
        uint256 renewalShare = _distributeAdminCharges(msg.value) / 2;
        _distributeRenewalCommission(msg.sender, renewalShare);

        // Track direct referral subscriptions for the referrer
        users[user.referrer].subscription.directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth = users[user.referrer].subscription.directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth.add(1);

        // Check for leadership promotion on renewal
        _checkAndPromoteToLeader(msg.sender);

        // Update the leader's rank
        _updateLeaderRank(msg.sender);

        emit Renewal(msg.sender, msg.value, planId);
    }

    // Extend subscription for a user
    function _extendSubscription(User storage user, uint8 planId) internal {
        if (block.timestamp < user.subscription.subscriptionEnd) {
            user.subscription.subscriptionEnd = user.subscription.subscriptionEnd.add(plans[planId].duration);
        } else {
            user.subscription.subscriptionEnd = block.timestamp.add(plans[planId].duration);
        }
        user.subscription.currentPlan = planId;
        user.subscribedPlans[planId] = true; // Track this plan subscription
        user.income.totalEarnings = user.income.totalEarnings.add(plans[planId].price);
    }

    // Distribute renewal commissions to 10 levels of upliners
    function _distributeRenewalCommission(address user, uint256 amount) internal nonReentrant {
        address currentReferrer = users[user].referrer;

        for (uint8 level = 1; level <= 10; level++) {
            if (currentReferrer == address(0) || !users[currentReferrer].isRegistered) {
                break;
            }

            uint256 share = amount / 10; // Distribute evenly across 10 levels
            users[currentReferrer].income.renewalIncome = users[currentReferrer].income.renewalIncome.add(share);
            users[currentReferrer].income.totalEarnings = users[currentReferrer].income.totalEarnings.add(share); // Track total earnings for promotion
            payable(currentReferrer).transfer(share);
            emit CommissionEarned(currentReferrer, share, "Renewal");

            _checkAndPromoteToLeader(currentReferrer); // Check promotion on commission earned

            currentReferrer = users[currentReferrer].referrer;
        }
    }

    // Function to distribute X3 commissions
    function _distributeX3(address user, uint256 amount) internal {
        // Find the nearest eligible referrer with an active plan
        address eligibleReferrer = _findEligibleReferrer(users[user].referrer);

        // Add user to the x3 slots of the eligible referrer
        if (users[eligibleReferrer].x3Slots.length < 3) {
            users[eligibleReferrer].x3Slots.push(user);
            _payX3Commission(eligibleReferrer, amount);
        } else {
            // Handle overflow if slots are full
            address overflowReferrer = _findEligibleReferrer(users[eligibleReferrer].referrer);
            _handleX3Overflow(user, overflowReferrer, amount);
        }
    }

    // Handle X3 overflow
    function _handleX3Overflow(address user, address overflowReferrer, uint256 amount) internal {
        // Place the user in the overflow referrer's x3 slots if active
        if (users[overflowReferrer].x3Slots.length < 3) {
            users[overflowReferrer].x3Slots.push(user);
            _payX3Commission(overflowReferrer, amount);
        } else {
            // Further overflow logic or recursive search for eligible uplines
            _handleX3Overflow(user, _findEligibleReferrer(users[overflowReferrer].referrer), amount);
        }
    }

    // Pay X3 commission
    function _payX3Commission(address recipient, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(amount > 0, "Invalid amount");
        require(recipient != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
        require(users[recipient].isRegistered, "Recipient not registered");
        require(_isActive(recipient), "Recipient is not active");

        users[recipient].income.x3Income = users[recipient].income.x3Income.add(amount);
        users[recipient].income.totalEarnings = users[recipient].income.totalEarnings.add(amount); // Track total earnings for promotion
        payable(recipient).transfer(amount);
        emit CommissionEarned(recipient, amount, "x3");

        // Check promotion on commission earned
        _checkAndPromoteToLeader(recipient);
    }

    // Function to distribute X4 commissions
    function _distributeX4(address user, uint256 amount) internal {
        // Find the nearest eligible referrer with an active plan
        address eligibleReferrer = _findEligibleReferrer(users[user].referrer);

        // Add to Level 1 of the eligible referrer
        if (users[eligibleReferrer].x4FirstLevel.length < 2) {
            users[eligibleReferrer].x4FirstLevel.push(user);
        } else {
            // Add to Level 2 of the appropriate user from the eligible referrer's Level 1
            address level1User = users[eligibleReferrer].x4FirstLevel[0];
            if (users[level1User].x4SecondLevel.length < 4) {
                users[level1User].x4SecondLevel.push(user);
                _payX4Commission(level1User, amount / 4); // Pay to Level 1 user
            } else {
                level1User = users[eligibleReferrer].x4FirstLevel[1];
                users[level1User].x4SecondLevel.push(user);
                _payX4Commission(level1User, amount / 4); // Pay to Level 1 user
            }
        }

        // Pay remaining shares to the eligible referrer
        _payX4Commission(eligibleReferrer, amount / 2);
    }

    // Pay X4 commission
    function _payX4Commission(address recipient, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(amount > 0, "Invalid amount");
        require(recipient != address(0), "Invalid recipient address");
        require(users[recipient].isRegistered, "Recipient not registered");
        require(_isActive(recipient), "Recipient is not active");

        users[recipient].income.x4Income = users[recipient].income.x4Income.add(amount);
        users[recipient].income.totalEarnings = users[recipient].income.totalEarnings.add(amount); // Track total earnings for promotion
        payable(recipient).transfer(amount);
        emit CommissionEarned(recipient, amount, "x4");

        // Check promotion on commission earned
        _checkAndPromoteToLeader(recipient);
    }

    // Function to find the nearest eligible referrer with an active subscription
    function _findEligibleReferrer(address referrer) internal view returns (address) {
        while (referrer != address(0) && (!_isActive(referrer) || !users[referrer].subscription.hasSubscribed)) {
            referrer = users[referrer].referrer;
        }

        // Default to owner if no eligible referrer is found
        return referrer == address(0) ? owner : referrer;
    }

    // Function to check if the user has an active subscription
    function _isActive(address user) internal view returns (bool) {
        return block.timestamp < users[user].subscription.subscriptionEnd;
    }

    // Check and promote user to leader status if criteria are met
    function _checkAndPromoteToLeader(address user) internal {
        // Check if user meets criteria: 3 unique plans, 20 referrals with at least one subscription
        if (!users[user].isLeader && _hasThreeUniquePlans(user) && _hasTwentySubscribedReferrals(user)) {
            users[user].isLeader = true;
            emit LeaderPromoted(user, users[user].rank);
        }
    }

    // Check if user has subscribed to at least 3 unique plans
    function _hasThreeUniquePlans(address user) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint8 planCount = 0;
        for (uint8 i = 1; i <= planCount; i++) {
            if (users[user].subscribedPlans[i]) {
                planCount++;
            }
        }
        return planCount >= 3;
    }

    // Check if user has at least 20 direct referrals with one subscription
    function _hasTwentySubscribedReferrals(address user) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 subscribedCount = 0;
        address[] memory referrals = getDirectReferrals(user);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < referrals.length; i++) {
            if (users[referrals[i]].subscription.hasSubscribed) {
                subscribedCount++;
            }
        }
        return subscribedCount >= 20;
    }

    // Function to check if a leader is eligible for a monthly bonus
    function _checkMonthlyBonusEligibility(address user) internal view returns (bool) {
        // Leader must have at least 3 direct referral subscriptions in the current month
        return users[user].isLeader && users[user].subscription.directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth >= 3;
    }

    // Update the leader's rank based on the number of direct referrals and direct leaders
    function _updateLeaderRank(address user) internal {
        uint256 subscribedCount = _getSubscribedDirectReferrals(user);
        uint256 directLeadersCount = _getDirectLeaders(user);

        // Remove the user from their current rank list if they have a rank
        _removeFromLeaderTracking(user);

        // Determine the rank based on direct referrals and leaders
        if (directLeadersCount >= 3) {
            users[user].rank = Rank.Diamond;
            isDiamondLeader[user] = true; // Mark as Diamond leader
        } else if (subscribedCount >= 30) {
            users[user].rank = Rank.Gold;
            isGoldLeader[user] = true; // Mark as Gold leader
        } else if (subscribedCount >= 20) {
            users[user].rank = Rank.Silver;
            isSilverLeader[user] = true; // Mark as Silver leader
        } else {
            users[user].rank = Rank.Unranked;
        }

        emit RankUpdated(user, users[user].rank);
    }

    // Remove user from leader tracking
    function _removeFromLeaderTracking(address user) internal {
        if (isSilverLeader[user]) {
            isSilverLeader[user] = false;
        }
        if (isGoldLeader[user]) {
            isGoldLeader[user] = false;
        }
        if (isDiamondLeader[user]) {
            isDiamondLeader[user] = false;
        }
    }

    // Count direct subscribed referrals for ranking purposes
    function _getSubscribedDirectReferrals(address user) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 subscribedCount = 0;
        address[] memory referrals = getDirectReferrals(user);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < referrals.length; i++) {
            if (users[referrals[i]].subscription.hasSubscribed) {
                subscribedCount++;
            }
        }
        return subscribedCount;
    }

    // Count the number of direct leaders under the user
    function _getDirectLeaders(address user) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 leaderCount = 0;
        address[] memory referrals = getDirectReferrals(user);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < referrals.length; i++) {
            if (users[referrals[i]].rank == Rank.Silver || users[referrals[i]].rank == Rank.Gold || users[referrals[i]].rank == Rank.Diamond) {
                leaderCount++;
            }
        }
        return leaderCount;
    }

    // Function to reset monthly subscription tracking and pay bonuses
    function resetMonthlyTracking() external onlyOwner {
        uint256 silverPool = (leadersPool * 30) / 100;
        uint256 goldPool = (leadersPool * 40) / 100;
        uint256 diamondPool = (leadersPool * 30) / 100;

        // Batch processing of leader payouts for gas optimization
        _distributeLeaderBonuses(silverPool, isSilverLeader);
        _distributeLeaderBonuses(goldPool, isGoldLeader);
        _distributeLeaderBonuses(diamondPool, isDiamondLeader);

        // Reset the leaders' pool after distribution
        leadersPool = 0;

        // Reset the monthly counter for direct referral subscriptions
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < userCount; i++) {
            users[userIds[i]].subscription.directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth = 0;
            users[userIds[i]].subscription.lastSubscriptionReset = block.timestamp;
        }
    }

    // Helper function to distribute leader bonuses
    function _distributeLeaderBonuses(uint256 pool, mapping(address => bool) storage leaderMapping) internal {
        uint256 leaderCount = 0;
        address[] memory leaders = new address[](userCount); // Correctly declare a memory array with fixed length
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < userCount; i++) {
            if (leaderMapping[userIds[i]]) {
                leaders[leaderCount] = userIds[i];
                leaderCount++;
            }
        }

        if (leaderCount > 0) {
            uint256 share = pool / leaderCount;
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < leaderCount; i++) {
                users[leaders[i]].income.leaderBonus = users[leaders[i]].income.leaderBonus.add(share);
                payable(leaders[i]).transfer(share);
                emit LeaderBonusPaid(leaders[i], share);
            }
        }
    }

    // Function to extract user data without nested mappings
    function getUserInfo(address user) external view returns (UserInfo memory) {
        User storage u = users[user];
        return UserInfo(
            u.isRegistered,
            u.income.x3Income,
            u.income.x4Income,
            u.income.renewalIncome,
            u.income.totalEarnings,
            u.referrer,
            u.subscription.subscriptionEnd,
            u.subscription.currentPlan,
            u.subscription.hasSubscribed,
            u.isLeader,
            u.subscription.directReferrals,
            u.subscription.directReferralSubscriptionsThisMonth,
            u.subscription.lastSubscriptionReset,
            u.income.leaderBonus,
            u.rank,
            u.directLeaders
        );
    }
}

Creating a cryptocurrency token (like "McKeever Token") requires writing a smart contract. Below is a **simple ERC-20 token contract** on Ethereum/Solidity. You can customize it for your needs.

---

### Step 1: Write the Smart Contract
```solidity
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract McKeeverToken is ERC20, Ownable {
    // Token details
    uint8 private _decimals = 18; // Standard for most tokens
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1000000 * (10**18); // 1 million tokens

    // Constructor: Deploys the token with initial supply
    constructor() ERC20("McKeever Token", "MCK") {
        _mint(msg.sender, INITIAL_SUPPLY);
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only owner can do this)
    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        _mint(to, amount);
    }

    // Set decimals (optional)
    function decimals() public view override returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals;
    }
}
```

---

### Step 2: What This Code Does
1. **Token Basics**: 
   - Name: `McKeever Token`
   - Symbol: `MCK`
   - Decimals: `18` (standard for ETH-compatible tokens).
   - Initial Supply: `1,000,000` tokens (adjustable in code).

2. **Features**:
   - Compliant with the ERC-20 standard (interoperable with wallets like MetaMask).
   - Includes minting functionality (only the owner can create new tokens).
   - Uses OpenZeppelin’s audited libraries for security.

---

### Step 3: Deploy the Token
1. **Tools Needed**:
   - **Remix IDE** (browser-based Solidity compiler): [remix.ethereum.org](https://remix.ethereum.org/)
   - **MetaMask Wallet** (to interact with Ethereum).
   - Test ETH (e.g., on Sepolia testnet) for gas fees. Get free test ETH from a [faucet](https://sepoliafaucet.com/).

2. **Deployment Steps**:
   - Copy the code into Remix IDE.
   - Compile the contract (`Ctrl+S` or "Compile" tab).
   - Deploy it to a testnet (e.g., Sepolia) via the "Deploy" tab.
   - Verify the contract on Etherscan (optional but recommended).

---

### Step 4: Customize Further
- **Add Features**:
  - Burn functionality.
  - Tax mechanism (e.g., 2% fee per transaction).
  - Staking rewards.
- **Tokenomics**:
  - Adjust initial supply in the `INITIAL_SUPPLY` variable.
  - Allocate tokens to specific wallets (e.g., team, liquidity pool).

---

### Risks & Costs
- **Gas Fees**: Deploying on Ethereum mainnet costs ~$50–$200+ (use testnets first!).
- **Security**: Auditing is critical before launching a real token.
- **Liquidity**: A token has no value unless paired with ETH/USDC on a DEX (e.g., Uniswap).

---

### Next Steps
1. Test the token on a testnet.
2. Create a website (e.g., using Web3 tools like React + ethers.js).
3. List on a decentralized exchange (DEX).

Need help with deployment, tokenomics, or other features? Let me know! 🚀

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract EthereumCoin {

    string public name = "ETH";
    string public symbol = "ETH";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;

    // Total supply is not applicable for ETH, as it's the native currency.
    // We'll just return a hardcoded value for the sake of consistency.
    uint256 public totalSupply = 0;

    // Check balance of ETH in the contract
    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return account.balance;
    }

    // Transfer ETH from contract to recipient address
    function transfer(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Insufficient contract balance");
        recipient.transfer(amount);
        return true;
    }

    // Transfer ETH from a sender to a recipient
    function transferFrom(address payable sender, address payable recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(sender.balance >= amount, "Insufficient sender balance");
        recipient.transfer(amount);
        return true;
    }

    // Get the price of ETH (hardcoded for now, you can change this logic)
    function getETHPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        return 2720 * (10 ** decimals);  // This is just a placeholder for now.
    }

    // Return the logo URI of the token (ETH in this case)
    function logoURI() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return "https://cryptologos.cc/logos/ethereum-eth-logo.png"; 
    }

    // Fallback function to receive Ether (ETH) into the contract
    receive() external payable {
        // This function allows the contract to accept ETH
    }
    
    // Function to withdraw Ether from the contract to the owner (if needed)
    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

// Import Chainlink Aggregator Interface
import "@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol";

contract EthereumCoin {

    string public name = "ETH";
    string public symbol = "ETH";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;

    // Total supply for the token (arbitrary large supply for this example)
    uint256 public totalSupply = 1000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals)); // 1 million tokens with 18 decimals

    // Balance mapping for token holders
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;

    AggregatorV3Interface internal priceFeed;
    constructor() {
    // Chainlink ETH/USD price feed address on Ethereum mainnet
    priceFeed = AggregatorV3Interface(0x0567F2323251f0aAef45ff0e5eB28f1b3E515A8F);
}

    // Function to get the latest ETH price in USD from Chainlink
    function getLatestETHPrice() public view returns (int) {
        (
            , 
            int price, 
            , 
            , 
        ) = priceFeed.latestRoundData();
        return price; // Returns price in 8 decimal places
    }

    // Function to get the equivalent USD value of a given amount of tokens
    function getTokenUSDValue(uint256 tokenAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        int ethPriceInUsd = getLatestETHPrice();
        require(ethPriceInUsd > 0, "Invalid price data");
        uint256 ethPrice = uint256(ethPriceInUsd); // Convert to positive value
        uint256 tokenValueInUSD = (tokenAmount * ethPrice) / (10 ** decimals); // Example calculation
        return tokenValueInUSD;
    }

    // Function to transfer tokens from one account to another
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;
        balanceOf[recipient] += amount;
        return true;
    }

    // Function to transfer tokens from a sender to a recipient with approval (like ERC20 transferFrom)
    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(balanceOf[sender] >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        balanceOf[sender] -= amount;
        balanceOf[recipient] += amount;
        return true;
    }

    // Fallback function to receive Ether (ETH)
    receive() external payable {}

    // Function to withdraw Ether from the contract to the owner
    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount);
    }

    // Function to get the balance of the contract in ETH
    function contractBalance() public view returns (uint256) {
        return address(this).balance;
    }

    // Function to mint new tokens (only for example purposes, avoid in production)
    function mint(address account, uint256 amount) public {
        totalSupply += amount;
        balanceOf[account] += amount;
    }

    // Function to get the token's logo URI (for UI display)
    function logoURI() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return "https://cryptologos.cc/logos/ethereum-eth-logo.png"; 
    }
}

 // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.9;

/**
 * @dev Provides information about the current execution context, including the
 * sender of the transaction and its data. While these are generally available
 * via msg.sender and msg.data, they should not be accessed in such a direct
 * manner, since when dealing with meta-transactions the account sending and
 * paying for execution may not be the actual sender (as far as an application
 * is concerned).
 *
 * This contract is only required for intermediate, library-like contracts.
 */
abstract contract Context {
    function _msgSender() internal view virtual returns (address) {
        return msg.sender;
    }

    function _msgData() internal view virtual returns (bytes calldata) {
        return msg.data;
    }
}


/**
 * @dev Interface of the ERC20 standard as defined in the EIP.
 */
interface IERC20 {
    /**
     * @dev Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to
     * another (`to`).
     *
     * Note that `value` may be zero.
     */
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);

    /**
     * @dev Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by
     * a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.
     */
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the amount of tokens in existence.
     */
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the amount of tokens owned by `account`.
     */
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Moves `amount` tokens from the caller's account to `to`.
     *
     * Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded.
     *
     * Emits a {Transfer} event.
     */
    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be
     * allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is
     * zero by default.
     *
     * This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.
     */
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the caller's tokens.
     *
     * Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded.
     *
     * IMPORTANT: Beware that changing an allowance with this method brings the risk
     * that someone may use both the old and the new allowance by unfortunate
     * transaction ordering. One possible solution to mitigate this race
     * condition is to first reduce the spender's allowance to 0 and set the
     * desired value afterwards:
     * https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/20#issuecomment-263524729
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event.
     */
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);

    /**
     * @dev Moves `amount` tokens from `from` to `to` using the
     * allowance mechanism. `amount` is then deducted from the caller's
     * allowance.
     *
     * Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded.
     *
     * Emits a {Transfer} event.
     */
    function transferFrom(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 amount
    ) external returns (bool);
}


/**
 * @dev Interface for the optional metadata functions from the ERC20 standard.
 *
 * _Available since v4.1._
 */
interface IERC20Metadata is IERC20 {
    /**
     * @dev Returns the name of the token.
     */
    function name() external view returns (string memory);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the symbol of the token.
     */
    function symbol() external view returns (string memory);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the decimals places of the token.
     */
    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
}



/**
 * @dev Implementation of the {IERC20} interface.
 *
 * This implementation is agnostic to the way tokens are created. This means
 * that a supply mechanism has to be added in a derived contract using {_mint}.
 * For a generic mechanism see {ERC20PresetMinterPauser}.
 *
 * TIP: For a detailed writeup see our guide
 * https://forum.openzeppelin.com/t/how-to-implement-erc20-supply-mechanisms/226[How
 * to implement supply mechanisms].
 *
 * We have followed general OpenZeppelin Contracts guidelines: functions revert
 * instead returning `false` on failure. This behavior is nonetheless
 * conventional and does not conflict with the expectations of ERC20
 * applications.
 *
 * Additionally, an {Approval} event is emitted on calls to {transferFrom}.
 * This allows applications to reconstruct the allowance for all accounts just
 * by listening to said events. Other implementations of the EIP may not emit
 * these events, as it isn't required by the specification.
 *
 * Finally, the non-standard {decreaseAllowance} and {increaseAllowance}
 * functions have been added to mitigate the well-known issues around setting
 * allowances. See {IERC20-approve}.
 */
contract ERC20 is Context, IERC20, IERC20Metadata {
    mapping(address => uint256) private _balances;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances;

    uint256 private _totalSupply;

    string private _name;
    string private _symbol;

    /**
     * @dev Sets the values for {name} and {symbol}.
     *
     * The default value of {decimals} is 18. To select a different value for
     * {decimals} you should overload it.
     *
     * All two of these values are immutable: they can only be set once during
     * construction.
     */
    constructor(string memory name_, string memory symbol_) {
        _name = name_;
        _symbol = symbol_;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Returns the name of the token.
     */
    function name() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _name;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the
     * name.
     */
    function symbol() public view virtual override returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation.
     * For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should
     * be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`).
     *
     * Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between
     * Ether and Wei. This is the value {ERC20} uses, unless this function is
     * overridden;
     *
     * NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in
     * no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including
     * {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.
     */
    function decimals() public view virtual override returns (uint8) {
        return 18;
    }

    /**
     * @dev See {IERC20-totalSupply}.
     */
    function totalSupply() public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSupply;
    }

    /**
     * @dev See {IERC20-balanceOf}.
     */
    function balanceOf(address account) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[account];
    }

    /**
     * @dev See {IERC20-transfer}.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `to` cannot be the zero address.
     * - the caller must have a balance of at least `amount`.
     */
    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        address owner = _msgSender();
        _transfer(owner, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @dev See {IERC20-allowance}.
     */
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) public view virtual override returns (uint256) {
        return _allowances[owner][spender];
    }

    /**
     * @dev See {IERC20-approve}.
     *
     * NOTE: If `amount` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on
     * `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `spender` cannot be the zero address.
     */
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        address owner = _msgSender();
        _approve(owner, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @dev See {IERC20-transferFrom}.
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance. This is not
     * required by the EIP. See the note at the beginning of {ERC20}.
     *
     * NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance
     * is the maximum `uint256`.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `from` must have a balance of at least `amount`.
     * - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least
     * `amount`.
     */
    function transferFrom(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 amount
    ) public virtual override returns (bool) {
        address spender = _msgSender();
        _spendAllowance(from, spender, amount);
        _transfer(from, to, amount);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Atomically increases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller.
     *
     * This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for
     * problems described in {IERC20-approve}.
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `spender` cannot be the zero address.
     */
    function increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public virtual returns (bool) {
        address owner = _msgSender();
        _approve(owner, spender, allowance(owner, spender) + addedValue);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Atomically decreases the allowance granted to `spender` by the caller.
     *
     * This is an alternative to {approve} that can be used as a mitigation for
     * problems described in {IERC20-approve}.
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event indicating the updated allowance.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `spender` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `spender` must have allowance for the caller of at least
     * `subtractedValue`.
     */
    function decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public virtual returns (bool) {
        address owner = _msgSender();
        uint256 currentAllowance = allowance(owner, spender);
        require(currentAllowance >= subtractedValue, "ERC20: decreased allowance below zero");
        unchecked {
            _approve(owner, spender, currentAllowance - subtractedValue);
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * @dev Moves `amount` of tokens from `from` to `to`.
     *
     * This internal function is equivalent to {transfer}, and can be used to
     * e.g. implement automatic token fees, slashing mechanisms, etc.
     *
     * Emits a {Transfer} event.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `from` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `to` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `from` must have a balance of at least `amount`.
     */
    function _transfer(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 amount
    ) internal virtual {
        require(from != address(0), "ERC20: transfer from the zero address");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC20: transfer to the zero address");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, amount);

        uint256 fromBalance = _balances[from];
        require(fromBalance >= amount, "ERC20: transfer amount exceeds balance");
        unchecked {
            _balances[from] = fromBalance - amount;
            // Overflow not possible: the sum of all balances is capped by totalSupply, and the sum is preserved by
            // decrementing then incrementing.
            _balances[to] += amount;
        }

        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);

        _afterTokenTransfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    /** @dev Creates `amount` tokens and assigns them to `account`, increasing
     * the total supply.
     *
     * Emits a {Transfer} event with `from` set to the zero address.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `account` cannot be the zero address.
     */
    function _mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC20: mint to the zero address");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), account, amount);

        _totalSupply += amount;
        unchecked {
            // Overflow not possible: balance + amount is at most totalSupply + amount, which is checked above.
            _balances[account] += amount;
        }
        emit Transfer(address(0), account, amount);

        _afterTokenTransfer(address(0), account, amount);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Destroys `amount` tokens from `account`, reducing the
     * total supply.
     *
     * Emits a {Transfer} event with `to` set to the zero address.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `account` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `account` must have at least `amount` tokens.
     */
    function _burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC20: burn from the zero address");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(account, address(0), amount);

        uint256 accountBalance = _balances[account];
        require(accountBalance >= amount, "ERC20: burn amount exceeds balance");
        unchecked {
            _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount;
            // Overflow not possible: amount <= accountBalance <= totalSupply.
            _totalSupply -= amount;
        }

        emit Transfer(account, address(0), amount);

        _afterTokenTransfer(account, address(0), amount);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Sets `amount` as the allowance of `spender` over the `owner` s tokens.
     *
     * This internal function is equivalent to `approve`, and can be used to
     * e.g. set automatic allowances for certain subsystems, etc.
     *
     * Emits an {Approval} event.
     *
     * Requirements:
     *
     * - `owner` cannot be the zero address.
     * - `spender` cannot be the zero address.
     */
    function _approve(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 amount
    ) internal virtual {
        require(owner != address(0), "ERC20: approve from the zero address");
        require(spender != address(0), "ERC20: approve to the zero address");

        _allowances[owner][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(owner, spender, amount);
    }

    /**
     * @dev Updates `owner` s allowance for `spender` based on spent `amount`.
     *
     * Does not update the allowance amount in case of infinite allowance.
     * Revert if not enough allowance is available.
     *
     * Might emit an {Approval} event.
     */
    function _spendAllowance(
        address owner,
        address spender,
        uint256 amount
    ) internal virtual {
        uint256 currentAllowance = allowance(owner, spender);
        if (currentAllowance != type(uint256).max) {
            require(currentAllowance >= amount, "ERC20: insufficient allowance");
            unchecked {
                _approve(owner, spender, currentAllowance - amount);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @dev Hook that is called before any transfer of tokens. This includes
     * minting and burning.
     *
     * Calling conditions:
     *
     * - when `from` and `to` are both non-zero, `amount` of ``from``'s tokens
     * will be transferred to `to`.
     * - when `from` is zero, `amount` tokens will be minted for `to`.
     * - when `to` is zero, `amount` of ``from``'s tokens will be burned.
     * - `from` and `to` are never both zero.
     *
     * To learn more about hooks, head to xref:ROOT:extending-contracts.adoc#using-hooks[Using Hooks].
     */
    function _beforeTokenTransfer(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 amount
    ) internal virtual {}

    /**
     * @dev Hook that is called after any transfer of tokens. This includes
     * minting and burning.
     *
     * Calling conditions:
     *
     * - when `from` and `to` are both non-zero, `amount` of ``from``'s tokens
     * has been transferred to `to`.
     * - when `from` is zero, `amount` tokens have been minted for `to`.
     * - when `to` is zero, `amount` of ``from``'s tokens have been burned.
     * - `from` and `to` are never both zero.
     *
     * To learn more about hooks, head to xref:ROOT:extending-contracts.adoc#using-hooks[Using Hooks].
     */
    function _afterTokenTransfer(
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 amount
    ) internal virtual {}
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract EthereumCoin {

    string public name = "ETH";
    string public symbol = "ETH";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;

    // Total supply is not applicable for ETH, as it's the native currency.
    // We'll just return a hardcoded value for the sake of consistency.
    uint256 public totalSupply = 0;

    // Check balance of ETH in the contract
    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        return account.balance;
    }

    // Transfer ETH from contract to recipient address
    function transfer(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Insufficient contract balance");
        recipient.transfer(amount);
        return true;
    }

    // Transfer ETH from a sender to a recipient
    function transferFrom(address payable sender, address payable recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(sender.balance >= amount, "Insufficient sender balance");
        recipient.transfer(amount);
        return true;
    }

    // Get the price of ETH (hardcoded for now, you can change this logic)
    function getETHPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        return 2720 * (10 ** decimals);  // This is just a placeholder for now.
    }

    // Return the logo URI of the token (ETH in this case)
    function logoURI() public pure returns (string memory) {
        return "https://cryptologos.cc/logos/ethereum-eth-logo.png"; 
    }

    // Fallback function to receive Ether (ETH) into the contract
    receive() external payable {
        // This function allows the contract to accept ETH
    }
    
    // Function to withdraw Ether from the contract to the owner (if needed)
    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount);
    }
}

contract EthereumCoin {

    string public name = "ETH";
    string public symbol = "ETH";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;

    // Total supply for the token (arbitrary large supply for this example)
    uint256 public totalSupply = 1000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals)); // 1 million tokens with 18 decimals

    // Balance mapping for token holders
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;

    AggregatorV3Interface internal priceFeed;
    constructor() {
    // Chainlink ETH/USD price feed address on Ethereum mainnet
    priceFeed = AggregatorV3Interface(0x0567F2323251f0aAef45ff0e5eB28f1b3E515A8F);
}

    // Function to get the latest ETH price in USD from Chainlink
    function getLatestETHPrice() public view returns (int) {
        (
            , 
            int price, 
            , 
            , 
        ) = priceFeed.latestRoundData();
        return price; // Returns price in 8 decimal places
    }

    // Function to get the equivalent USD value of a given amount of tokens
    function getTokenUSDValue(uint256 tokenAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        int ethPriceInUsd = getLatestETHPrice();
        require(ethPriceInUsd > 0, "Invalid price data");
        uint256 ethPrice = uint256(ethPriceInUsd); // Convert to positive value
        uint256 tokenValueInUSD = (tokenAmount * ethPrice) / (10 ** decimals); // Example calculation
        return tokenValueInUSD;
    }

    // Function to transfer tokens from one account to another
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;
        balanceOf[recipient] += amount;
        return true;
    }

    // Function to transfer tokens from a sender to a recipient with approval (like ERC20 transferFrom)
    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public returns (bool) {
        require(balanceOf[sender] >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        balanceOf[sender] -= amount;
        balanceOf[recipient] += amount;
        return true;
    }

    // Fallback function to receive Ether (ETH)
    receive() external payable {}

    // Function to withdraw Ether from the contract to the owner
    function withdraw(uint256 amount) public {
        payable(msg.sender).transfer(amount);
    }

    // Function to get the balance of the contract in ETH
    function contractBalance() public view returns (uint256) {
        return address(this).balance;
    }

    // Function to mint new tokens (only for example purposes, avoid in production)
    function mint(address account, uint256 amount) public {
        totalSupply += amount;
        balanceOf[account] += amount;
    }

    // Function to get the token's logo URI (for UI display)

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract McKeeverToken is ERC20, Ownable {
    // Token details
    uint8 private _decimals = 18; // Standard for most tokens
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1000000 * (10**18); // 1 million tokens

    // Constructor: Deploys the token with initial supply
    constructor() ERC20("McKeever Token", "MCK") {
        _mint(msg.sender, INITIAL_SUPPLY);
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only owner can do this)
    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        _mint(to, amount);
    }

    // Set decimals (optional)
    function decimals() public view override returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals;
    }
}

Deploying an ERC20 Token
With a basic understanding of smart contract, and using EDU Chain to interact and work with them, it’s time to take things up a notch! This section, we’ll guide you through deploying your own ERC20 token, using OpenZeppelin’s battle-tested ERC20 🪙 implementation.

What is OpenZeppelin?
Before we dive into the contract, let understand OpenZeppelin. OpenZeppelin is a library for secure smart contract development. It provides implementations of popular token standards, including ERC20, which you can use to create your own tokens without having to reinvent the wheel. Using OpenZeppelin's implementations ensures that your token adheres to best practices and standards in the Ethereum ecosystem.

From understanding the basic structure of the contract, let create a SampleERCToken. Load the template contract https://github.com/POLearn/pol-template/blob/master/contracts/SampleERCToken.sol in your desired IDE.



We can see that it a empty contract. However, notable there is a import of OpenZeppelin ERC20 contract. Let's take a look into that.

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
This allows you to inherit the ERC20 contract and build your token on top of it. OpenZeppelin provides a secure, battle-tested foundation for ERC20 tokens.



If we take a look at the constructuor, its take in a name and symbol. The remaining code, are implementation for minting, and transfering the ERC20 token, all completed for you.

Let inherit this in our main contract. Going back SampleERCToken. Make sure your contract is ERC20 such that,

contract SampleERCToken is ERC20
In the constructor, we will also make sure to call the ERC20 contractor,

constructor() ERC20("TokenName", "TOKEN") {
}
We will define the ERC20 token by writing the contract code. Use the name "TokenPoken" and symbol "TP" as arguments to the ERC20 constructor. Make sure the constructor is empty, only calling the ERC20 constructor:

For more details on the ERC20 contract, refer to the OpenZeppelin documentation to understand its features and functionality.

Compile the Contract
Like our previous contract, ensure you're using the correct Solidity compiler version. For this exercise, we'll use 0.8.23. Using the right version is crucial, as features and syntax may vary across versions,

Deploy the Contract
Once your contract is compiled, deploy the SampleERCToken to the EDU Chain testnet that we connected. MetaMask will prompt you to approve the transaction for deployment.

Testing Your Token
Once your TokenPoken contract is deployed, you can interact with its inherited ERC20 functions. Here are a few actions to try:

🧮 Check Total Supply: Call totalSupply to view the total TokenPoken tokens.
👛 Check Your Balance: Use balanceOf with your address to see your token balance.
🔄 Transfer Tokens: Try the name function to send tokens to another wallet.


❗Quest: Token Deployment
If you deployed a SimpleContract earlier, you can do the same for SimpleERCToken. Congratulations! You've successfully created and deployed your own ERC20 token called TokenPoken with the symbol TP using OpenZeppelin's ERC20 contract. This exercise demonstrates the power and ease of using OpenZeppelin for secure and standardized smart contract development.

Make sure you claim for POL POAP from Proof of Learn, showcasing you deployed and interact smart contract on EDU Chain! 🎉🎉🎉

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract McKeeverToken is ERC20, Ownable {
    // Token details
    uint8 private _decimals = 18; // Standard for most tokens
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1000000 * (10**18); // 1 million tokens

    // Constructor: Deploys the token with initial supply
    constructor() ERC20("McKeever Token", "MCK") {
        _mint(msg.sender, INITIAL_SUPPLY);
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only owner can do this)
    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        _mint(to, amount);
    }

    // Set decimals (optional)
    function decimals() public view override returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract McKeeverToken is ERC20, Ownable {
    // Token details
    uint8 private _decimals = 18; // Standard for most tokens
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1000000 * (10**18); // 1 million tokens

    // Constructor: Deploys the token with initial supply
    constructor() ERC20("McKeever Token", "MCK") {
        _mint(msg.sender, INITIAL_SUPPLY);
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only owner can do this)
    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        _mint(to, amount);
    }

    // Set decimals (optional)
    function decimals() public view override returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract McKeeverToken is ERC20, Ownable {
    // Token details
    uint8 private _decimals = 18; // Standard for most tokens
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1000000 * (10**18); // 1 million tokens

    // Constructor: Deploys the token with initial supply
    constructor() ERC20("McKeever Token", "MCK") {
        _mint(msg.sender, INITIAL_SUPPLY);
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only owner can do this)
    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) public onlyOwner {
        _mint(to, amount);
    }

    // Set decimals (optional)
    function decimals() public view override returns (uint8) {
        return _decimals;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.6.6;
 
// Import Libraries Migrator/Exchange/Factory
import "github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-periphery/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Migrator.sol";
